verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galvladisgini">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsitlisisgesdi">ᏫᏥᏟᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hani">ᎾᎿᎭᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisgoyv">ᏥᏍᎪᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayasdladadisgino">ᎠᏯᏍᏜᏓᏗᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyosdodiyi">ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninosgisgi">ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvsdiyi">ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninosgisdiyi">ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hna·hayeno">ᎾᎿᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsihvi">ᏫᏥᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widahesdi">ᏫᏓᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanvdo">ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agata">ᎠᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatisdisgi">ᎦᏘᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higadoli">ᎯᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdvna">ᏄᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigv">ᏂᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiyelvi">ᎯᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ukalitsonvhi">ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igagati">ᎢᎦᎦᏘ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higadoli">ᎯᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigv">ᏂᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiyelvi">ᎯᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ukalitsonvhi">ᎤᎧᎵᏦᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigi">ᎤᎵᏏᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Iyusginino">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igagati">ᎢᎦᎦᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawini">ᎭᏫᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsehv">ᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigiquo">ᎤᎵᏏᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigi">ᎤᎵᏏᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niga">ᏂᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:equohiyu">ᎡᏉᎯᏳ</w>!

verses.name: Matthew 6:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanatlai">ᎬᏩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogvdvnisi">ᏱᏙᎬᏛᏂᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yiasgagayeno">ᏱᎠᏍᎦᎦᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgeyuhano">ᏱᏅᎨᏳᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soi">ᏐᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidouniyvha">ᏱᏙᎤᏂᏴᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiganiquatihano">ᏱᎦᏂᏆᏘᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soi">ᏐᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgini">ᏝᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Mamani">ᎹᎹᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdiyidogetsadvnisi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏱᏙᎨᏣᏛᏂᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitselihisgesdi">ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsvnvi">ᏕᏨᏅᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigisdiyi">ᎢᏥᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaditasdiyi">ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelvi">ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitselihisgesdi">ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsanuwosdiyi">ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏍᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agvnv">ᎠᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinuwo">ᏗᏄᏬ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 6:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ditsakanvga">ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisqua">ᏥᏍᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvloi">ᎦᎸᎶᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlayeno">ᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaniwisgoi">ᏯᏂᏫᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaninetsaisgoi">ᏯᏂᏁᏣᎢᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadanelv">ᏓᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanitlisisgoi">ᏯᏂᏟᏏᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsidoda">ᎢᏥᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dogelohoi">ᏙᎨᎶᎰᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinetsilvquodi">ᏱᏁᏥᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 6:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagono">ᎦᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsadvnv">ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udasuya">ᎤᏓᏑᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwelihisgvquo">ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyutlilodv">ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yikanequotsa">ᏱᎧᏁᏉᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnvi">ᎬᏅᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 6:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinuwo">ᏗᏄᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotselihisgoi">ᏙᏤᎵᎯᏍᎪᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ditsadanvdvli">ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏛᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutsilvhi">ᏧᏥᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlogesi">ᏠᎨᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsehi">ᏤᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadvsgvi">ᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidunilvwisdanehoi">ᏱᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanisdohoi">ᏯᏂᏍᏙᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:solimanv">ᏐᎵᎹᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwodusvi">ᏄᏬᏚᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusde">ᏱᏄᏍᏕ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunuwvi">ᏚᏄᏮᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdvi">ᏄᏍᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigvneha">ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiganuwoha">ᏱᎦᏄᏬᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanesga">ᎧᏁᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlogesi">ᏠᎨᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tseha">ᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugitsvnvno">ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digadudiyi">ᏗᎦᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunadinvdi">ᏭᎾᏗᏅᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinidogetsinuwotsa">ᏱᏂᏙᎨᏥᏄᏬᏣ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyuhi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 6:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitselihisgesdi">ᏱᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsiwesgesdi">ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayotsigi">ᏓᏲᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayotsaditahi">ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏔᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayotsanuwoi">ᏓᏲᏣᏄᏬᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 6:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadvyeno">ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyoho">ᎤᏂᏲᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsunatelenvdv">ᏧᎾᏖᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Galvladiyeno">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsidoda">ᎢᏥᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agataha">ᎠᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinigvsehvi">ᎢᏥᏂᎬᏎᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igvyisgini">ᎢᎬᏱᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyoga">ᎢᏥᏲᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodvi">ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayetsinequoeli">ᏓᏰᏥᏁᏉᎡᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 6:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugitsvnv">ᎤᎩᏨᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiwitselihisgesdi">ᏱᏫᏤᎵᎯᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugitsvnvyeno">ᎤᎩᏨᏅᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvdelihistani">ᏛᏕᎵᎯᏍᏔᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwehvi">ᎤᏪᎲᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.6"/>

verses.name: Matthew 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 7</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7"/><w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsadalawiseli">ᏥᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsilawiselvgi">ᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadalawiselv">ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvetsilawiseli">ᏛᎡᏥᎳᏫᏎᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadatlilosvlv">ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᏒᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvetsatliloeli">ᏛᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ihigowatisgo">ᎢᎯᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvdalvdv">ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugasuhvi">ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadanvtli">ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nelisgvnano">ᏁᎵᏍᎬᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igeso">ᎢᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unosdv">ᎤᏃᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ada">ᎠᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagasuhvi">ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdoda">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiniwesi">ᏱᏂᏪᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadanvtli">ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gvlvsi">ᎬᎸᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvdalvdv">ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagasuhvi">ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unosdv">ᎤᏃᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ada">ᎠᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagasuha">ᏣᎦᏑᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsatlonasdi">ᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hilv">ᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unosdv">ᎤᏃᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ada">ᎠᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagasuhvi">ᏣᎦᏑᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesviyu">ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagowadvdiyi">ᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hilvediyi">ᎯᎸᎡᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvdalvdv">ᎤᏢᏓᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadanvtli">ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugasuhvi">ᎤᎦᏑᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodi">ᎦᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gili">ᎩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinelvgi">ᏗᏥᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvna-iyunasdi">ᏓᎬᎾ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatseliga">ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:siqua">ᏏᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widitsadinelvgi">ᏫᏗᏣᏗᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yidanalasdavliquoyeno">ᏱᏓᎾᎳᏍᏓᎥᎵᏉᏰᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanagatahvna">ᏯᎾᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgetsidagalvvga">ᏴᎨᏥᏓᎦᎸᎥᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsitayoha">ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayetsineli">ᏓᏰᏥᏁᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsiyoga">ᎢᏥᏲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsiwadvhi">ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsvniga">ᎢᏨᏂᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayetsisduieli">ᏓᏰᏥᏍᏚᎢᎡᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:8

verses.name: Matthew 7:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagoge">ᎦᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsadvnv">ᏥᏂᏣᏛᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yutayoseha">ᏳᏔᏲᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvyaquo">ᏅᏯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yahvsi">ᏯᎲᏏ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 7:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsadi">ᎠᏣᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatayohiha">ᏯᏔᏲᎯᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inadvquo">ᎢᎾᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvganvvsi">ᏴᎦᏅᎥᏏ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 7:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyoi">ᎢᏥᏲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsisina·hi">ᏱᏥᏏᎾᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinediyi">ᏗᏥᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsetsi">ᏗᏤᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsidoda">ᎢᏥᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danehesdi">ᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwatayosehi">ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadulisgv">ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igetsadvnediyi">ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidetsadvnehesdi">ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>

verses.name: Matthew 7:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayadoli">ᎠᏯᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galohisdiyi">ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyvsda">ᎢᏥᏴᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ayateniyeno">ᎠᏯᏖᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galohisdiyi">ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayateni">ᎠᏯᏖᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvnohi">ᏅᏃᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdiyi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigananugogvi">ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uni">ᎤᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatano">ᏣᏔᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haanilosga">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏂᎶᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayadoliyuyeno">ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galohisdiyi">ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayadoliyu">ᎠᏯᏙᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvnohi">ᏅᏃᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigananugogvi">ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigayoliyu">ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwatiha">ᎠᏂᏩᏘᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Detseyadotsehesdi">ᏕᏤᏯᏙᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlonasdi">ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninodena">ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganega">ᎦᏁᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanuwai">ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigetsilutsehoi">ᏥᎨᏥᎷᏤᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawini">ᎭᏫᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waya">ᏩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigvvsgi">ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadadvsgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodatsolistani">ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:telvladi">ᏖᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danadesgo">ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisdunigisdihi">ᏥᏍᏚᏂᎩᏍᏗᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgata-iyunasdi">ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigotsitsihi">ᏥᎪᏥᏥᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danadesgoi">ᏓᎾᏕᏍᎪᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 7:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadvsgoi">ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyono">ᎤᏲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadvsgoi">ᎠᏓᏛᏍᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvdadvga">ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvdadvga">ᏴᎬᏓᏛᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigavsgini">ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detlugv">ᏕᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanadadvsgvna">ᎾᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:digaleyvsdodi">ᏗᎦᎴᏴᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvyi">ᎠᏥᎸᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widadinvdi">ᏫᏓᏗᏅᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodatsolistani">ᏙᏓᏦᎵᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadadvsgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏛᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvquosehi">ᎬᏉᏎᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuninanugoisdi">ᏭᏂᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgv">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanehi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 7:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsatisdi">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvgiwehali">ᏅᏓᎬᎩᏪᎭᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadov">ᏕᏣᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsvdisge">ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsadolehosgei">ᏲᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadov">ᏕᏣᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsvdisge">ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidotsinugowisgei">ᏱᏙᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎨᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadov">ᏕᏣᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsvdisge">ᏲᏨᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogilvwisdanehei">ᏱᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 7:23

verses.name: Matthew 7:24

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Usvnileno">ᎤᏒᏂᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udilehvsgvno">ᎤᏗᎴᎲᏍᎬᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiwahai">ᎤᏗᏩᎭᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Duleneno">ᏚᎴᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusdelvhidolei">ᏚᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Usvno">ᎤᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanv">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unitsate">ᎤᏂᏣᏖ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwaniyai">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwatinohelei">ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dunugowiseno">ᏚᏄᎪᏫᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanegvquo">ᎧᏁᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgei">ᎬᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunitlvgi">ᏧᏂᏢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvwanei">ᏚᏅᏩᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyudiyi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvsvgi">ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isaya">ᎢᏌᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetsei">ᏧᏁᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwesei">ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igigisdanelvgi">ᎢᎩᎩᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didiwanagalahiyu">ᏗᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:degitlvgvno">ᏕᎩᏢᎬᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwanelvgi">ᏂᏚᏩᏁᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dugohv">ᏚᎪᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadladawisdisgvi">ᎬᏩᏜᏓᏫᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unetse">ᎤᏁᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isgonv">ᎢᏍᎪᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunilohisdiyi">ᏭᏂᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digowelisgi">ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsei">ᎤᎷᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvsdawadidoli">ᏓᎬᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hedohvi">ᎮᏙᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsula">ᏧᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunitalesoi">ᏚᏂᏔᎴᏐᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsisquano">ᏥᏍᏆᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvlo">ᎦᎸᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunanesdatlahoi">ᏚᎾᏁᏍᏓᏝᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yvwisgini">ᏴᏫᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhitlv">ᎢᎸᎯᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgoli">ᎠᏍᎪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiyi">ᎤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdawadidohi">ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gena">ᎨᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinisanuga">ᏥᏂᏌᏄᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwehalei">ᏄᏪᎭᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sgisdawaduga">ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unanelagino">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninisisgesdi">ᏓᏂᏂᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatseli">ᏧᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuhi">ᏥᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wutsanv">ᏭᏣᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadvsei">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyilole">ᎤᏱᎶᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unole">ᎤᏃᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idali">ᎢᏓᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuyeno">ᏥᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ama">ᎠᎹ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dalisdilanegv">ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwutlvvsgei">ᎤᏭᏢᎥᏍᎨᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igalihequo">ᎢᎦᎵᎮᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutsele">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayestanei">ᎬᏩᏰᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselei">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:sgisdelv">ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dayotsadisvniquo">ᏓᏲᏣᏗᏒᏂᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisgaiha">ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎢᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyuhi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulenv">ᏚᎴᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusgatse">ᏚᏍᎦᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unole">ᎤᏃᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatino">ᎤᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udatsinasdvhi">ᎤᏓᏥᎾᏍᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanei">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anisgayano">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisquanigosei">ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquoyeno">ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unole">ᎤᏃᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwohiyuhvsga">ᎢᎬᏬᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Isgoniditlvno">ᎢᏍᎪᏂᏗᏢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutsv">ᏭᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gagisini">ᎦᎩᏏᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseligohi">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwaniyai">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwatlosei">ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dadanisahv">ᏓᏓᏂᏌᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninugotsei">ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatanvhi">ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihna·halvhiyu">ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hagvwalohisdi">ᎾᎿᎭᎬᏩᎶᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelunei">ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digadadvdodi">ᏗᎦᏓᏛᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalutsilv">ᏣᎷᏥᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sginigiliyoisdodiyiquo">ᏍᎩᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasqualisgvna">ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 8:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gehino">ᎨᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinedohe">ᏗᏁᏙᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sunadatlugi">ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:siqua">ᏏᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analisdayvnidohei">ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏂᏙᎮᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anisginano">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwatayoselei">ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselei">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgininugowisvha">ᏍᎩᏂᏄᎪᏫᏒᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgineliselvha">ᏍᎩᏁᎵᏎᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:siqua">ᏏᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sunadatlugi">ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigosdiyvsdiyi">ᏫᎪᏍᏗᏴᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sdena">ᏍᏕᎾ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Uninugotsvno">ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:siqua">ᏏᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sunadatlugi">ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuniyvlei">ᏫᏚᏂᏴᎴᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sunadatlugi">ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:siqua">ᏏᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayanuliyu">ᎠᏯᏄᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisei">ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:wunigasoase">ᏭᏂᎦᏐᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganetlugi">ᎦᏁᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvsvi">ᎬᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunalitadinvsei">ᏭᎾᎵᏔᏗᏅᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amayi">ᎠᎹᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniliwotsei">ᏚᏂᎵᏬᏤᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dinigatiyano">ᏗᏂᎦᏘᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisei">ᎤᎾᎵᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:digaduhv">ᏗᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunilosei">ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuninohelei">ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwaniyai">ᎬᏩᏂᏯᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunalisdanelvi">ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 8:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgadugi">ᏍᎦᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninugotsei">ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwatlosilei">ᏕᎬᏩᏠᏏᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvwagohvno">ᎬᏩᎪᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwatayosele">ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvsdiyiquo">ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseligohi">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.8"/>

verses.name: Matthew 9:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 9</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9"/><w xlit="Seq:Tsiyuhino">ᏥᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsanv">ᎤᏣᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duwesotsei">ᏚᏪᏐᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uwasvno">ᎤᏩᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uweduhv">ᎤᏪᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutsei">ᏭᎷᏤᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwatinohele">ᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvgi">ᎤᏢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulvdalvvsgi">ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvge">ᎦᏅᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsesdogihi">ᎠᏤᏍᏙᎩᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgvi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesele">ᏄᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulvdalvvsgi">ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugalisdiyuquo">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hadanvdada">ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsasganvtsv">ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsadoligi">ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinowelisgi">ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwese">ᏄᏂᏪᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadanvdvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asotlvisdiha">ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahe">ᎠᎦᏔᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvteha">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinawiyi">ᏗᏥᎾᏫᏱ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 9:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahidiyu">ᎠᎯᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdiyi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinagawea">ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsasganvtsv">ᏣᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsadoligi">ᎡᏣᏙᎵᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Hiage">ᎯᎠᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinagawea">ᏱᎾᎦᏪᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:talehvga">ᏔᎴᎲᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geda">ᎨᏓ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 9:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadolehohisdiyi">ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvtsv">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadadolisdi">ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesele">ᏄᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulvdalvvsgi">ᎤᎸᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Talehvga">ᏔᎴᎲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsatsesdo">ᏣᏤᏍᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hinagi">ᎯᎾᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsenvsv">ᏗᏤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hena">ᎮᎾ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dulenvno">ᏚᎴᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwenvsv">ᏧᏪᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulosei">ᏭᎶᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unitsatino">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigohv">ᎤᏂᎪᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unisquanigosei">ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilvquotane">ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulisgolvdanelvhi">ᏧᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanediyi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haudanvsv">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugohvgi">ᎤᎪᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Madu">ᎹᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudoidv">ᏧᏙᎢᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uwolvgi">ᎤᏬᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvdiyi">ᎠᎫᏴᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sgisdawaduga">ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏚᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Dulenvno">ᏚᎴᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdawadvsvgi">ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ganvgv">ᎦᏅᎬ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgv">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:galitsode">ᎦᎵᏦᏕ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsadvgi">ᎤᏂᏣᏛᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigisidohi">ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgana">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsv">ᎤᏂᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanitlvnvgi">ᎤᎾᏂᏢᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninvdladav">ᎠᏂᏅᏜᏓᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisino">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadolehosv">ᎤᎾᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidu">ᏂᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niweselv">ᏂᏪᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ditseyohvsgi">ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigisidohi">ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgana">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ianalisdayvhvsga">ᎢᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 9:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvganv">ᎤᏛᎦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nidunitlvgvna">ᏂᏚᏂᏢᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulvdi">ᎤᏚᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinunalisdaneho">ᏱᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didanvwisgi">ᏗᏓᏅᏫᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsunitlvgisgini">ᏧᏂᏢᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsenasgini">ᎢᏤᎾᏍᎩᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:witsadeloqua">ᏫᏣᏕᎶᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadvgv">ᎦᏛᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigaweha">ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquaduliha">ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelasdiyi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanisganvna">ᎾᏂᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsiyanvhilv">ᏱᏗᏥᏯᏅᎯᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anisganasgini">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninetliyvsdiyi">ᏧᏂᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadanvdvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisino">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yano">ᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsvsga">ᏦᏨᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsasdawadidohi">ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanvsgvna">ᎾᏅᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 9:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegatsvsdisgv">ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidanatloyiga">ᏱᏓᎾᏠᏱᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udesvnilvhi">ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneladidohvi">ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏙᎲᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvliyiloli">ᏛᎵᏱᎶᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagetsiyanveli">ᏓᎨᏥᏯᏅᎡᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udesvnilvhi">ᎤᏕᏒᏂᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gila">ᎩᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvnvni">ᏛᏅᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalastlvdisgo">ᏱᎦᎳᏍᏢᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uweti">ᎤᏪᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anuwogihi">ᎠᏄᏬᎩᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galastlvdvyeno">ᎦᎳᏍᏢᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgatsagalvda">ᏴᎦᏣᎦᎸᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anuwo">ᎠᏄᏬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udatsagalvhvno">ᎤᏓᏣᎦᎸᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:equohiyu">ᎡᏉᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigalisda">ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigage-aditasdi">ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuweti">ᏧᏪᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disutlvdv">ᏗᏑᏢᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidanitlisdisgoi">ᏱᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:disutlvdvyeno">ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidadatsagalv">ᏱᏓᏓᏣᎦᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigage-aditasdi">ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatsewogi">ᏯᏤᏬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:disutlvdvno">ᏗᏑᏢᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidayogi">ᏱᏓᏲᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Itsesgini">ᎢᏤᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigage-aditasdi">ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditse">ᏗᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disutlvdv">ᏗᏑᏢᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danitlisdisgoi">ᏓᏂᏟᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsulano">ᎢᏧᎳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunisquanigodoi">ᏚᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidegawesehvgi">ᏂᏕᎦᏪᏎᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusadegi">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdanelvgi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyutsa">ᎠᎨᏳᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayula">ᎦᏳᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusidena">ᎤᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hena">ᎮᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiyasvnilvha">ᎯᏯᏒᏂᎸᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aha">ᎠᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvadvnidiquo">ᏛᎠᏛᏂᏗᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulenv">ᏚᎴᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdawadvsvgi">ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvgi">ᎤᏢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigv">ᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvehi">ᎤᏪᏅᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudetiyvda">ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwalistanvhi">ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:oniditlv">ᎣᏂᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdanelvgi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadaluyadv">ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unuwav">ᎤᏄᏩᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usvnelvgi">ᎤᏒᏁᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:21

verses.name: Matthew 9:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugatahvsv">ᎤᎦᏔᎲᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugohv">ᎤᎪᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugalisdiquo">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hadanvdada">ᎭᏓᏅᏓᏓ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsohiyusv">ᏦᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadiwisda">ᏣᏗᏫᏍᏓ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ageyvno">ᎠᎨᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyuquo">ᎾᎯᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiwasvgi">ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itsadanvna">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nagono">ᎾᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyutsa">ᎠᎨᏳᏣ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:galihaquosgini">ᎦᎵᎭᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vgvwayetsastanvquono">ᎥᎬᏩᏰᏣᏍᏔᏅᏉᏃ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Getsinugowisvno">ᎨᏥᏄᎪᏫᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyvlvgi">ᎤᏴᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvhvgi">ᎤᏂᏴᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ageyutsano">ᎠᎨᏳᏣᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulenvgi">ᏚᎴᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunotsalotsidolvi">ᏚᏃᏣᎶᏥᏙᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanigvnadv">ᎾᎿᎭᏂᎬᎾᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyelisidolvgi">ᏚᏰᎵᏏᏙᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haudanvsv">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigewi">ᏗᏂᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadvsvgi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unelugvgi">ᎤᏁᎷᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniwesgvgi">ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:sginidoligi">ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galitsodeno">ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvlv">ᎤᏴᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dinigewi">ᏗᏂᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Isdohiyuhvsgasgo">ᎢᏍᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvquadvnedi">ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 9:32

verses.name: Matthew 9:33

verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 10</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10"/><w xlit="Seq:Widuyanvhvno">ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dunelv">ᏚᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninugowisdiyi">ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadanvwodiyi">ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunitlvgv">ᏚᏂᏢᎬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vyugi">ᎥᏳᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 10:2

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunasdi">ᏧᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisquidiquo">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:akalii">ᎠᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvdladaama">ᎤᏴᏜᏓᎠᎹ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahuvsgesdi">ᎠᎱᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisdawadidohi">ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgesdi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusedi">ᎤᏲᎱᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agaguyvedi">ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.10"/>

verses.name: Matthew 11:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 11</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11"/><w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquadv">ᎤᏍᏆᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dekanetsehv">ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unigisvgi">ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hani">ᎾᎿᎭᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dudeyousvgi">ᏚᏕᏲᎤᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulitsidonvsvgi">ᎤᎵᏥᏙᏅᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniduhna·havi">ᏚᏂᏚᎿᎭᎥᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsisduhv">ᏣᏥᏍᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudvganv">ᏧᏛᎦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehv">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dotsunvse">ᏙᏧᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 11:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayuweselvgi">ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgo">ᏂᎯᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigoge">ᏥᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsigatenohesdi">ᎣᏥᎦᏖᏃᎮᏍᏗ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 11:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsisdena">ᏥᏍᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wiesdinohvsi">ᏫᎡᏍᏗᏃᎲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isdadvgisgvi">ᎢᏍᏓᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isdigowatisgvi">ᎢᏍᏗᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ</w>:

verses.name: Matthew 11:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dinigewi">ᏗᏂᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigowatiha">ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:diniyoulino">ᏗᏂᏲᎤᎵᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anedoha">ᎠᏁᏙᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adayesgi">ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunitlvgi">ᏧᏂᏢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadiwasga">ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsunilienano">ᏧᏂᎵᎡᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadvgiha">ᎠᎾᏛᎩᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhino">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegalediha">ᏕᎨᎦᎴᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyono">ᎤᏲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvhna·hadegi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igegalitsidoneha">ᎢᎨᎦᎵᏥᏙᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:giloniditsiyodesdisgvna">ᎩᎶᏂᏗᏥᏲᏕᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iunenvno">ᎢᎤᏁᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulenvhvgi">ᎤᎴᏅᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunohedanelvgi">ᏚᏃᎮᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsagatanvse">ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inagei">ᎢᎾᎨᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Wasonasgo">ᏩᏐᎾᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unole">ᎤᏃᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utelvhesgvi">ᎤᏖᎸᎮᏍᎬᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 11:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsagatanvsei">ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Asgayasgo">ᎠᏍᎦᏯᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diwanage">ᏗᏩᎾᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunuwai">ᏧᏄᏩᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diwanage">ᏗᏩᎾᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanuwai">ᏧᎾᏄᏩᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigvwiyuhi">ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninelv">ᏓᏂᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehoi">ᎠᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsagatanvsei">ᎢᏣᎦᏔᏅᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Adolehosgisgo">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩᏍᎪ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvyoseha">ᎢᏨᏲᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegowelv">ᎨᎪᏪᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinohelvsgv">ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsinvli">ᏥᏅᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinvsidasdi">ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsakadv">ᏣᎧᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiditlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsadvnvisdaneli">ᏓᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalohisdiyi">ᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiditlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Anigeyv">ᎠᏂᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwaninanugowisvhi">ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunanugotsv">ᏳᎾᏄᎪᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadalinehidedi">ᎬᏩᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didawosgi">ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdikani">ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodiyu">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsani">ᏣᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsanino">ᏣᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didawosgi">ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanugotsv">ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwadalenvdv">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyasti">ᎢᏯᏍᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ananelugieha">ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᎡᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ananelugisgino">ᎠᎾᏁᎷᎩᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvsgaisdagi">ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daniniyiha">ᏓᏂᏂᏱᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nanivyeno">ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgvgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanugotsilv">ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏥᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyasti">ᎢᏯᏍᏘ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsadanilvisdi">ᏗᎨᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ilaya">ᎢᎳᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesvgi">ᏥᎨᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degalilugesdi">ᏕᎦᎵᎷᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvgodiyi">ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advgisgesdi">ᎠᏛᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagatsiyatlilostani">ᏙᏓᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaneha">ᏣᏁᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Diniyoliquo">ᏗᏂᏲᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganododiyi">ᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaninoi">ᏣᏂᏃᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiwidaniyanisgo">ᏥᏫᏓᏂᏯᏂᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unedasdi">ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 11:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinidaniwesehoi">ᏥᏂᏓᏂᏪᏎᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:atselugi">ᎠᏤᎷᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogvtanv">ᎣᎬᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsvnogielv">ᏕᏨᏃᎩᎡᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsalisgisv">ᏱᏣᎵᏍᎩᏒ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dotsiyvgvgi">ᏙᏥᏴᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvgodi">ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsatloyilv">ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏱᎸ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsaniyeno">ᏣᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsvgi">ᎤᎷᏨᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yalisdayvhvsgei">ᏯᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎨᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaditasgei">ᏯᏗᏔᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nianiweha">ᏂᎠᏂᏪᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Asgina">ᎠᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyaa">ᎤᏯᎠ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 11:19

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Yitsigadovsesgini">ᏱᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadvgv">ᎦᏛᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigawea">ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquaduliha">ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelasdiyi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsvhi">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogetsiyelvne">ᏱᏙᎨᏥᏰᎸᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunisganvtsvna">ᏄᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Yvwiyeno">ᏴᏫᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgv">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hna·hano">ᎾᎿᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iudanvsv">ᎢᎤᏓᏅᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsunilawiisdiyi">ᏧᏂᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuyvlvgi">ᏭᏴᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edohvgi">ᎡᏙᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwaiselvhi">ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gvwadvdvnvgino">ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdanvwodi">ᎬᏓᏅᏬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgvi">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvwayilidasdiyi">ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadulisgvgi">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udasuya">ᎤᏓᏑᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unodena">ᎤᏃᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunatlaa">ᏳᎾᏝᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:atalesvno">ᎠᏔᎴᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yulvtsv">ᏳᎸᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgvi">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuniyvdi">ᏭᏂᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulesdi">ᏭᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 12:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigavsgini">ᏂᎦᎥᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodiyu">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unodena">ᎤᏃᏕᎾ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgv">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselv">ᏄᏪᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hadoyanvhida">ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏓ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:udoyanvhidvgino">ᎤᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛᎩᏃ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiwasvgi">ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soi">ᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:14

verses.name: Matthew 12:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haudanvsvgi">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:unitsatino">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadvsvgi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvwanvgi">ᏚᏅᏩᏅᎩ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 12:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvsdadelv">ᏚᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwanediyi">ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyudiyi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvsvgi">ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isaya">ᎢᏌᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetsei">ᏧᏁᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwesei">ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>;

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinvsidasdi">ᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyasuyedv">ᏥᏯᏑᏰᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeyui">ᏥᎨᏳᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquadanvdv">ᏗᏆᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyelvi">ᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:datsineli">ᏓᏥᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanugowisedi">ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:20

verses.name: Matthew 12:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatinohelvgi">ᎠᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgina">ᎠᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyai">ᎤᏯᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digewi">ᏗᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwagewi">ᎤᏩᎨᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvwanvgi">ᎤᏅᏩᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digewi">ᏗᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwagewi">ᎤᏩᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwonisvgi">ᎤᏬᏂᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugohvgi">ᎤᎪᎲᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:23

verses.name: Matthew 12:24

verses.name: Matthew 12:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahv">ᎠᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvsvi">ᎪᏢᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinadadisgo">ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadatludisgo">ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayogoquo">ᎠᏲᎪᏉ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaduhv">ᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanelv">ᎠᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinadadisgo">ᏥᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadatludisgo">ᏣᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigvwasdoquo">ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏙᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sedani">ᏎᏓᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sedani">ᏎᏓᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiganugowisga">ᏱᎦᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadadisgoi">ᎾᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adatludisgoi">ᎠᏓᏡᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdoda">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigvwasdiquo">ᏱᏂᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 12:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quelitsiqua">ᏇᎵᏥᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagisdeli">ᏯᎩᏍᏕᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsinugowisga">ᏱᏗᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisdelisgo">ᎤᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsetsi">ᏗᏤᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidaninugowisgoi">ᏥᏓᏂᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsugodanehi">ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:28

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iegoi">ᎢᎡᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widayanisgo">ᏫᏓᏯᏂᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwanadale">ᎤᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galiquogi">ᎦᎵᏉᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgina">ᎠᏂᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuninegutsidv">ᎢᏳᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hano">ᎾᎿᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyvhihoi">ᎠᏂᏴᎯᎰᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ananeladisgoi">ᎠᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:onino">ᎣᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyi">ᎢᎬᏱᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunasdesdi">ᏄᎾᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninegutsidv">ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaneha">ᏣᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:46
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degawonedisgv">ᏕᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsi">ᎤᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analinvtli">ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:doyitlv">ᏙᏱᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonavgi">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unadulisgvgi">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalinohedodiyi">ᎬᏩᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:47
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsi">ᏣᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalinvtli">ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:doyi">ᏙᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonaa">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsalinohedodiyi">ᎨᏣᎵᏃᎮᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unaduliha">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:48
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unetsvno">ᎤᏁᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselv">ᏄᏪᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unonelvhi">ᎤᏃᏁᎸᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsi">ᎡᏥ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalinvtli">ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 12:49
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Widusonvno">ᏫᏚᏐᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsi">ᎡᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalinvtli">ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 12:50
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvnehesdi">ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulisgv">ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginvtli">ᎥᎩᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgido">ᎥᎩᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsi">ᎡᏥ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.12"/>

verses.name: Matthew 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv13"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 13</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv13"/><w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugotsvgi">ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanelvi">ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdalulodi">ᎥᏓᎷᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvgi">ᎤᏪᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unitsatino">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadatluwistanvgi">ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuhi">ᏥᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsanvgi">ᎤᏣᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvgi">ᎤᏪᏅᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nigadiyuno">ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amayulodi">ᎠᎹᏳᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonavgi">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎥᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Deuwonetanvno">ᏕᎤᏬᏁᏔᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dutlilosdanelvgi">ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:awisgi">ᎠᏫᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwisvsei">ᎤᏫᏒᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uwisvno">ᎤᏫᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvnohulodi">ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulageyadvtsei">ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsisquano">ᏥᏍᏆᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutse">ᎤᏂᎷᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unutisonei">ᎤᏄᏘᏐᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igadvno">ᎢᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvyohi">ᏅᏲᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulageyadvtsei">ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gayoli">ᎦᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gada">ᎦᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galageyvi">ᎦᎳᎨᏴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uliyenei">ᎤᎵᏰᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisge">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sageiyu">ᏌᎨᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gada">ᎦᏓ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdo">ᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsukalvtsv">ᏧᎧᎸᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uleyvsei">ᎤᎴᏴᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:niduhna·hasdetlvnano">ᏂᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhna·hasgvtsequo">ᎤᎿᎭᏍᎬᏤᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igadvno">ᎢᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anugalvhi">ᎠᏄᎦᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulageyadvtsei">ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anugalvno">ᎠᏄᎦᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudvsv">ᏧᏛᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unenulastanei">ᎤᏁᏄᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igadvsgini">ᎢᎦᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osv">ᎣᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadohi">ᎦᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulageyadvtsei">ᎤᎳᎨᏯᏛᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugatatanei">ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgohitsuqui">ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unequotsei">ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igadvno">ᎢᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sudalasgohi">ᏑᏓᎳᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unequotsei">ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igadvno">ᎢᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoasgohi">ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unequotsei">ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degalugesdi">ᏕᎦᎷᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvgodiyi">ᎤᏛᎪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wadvgvga">ᏩᏛᎬᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselv">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dehiwonedisgv">ᏕᎯᏬᏁᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidehatlilosdaneha">ᏥᏕᎭᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 13:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unetsvno">ᎤᏁᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nvdigalisdodisgini">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinelvhi">ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsolisdiyi">ᎢᏦᎵᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugv">ᎤᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wiyuhi">ᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na-sgini">Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegalisgolvdanelvhi">ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhesdi">ᎤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinedi">ᎠᏥᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatino">ᎤᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhesdi">ᎤᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuhvna">ᏄᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsigiediquo">ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhvi">ᎤᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidegatsiyatlilosdaneha">ᏥᏕᎦᏥᏯᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anigowatisgvyeno">ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinadvgiha">ᏱᎾᏛᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinoliga">ᏱᏃᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 13:14

verses.name: Matthew 14:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsaisv">ᎤᏣᎢᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dugohvgi">ᏚᎪᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwedolitsvgi">ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvwanvtsunitlvgi">ᏚᏅᏩᏅᏧᏂᏢᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Usvno">ᎤᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanv">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inagequo">ᎢᎾᎨᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosonidi">ᎤᎶᏐᏂᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsitsenaquono">ᏥᏤᎾᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:giyosi">ᎩᏲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodigaduhv">ᏙᏗᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wianilohi">ᏫᎠᏂᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haunvsv">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisdayvdi">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwasvha">ᎤᏂᏩᏒᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vunenvsdi">ᎥᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihiquo">ᏂᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditselasda">ᏗᏤᎳᏍᏓ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgvwaweselvgi">ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgiquo">ᎯᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dogiha">ᏙᎩᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:taliquono">ᏔᎵᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsadi">ᎠᏣᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disgiyohisi">ᏗᏍᎩᏲᎯᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dunetselvno">ᏚᏁᏤᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanesgohi">ᎧᏁᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanvdiyi">ᎤᎾᏅᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dugisvno">ᏚᎩᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsadi">ᎠᏣᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunesv">ᏚᏁᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvladino">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widukananv">ᏫᏚᎧᎾᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulihelitsvgi">ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dugvhaluyv">ᏚᎬᎭᎷᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunelvgi">ᏚᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuninelvgi">ᏫᏚᏂᏁᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadvno">ᏂᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisdayvnvgi">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunolvsvgi">ᏚᏃᎸᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unutisvgi">ᎤᏄᏘᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uligvhaluyvhi">ᎤᎵᎬᎭᎷᏴᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utiyvhi">ᎤᏘᏴᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyakalii">ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talutsa">ᏔᎷᏣ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unalisdayvnvhino">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgiha">ᎯᏍᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivgi">ᎾᏂᎥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nidanetlvdvna">ᏂᏓᏁᏢᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigeyv">ᎠᏂᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvwistanvgi">ᏚᏅᏫᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuhi">ᏥᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatsodiyi">ᎤᎾᏦᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidunisohisdiyi">ᏂᏚᏂᏐᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayelihisdisgv">ᏓᏰᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyelihistanv">ᏚᏰᎵᎯᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:odalv">ᎣᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhna·halusvgi">ᎤᎿᎭᎷᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udadolistanvsvgi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏒᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Usvno">ᎤᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanv">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hauwasvquo">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsiyuno">ᏥᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waninisvgi">ᏩᏂᏂᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utladistanidohv">ᎤᏝᏗᏍᏔᏂᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ama">ᎠᎹ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dalisdilanegvi">ᏓᎵᏍᏗᎳᏁᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unoleyeno">ᎤᏃᎴᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyitlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayugadvgi">ᏓᏳᎦᏛᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgine">ᏅᎩᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadanetliyvdv">ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyawisgi">ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svnoyi">ᏒᏃᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widulutselvgi">ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadui">ᎦᏚᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aisvgi">ᎠᎢᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagohv">ᎬᏩᎪᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadugi">ᎦᏚᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aisvi">ᎠᎢᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvtetanvgi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nayehi">ᎾᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Anisgaihvno">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎢᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalistanvgi">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilaquo">ᎩᎳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunetselvgi">ᏚᏁᏤᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ugalisdiquo">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvdada">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvquoyeno">ᎠᏴᏉᏰᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsisgaihesdi">ᏱᏥᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Quidano">ᏈᏓᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:sginetsi">ᏍᎩᏁᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigvlutsediyi">ᏫᎬᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amayi">ᎠᎹᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadui">ᎦᏚᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ehena">ᎡᎮᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnvgi">ᎤᏛᏅᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuhi">ᏥᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsaisv">ᎤᏣᎢᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amayi">ᎠᎹᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadui">ᎦᏚᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aisvgi">ᎠᎢᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsedohv">ᏤᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wagadvgi">ᏩᎦᏛᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdolehosv">ᏅᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdayiyu">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganolvvsgv">ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usgalvgi">ᎤᏍᎦᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulenvhv">ᎤᎴᏅᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganoyvgv">ᎦᏃᏴᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwelunvgi">ᎤᏪᎷᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgisdelv">ᏍᎩᏍᏕᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnvgi">ᎤᏛᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wudoyanvhidv">ᏭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuniyvhvgi">ᏭᏂᏴᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsohiyuhi">ᏦᎯᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadohi">ᎦᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtsadladasidvsi">ᎥᏣᏜᏓᏏᏛᏏ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 14:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsiyuhino">ᏥᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iunatsanv">ᎢᎤᎾᏣᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganolvvsgv">ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usuligotsvgi">ᎤᏑᎵᎪᏨᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyuhi">ᏥᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatsai">ᎤᎾᏣᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsv">ᎤᏂᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadadolisdanelvgi">ᎬᏩᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunisotsv">ᏚᏂᏐᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Genisiladi">ᎨᏂᏏᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsvgi">ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hna·hano">ᎾᎿᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwolitsv">ᎬᏬᎵᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwaduwidv">ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadanvsidolvgi">ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏏᏙᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:degvwatinohelvgi">ᏕᎬᏩᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunitlvgi">ᏧᏂᏢᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 14:36
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwatayoselvgino">ᎬᏩᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaluyadvquo">ᎦᏓᎷᏯᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unuwav">ᎤᏄᏩᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unasvnediyi">ᎤᎾᏒᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadvno">ᏂᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unasvnilvhi">ᎤᎾᏒᏂᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadiwasvgi">ᏚᎾᏗᏩᏒᎩ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.14"/>

verses.name: Matthew 15:1

verses.name: Matthew 15:7

verses.name: Matthew 15:14

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Sunaleno">ᏑᎾᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesoi">ᏥᎨᏐᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvgahna·hani">ᏛᎦᎿᎭᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvloyeno">ᎦᎸᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigageiyu">ᎩᎦᎨᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igalogiliyeha">ᎢᎦᎶᎩᎵᏰᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsadisgoi">ᎢᏣᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadolehosgo">ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvloi">ᎦᎸᎶᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlasgono">ᏝᏍᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsadolehohisdi">ᎨᏣᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdv">ᎤᏰᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:listanidasdi">ᎵᏍᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uniyo">ᎤᏂᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninegutsidv">ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏥᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaneha">ᏣᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyoho">ᎤᏂᏲᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdvi">ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgagegalisgolvdasi">ᏴᎦᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdvi">ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsona">ᏦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdv">ᎤᏰᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Dudanvelvno">ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigisvgi">ᎤᏂᎩᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunisotsv">ᏚᏂᏐᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvgewisvhi">ᎤᏅᎨᏫᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadenodiyi">ᎤᎾᏕᏃᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itseyatahesdi">ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agododi">ᎠᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anisadusi">ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:7

verses.name: Matthew 16:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyuhi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinoheha">ᎢᏥᏃᎮᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiyehvna">ᏂᏥᏰᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsoliga">ᏱᏦᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsanvta">ᏱᏣᏅᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinanivgi">ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyakalii">ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talutsa">ᏔᎷᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsutesvi">ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galiquogi">ᎦᎵᏉᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgino">ᏅᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinanivgi">ᏥᎾᏂᎥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyakalii">ᎢᏯᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talatsa">ᏔᎳᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsutesvi">ᎢᏧᏖᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalisdodi">ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsoligvna">ᏂᏦᎵᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsvwesi">ᏥᏂᏨᏪᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlasgini">ᏝᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsidvga">ᏱᏥᏛᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itseyatahesdi">ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agododi">ᎠᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anisadusi">ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsitsvyosi">ᏥᏨᏲᏏ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:12

verses.name: Matthew 16:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sisaliyi">ᏏᏌᎵᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Queligiyi">ᏇᎵᎩᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dudvdvnvgi">ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvquoseho">ᎬᏉᏎᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 16:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didawosgi">ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:getsosehoi">ᎨᏦᏎᎰᎢ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:igadvno">ᎢᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ilaya">ᎢᎳᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anisoino">ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tselimaya">ᏤᎵᎹᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:15

verses.name: Matthew 16:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Sawanino">ᏌᏩᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sawani">ᏌᏩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsona">ᏦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigv">ᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsananugowiselv">ᏱᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Edodasgini">ᎡᏙᏓᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 16:20

verses.name: Matthew 16:21
