verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ilaya">ᎢᎳᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwotlvhisodi">ᎤᏬᏢᎯᏐᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ilaya">ᎢᎳᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayula">ᎦᏳᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvwolitsoi">ᏱᎬᏬᎵᏦᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadulisgvi">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwanelv">ᏂᎬᏩᏁᎸ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasquosgini">ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwaneli">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏁᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unolitse">ᎤᏃᎵᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Didawosgi">ᏗᏓᏬᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdisgvi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anedohv">ᎠᏁᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsv">ᎤᏂᎷᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulutselvgi">ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duliniquanvnelvgi">ᏚᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 17:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiyadoligi">ᎯᏯᏙᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsutsa">ᎠᏧᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvliyeno">ᎬᎵᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwahiha">ᎬᏩᎯᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliyoga">ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yanogiyuyeno">ᏯᏃᎩᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvyi">ᎠᏥᎸᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdvgoi">ᎬᏛᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amayi">ᎠᎹᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agvgoi">ᎠᎬᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gatsiyatinohelvgino">ᎦᏥᏯᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsasdawadidohi">ᎨᏣᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninulvnvgi">ᎤᏂᏄᎸᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninvwodiyi">ᎤᏂᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nitsohiyusvna">ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsagatahvdv">ᎢᏣᎦᏔᎲᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitseha">ᏥᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ilago">ᎢᎳᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilesdi">ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyeladidohesdi">ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ilago">ᎢᎳᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilesdi">ᏂᎪᎯᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyelisehesdi">ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Sgiyatinohisi">ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏃᎯᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgina">ᎠᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usgatsvgi">ᎤᏍᎦᏨᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asginano">ᎠᏍᎩᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugotsvgi">ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsutsa">ᎠᏧᏣ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyuquo">ᎾᎯᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiwasvgi">ᎤᏗᏩᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoginulvnvgi">ᏦᎩᏄᎸᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsinugowisdiyi">ᎣᏥᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗᏱ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 17:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsohiyusvna">ᏂᏦᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiyayeno">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsohiyuha">ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquo">ᎠᏥᎸᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugata">ᎤᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igidv">ᎢᎩᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsiwesi">ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsodalv">ᏦᏓᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hadanvna">ᎭᏓᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itlv">ᎢᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wilohi">ᏫᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aha">ᎠᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvsdi">ᎤᏓᏅᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigetsinulvhvsga">ᏱᎨᏥᏄᎸᎲᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiasgininonv">ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugoisdi">ᎤᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvdadolisdiha">ᏴᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagvsga">ᏯᎬᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asino">ᎠᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gelili">ᎨᎵᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anedohvi">ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagetsiyohiseli">ᏙᏓᎨᏥᏲᎯᏎᎵ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 17:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvwali">ᏓᎬᏩᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoine">ᏦᎢᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvaleni">ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Utsatanvhino">ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvnvgi">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gequanino">ᎨᏆᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsv">ᎤᏂᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigisidohi">ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutsele">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditseyohvsgi">ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaguyisgoi">ᏯᎫᏱᏍᎪᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 17:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Adanelvno">ᎠᏓᏁᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyosdodanelvgi">ᎤᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:heliha">ᎮᎵᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sawani">ᏌᏩᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanaguyveho">ᎬᏩᎾᎫᏴᎡᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigvwiyuhi">ᎤᏂᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsunetsisgo">ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎪ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadalege">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎨ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 17:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvwanadalei">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udadoselvgi">ᎤᏓᏙᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsunetsisginigeno">ᏧᏁᏥᏍᎩᏂᎨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagiquo">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 17:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinihna·halvdosdiyi">ᏗᏂᎿᎭᎸᏙᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vdali">ᎥᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hena">ᎮᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asudino">ᎠᏑᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsadaesvha">ᏫᏣᏓᎡᏒᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyino">ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiyvgidv">ᎯᏴᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsadi">ᎠᏣᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hinesvha">ᎯᏁᏒᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisduisv">ᎯᏍᏚᎢᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aholi">ᎠᎰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli-adelv">ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tiwadvhi">ᏘᏩᏛᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higisvha">ᎯᎩᏒᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dehinelvha">ᏕᎯᏁᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ginaguyvdi">ᎩᎾᎫᏴᏗ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.17"/>

verses.name: Matthew 18:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv18"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 18</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv18"/><w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselv">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlia">ᎤᏟᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsilvquodiyu">ᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hagalvladi">ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 18:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayoli">ᎠᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuyanvhv">ᏭᏯᏅᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninv">ᎠᏂᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwekanvgi">ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 18:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadanetliyvsvna">ᏂᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinunasdi">ᏥᏄᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsalistanvna">ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgetsiyvha">ᏴᎨᏥᏴᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 18:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayoli">ᎠᏲᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodiyu">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hagalvladi">ᎾᎿᎭᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 18:5

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:saquoquosgini">ᏌᏉᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniquedalvi">ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwudatanvhi">ᏧᏭᏓᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidugalenvtanesdi">ᏱᏚᎦᎴᏅᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgvwaweselvgi">ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yisi">ᏱᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetse">ᏧᏁᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goweli">ᎪᏪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvnediyi">ᎦᏅᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalenvdodi">ᏗᎦᎴᏅᏙᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agehidasdiyi">ᎠᎨᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 19:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:disdayiyu">ᏗᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinawi">ᏗᏥᎾᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Mosi">ᎼᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danigedohihesdi">ᏓᏂᎨᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalii">ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itseliselvgi">ᎢᏤᎵᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:didalenisgvsgini">ᏗᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdei">ᏱᏄᏍᏕᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iagehidohesdi">ᎢᎠᎨᎯᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunisinvhisgininonv">ᏧᏂᏏᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iadayegesdi">ᎢᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adayonehesdi">ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsigehidolvhi">ᎠᏥᎨᎯᏙᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adayegesdi">ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adayonehesdi">ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdi">ᏱᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danatsehvi">ᏓᎾᏤᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adesvhvsdiyi">ᎠᏕᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsi">ᏥᏂᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wi">Ꮻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogvnadanilvgi">ᏱᏙᎬᎾᏓᏂᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gegalisgolvdanelvhi">ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anehayeno">ᎠᏁᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninali">ᎠᏂᎾᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanasdo">ᏅᏩᎾᏍᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunitsi">ᏧᏂᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwaninanugowisv">ᎬᏩᏂᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aneha">ᎠᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninali">ᎠᏂᎾᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwaninalidvhi">ᎬᏩᏂᎾᎵᏛᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aneha">ᎠᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninali">ᎠᏂᎾᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanalidvhi">ᎤᎾᏓᎾᎵᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diliyeilvsdisgvi">ᏗᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwadanilvisdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadanilvgesdi">ᏓᏓᏂᎸᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatinohelvgi">ᏓᎦᏘᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunasdi">ᏧᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsusitadisdiyi">ᏧᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdodiyi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duninvsdadelvgi">ᏚᏂᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditselisi">ᏗᏤᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunasdi">ᏧᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinvsdadelvgi">ᏗᏥᏅᏍᏓᏕᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvgilutsediyi">ᎬᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunasdi">ᏄᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dusitadvno">ᏚᏏᏔᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haudanvsvgi">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutselvgi">ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hosdv">ᎰᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagadvneli">ᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiwadvdodi">ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winasdvna">ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 19:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hosdv">ᎰᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isquoseha">ᎢᏍᏉᏎᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvhiyu">ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadulisgesdi">ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsananugoisdiyi">ᏫᏣᎾᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tisquanigoda">ᏘᏍᏆᏂᎪᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweegi">ᏄᏪᎡᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadalvgi">ᏣᏓᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadayonelvgi">ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanosgisvgi">ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:danadayilidohv">ᏓᎾᏓᏱᎵᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanohelvgi">ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 19:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hilvquodesdi">ᎯᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadoda">ᏣᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsi">ᏣᏥ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadageyusv">ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigeyusesdi">ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdadala">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Awinv">ᎠᏫᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagikahna·hawadenv">ᏓᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsutsa">ᏥᏧᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwadalenvdv">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilula">ᎠᎩᎷᎳ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 19:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsasquadisdiyi">ᏣᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadulisgesdi">ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hena">ᎮᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:winaduga">ᏫᎾᏚᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsahna·havi">ᏣᎿᎭᎥᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tihvsi">ᏘᎲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvhna·hadegi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvladino">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsahesdi">ᏫᏣᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tesv">ᏖᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgisdawadesvha">ᏍᎩᏍᏓᏩᏕᏒᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awinv">ᎠᏫᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvganv">ᎤᏛᎦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvsvgi">ᎤᏓᏅᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvnvgi">ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatiyeno">ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwehna·haiyu">ᎤᏪᎿᎭᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 19:23

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gegaguyvelvno">ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᎸᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unigonelohiselequo">ᎤᏂᎪᏁᎶᎯᏎᎴᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganela">ᎦᏁᎳ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 20:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oniyi">ᎣᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsvhi">ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyutlilodv">ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilvwisdasi">ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsulahaquono">ᎢᏧᎳᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvsgiyvga">ᏅᏍᎩᏴᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagesv">ᎦᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udilegv">ᎤᏗᎴᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogilvwisdanelvhi">ᏦᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsele">ᎤᏁᏤᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ginalii">ᎩᎾᎵᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatini">ᎤᏣᏘᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigvyvneha">ᏱᏂᎬᏴᏁᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osi">ᎣᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsayelvne">ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisi">ᎠᎩᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvyaguyvediyi">ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 20:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Higi">ᎯᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatseliga">ᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsihena">ᏥᎮᎾ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Osi">ᎣᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelv">ᎠᎩᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyaguyvediyi">ᏥᏯᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oniyi">ᎣᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsvhi">ᎤᎷᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvyaguyvelv">ᎬᏯᎫᏴᎡᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadanvtesgv">ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseli">ᎠᏆᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higadoli">ᎯᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtiyu">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 20:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Howano">ᎰᏩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oniyi">ᎣᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igvyino">ᎢᎬᏱᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oniyi">ᎣᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Unitsatayeno">ᎤᏂᏣᏔᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyanvhv">ᎨᏥᏯᏅᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigayoliyu">ᎠᏂᎦᏲᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegasuyesv">ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsilusilimi">ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wagadvi">ᏩᎦᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadasdawadidohi">ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widutinvstanvgi">ᏫᏚᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 20:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsilusilimi">ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widigati">ᏫᏗᎦᏘ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodayetsiyosi">ᏙᏓᏰᏥᏲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagetsoyohiseli">ᏙᏓᎨᏦᏲᎯᏎᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinowelisgi">ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvnugolani">ᏙᏛᏄᎪᎳᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohuhisdiyi">ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 20:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gunasilenvdv">ᎫᎾᏏᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvniyohiseli">ᏙᏛᏂᏲᎯᏎᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwetlvnanediyi">ᎤᏂᏪᏢᎾᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilivnisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎵᎥᏂᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadvdiyi">ᎤᎾᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudahna·hawadv">ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gedvi">ᎨᏛᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoine">ᏦᎢᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvaleni">ᏙᏛᎠᎴᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutselvgi">ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsequiti">ᏤᏈᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsi">ᎤᏂᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:datinehvgi">ᏓᏘᏁᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwinv">ᎠᏂᏫᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:eladi">ᎡᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvnvgi">ᎤᏓᏅᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahusdi">ᎠᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utayosehvgi">ᎤᏔᏲᏎᎲᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaduliha">ᏣᏚᎵᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayuweselvgi">ᏅᏓᏳᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Halisgolvda">ᎭᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquetsi">ᏗᏇᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunidiyi">ᏧᏂᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatseligohi">ᏣᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higatisi">ᎯᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:soino">ᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higasgani">ᎯᎦᏍᎦᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsitayohihvi">ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsaditasdi">ᎨᏣᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisquidi">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlisdv">ᎠᏟᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdagaditahi">ᏨᏓᎦᏗᏔᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:alesgo">ᎠᎴᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidetsawosda">ᏱᏕᏣᏬᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdayvquawostani">ᏨᏓᏴᏆᏬᏍᏔᏂ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unadvnvgi">ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseli">ᎠᏆᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisquidi">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlisdv">ᎠᏟᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsaditahi">ᏓᏣᏗᏔᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquawosdodi">ᎥᏆᏬᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodayetsawostani">ᏙᏓᏰᏣᏬᏍᏔᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsigatisisgini">ᏥᎦᏘᏏᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigasgani">ᏥᎦᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwediyi">ᎤᏪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanedi">ᎠᏆᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsinedisgininonv">ᎨᏥᏁᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudanelanelvhi">ᏧᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asgohino">ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadvganv">ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitalawosvgi">ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniniquatilv">ᏚᏂᏂᏆᏘᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadanvtli">ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuyanvhv">ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itsigataha">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degotlvwadisv">ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusadegi">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninego">ᎠᏂᏁᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvnelidasdiyi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsilvquodi">ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninetsidohv">ᎠᏂᏁᏥᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanadvnehoi">ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsvnesdi">ᏱᏂᏨᏁᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodi">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulisgesdi">ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinvsidasdi">ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulisgesdi">ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinatlai">ᎡᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyaquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvsidasdiyi">ᎤᏓᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuyolilvna">ᏄᏲᎵᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:atsinvsidasdiyiquosgini">ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnvi">ᎬᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgolvdodiyi">ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diguyvdodi">ᏗᎫᏴᏙᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tseligono">ᏤᎵᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanigisv">ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadvsvgi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquono">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigewi">ᏗᏂᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohulodi">ᎤᏃᎱᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunolvgi">ᏚᏃᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unadvganvno">ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvi">ᎤᎶᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelunvgi">ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sginidoligi">ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unitsatino">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duninetselvgi">ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elaweyi">ᎡᎳᏪᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvdiyi">ᎤᏅᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utliquo">ᎤᏟᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelunvgi">ᎤᏁᎷᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sginidoligi">ᏍᎩᏂᏙᎵᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 20:33

verses.name: Matthew 20:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwedolitsv">ᏚᏪᏙᎵᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigadoli">ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusvnelvgi">ᏚᏒᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanigowadvdi">ᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadvsvgi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.20"/>

verses.name: Matthew 21:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isdoselvha">ᎢᏍᏙᏎᎸᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nesdiweselvha">ᏁᏍᏗᏪᏎᎸᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duduliha">ᏚᏚᎵᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodayuyosi">ᏙᏓᏳᏲᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:6

verses.name: Matthew 21:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hadvgisgo">ᎭᏛᎩᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinaniweha">ᏥᎾᏂᏪᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hilvhiyu">ᎯᎸᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigoliyeoi">ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsunasdi">ᏧᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisdai">ᏗᏂᏍᏓᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniholi">ᎠᏂᎰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugotsvhi">ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsawadvdotanv">ᏣᏩᏛᏙᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsalvquododiyi">ᎡᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 21:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dudanvelvgino">ᏚᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaduhv">ᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugotsvgi">ᎤᏄᎪᏨᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Quediniyi">ᏇᏗᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutsvgi">ᏭᎷᏨᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hausvlvgi">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏒᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Sunaleno">ᏑᎾᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digaduhv">ᏗᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvagadvi">ᏮᎠᎦᏛᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agonu">ᎠᎪᏄ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyosisanvgi">ᎤᏲᏏᏌᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugohvno">ᎤᎪᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgata-iyusdi">ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvnohulodi">ᏅᏃᎱᎶᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hawulutsvgi">ᎾᎿᎭᏭᎷᏨᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuwadvhei">ᏳᏩᏛᎮᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulasdusv">ᎤᎳᏍᏚᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhiyu">ᎢᎸᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalenvdv">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadatanesdi">ᏱᏣᏓᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgata-iyusdi">ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwayvsvgi">ᎤᏩᏴᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigohv">ᎤᏂᎪᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisquanigosvgi">ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Natlegvquo">ᎾᏞᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvyvhi">ᎬᏴᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgata-iyusdi">ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugvi">ᏡᎬᎢ</w>!

verses.name: Matthew 21:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsohiyuha">ᏱᏦᎯᏳᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadladasidvehvna">ᏂᏣᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiaquo">ᎯᎠᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgata-iyusdi">ᏒᎦᏔ-ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinagvga">ᏥᎾᎬᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgetsadvga">ᏱᏅᎨᏣᏛᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquosgini">ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsiweselv">ᏱᏂᏥᏪᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsodalv">ᏦᏓᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Hadanvna">ᎭᏓᏅᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amequohi">ᎠᎺᏉᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wetsaduga">ᏪᏣᏚᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigavno">ᏂᎦᎥᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsitayohihesdi">ᎢᏥᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolisdisgvi">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyuhvsgesdi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsiwatisgesdi">ᎢᏥᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udvnano">ᎤᏛᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalawiisdiyi">ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadvsonvhi">ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehv">ᎠᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadeyohvsgvi">ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalisgasdodi">ᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidetsalvwisdaneha">ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanetselvhi">ᏣᏁᏤᎸᎯ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 21:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sudalegi">ᏑᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsvyadvdvni">ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isginonelv">ᎢᏍᎩᏃᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsvnoneli">ᏓᏨᏃᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualisgasdodvi">ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidagilvwisdaneha">ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidadawosgvgi">ᏥᏓᏓᏬᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenei">ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Galvladisgo">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏍᎪ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yvwiquoge">ᏴᏫᏉᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehv">ᎠᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenei">ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Elaweyino">ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvtelvgi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniwesgvgi">ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎬᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yogadvnv">ᏲᎦᏛᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yietsoiyunei">ᏱᎡᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Yogosi">ᏲᎪᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwiquo">ᏴᏫᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehv">ᎠᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenei">ᏧᏓᎴᏁᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yogadvnv">ᏲᎦᏛᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dotsisgaihaquo">ᏙᏥᏍᎦᎢᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigadvyeno">ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvha">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uninetsvno">ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgvwaweselv">ᏅᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsigataha">ᏲᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgetsvnohvsi">ᏴᎨᏨᏃᎲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualisgasdodvi">ᎠᏆᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidagilvwisdaneha">ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseliha">ᎢᏤᎵᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehei">ᎠᏁᎮᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwino">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutselv">ᏭᎷᏤᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hena">ᎮᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widitsalvwisdasi">ᏫᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:telvladi">ᏖᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagiwisvi">ᏓᎩᏫᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsunetsvno">ᏧᏁᏨᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oni">ᎣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetliyvse">ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdvi">ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvsei">ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Soino">ᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutselv">ᏭᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsunetsvno">ᏧᏁᏨᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dagesi">ᏓᎨᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwenvsvnaquo">ᏄᏪᏅᏒᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesei">ᎢᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udoda">ᎤᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnelei">ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulutselvhi">ᏭᎷᏤᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vgvwoselvgi">ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigisidohi">ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatsesati">ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigeyv">ᎠᏂᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waniyvhiha">ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degetsigoniha">ᏕᎨᏥᎪᏂᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 21:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsaniyeno">ᏣᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehv">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsilutselvgi">ᎢᏥᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yetsoiyunei">ᏰᏦᎢᏳᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adelvsgini">ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigisidohi">ᎠᏂᎩᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigeyv">ᎠᏂᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatsesati">ᏧᎾᏤᏌᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvwohiyunvgi">ᏥᎬᏬᎯᏳᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadolehosv">ᎢᏣᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oni">ᎣᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsinetliyvse">ᏱᏗᏥᏁᏟᏴᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvdv">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsoiyudiyi">ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anisoino">ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniniyvhe">ᏚᏂᏂᏴᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanisotlvtanei">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏔᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilei">ᏚᏂᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvganv">ᎤᏛᎦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utalawosei">ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvse">ᏚᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyawisgi">ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widunile">ᏫᏚᏂᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalvhi">ᏧᎾᏓᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunagohvstane">ᏭᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniduhvi">ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwesele">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:digegatsvsdodiyi">ᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advnvisdi">ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigetsiyanvdv">ᏫᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinanose">ᏱᎾᏃᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniluhisyi">ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deganvhna·hawadisv">ᏕᎦᏅᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsilohi">ᏫᏥᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nanivno">ᎾᏂᎥᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsiwatisgesdi">ᏕᏥᏩᏘᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetsehesdi">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniluhisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodigegatsvstanisvi">ᏙᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏔᏂᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Howano">ᎰᏩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deganvhna·hawadisv">ᏕᎦᏅᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunilosei">ᏭᏂᎶᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitlisane">ᎤᏂᏟᏌᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniwadvhv">ᏚᏂᏩᏛᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyo">ᎤᏂᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anosdv">ᎠᏃᏍᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodigegatsvstanisv">ᏙᏗᎨᎦᏨᏍᏔᏂᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanile">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏂᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analisdayvhvsgi">ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvlv">ᎤᏴᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dugatanilv">ᏚᎦᏔᏂᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analisdayvhvsgi">ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugohe">ᎤᎪᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haasiyvwi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunuwavna">ᏄᏄᏩᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gese">ᎨᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegatsvsdisgv">ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anuwosdi">ᎠᏄᏬᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ginalii">ᎩᎾᎵᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vhiyvliga">ᎥᎯᏴᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsanuwavna">ᏂᏣᏄᏩᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegatsvsdisgv">ᏕᎨᎦᏨᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anuwosdi">ᎠᏄᏬᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Elaweyiquono">ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwesele">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidasdi">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Etsalvtsa">ᎡᏣᎸᏣ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwoyeni">ᏧᏬᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulasideni">ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinawidv">ᎡᏥᎾᏫᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vdoyiditlv">ᎥᏙᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulisigv">ᏧᎵᏏᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wetsadauga">ᏪᏣᏓᎤᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Na·hna·hadaniyvgesdi">ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danilvdagisgesdi">ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninudogvi">ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unitsatiyeno">ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyanvdv">ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigiyoliyu">ᎠᏂᎩᏲᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegasuyedv">ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unenvsvgi">ᎤᏁᏅᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuninohelvgi">ᏭᏂᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvnediyi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisadvdiyi">ᎤᏂᏌᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gawonisgvi">ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Duninvsvgino">ᏚᏂᏅᏒᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsedohv">ᏤᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanisdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏂᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Elodv">ᎡᎶᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdelisgi">ᎬᏩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:otsigataha">ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyugiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dehadeyohvsgvi">ᏕᎭᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitinayesga">ᏱᏘᎾᏰᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunasdvquo">ᏄᎾᏍᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitilvquodoi">ᏱᏘᎸᏉᏙᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sginohvsi">ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:heliha">ᎮᎵᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodi">ᏚᏳᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sisa">ᏏᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvediyi">ᎠᎫᏴᎡᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvdi">ᎠᎫᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tlage">ᏝᎨ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosvgi">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoquo">ᎤᏲᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isgisadvvsga">ᎢᏍᎩᏌᏛᎥᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigowadv">ᏥᎪᏩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvdodi">ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Agisino">ᎠᎩᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayohelvgi">ᎬᏩᏲᎮᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwehalvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᎭᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatlilosdi">ᏓᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinoheha">ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Sisa">ᏏᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unadvnvgi">ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sisa">ᏏᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsihvsi">ᎡᏥᎲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sisa">ᏏᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhino">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unadvganvno">ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisquanigosvgi">ᎤᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvelvgi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎡᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anisadusi">ᎠᏂᏌᏚᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilehisodi">ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadladasidvehi">ᎤᎾᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselvgi">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadvdvnvgi">ᎬᏩᏛᏛᏅᎩ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 22:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Mosi">ᎼᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetse">ᎤᏁᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohusgesdi">ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanehvna">ᎾᏁᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dinadanvtli">ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adayegesdi">ᎠᏓᏰᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udayvdv">ᎤᏓᏴᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadvhisdanehesdi">ᏓᏛᎯᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyoli">ᏗᏂᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadanvtli">ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsehv">ᎣᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehvgi">ᎠᏁᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galiquogi">ᎦᎵᏉᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtli">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏟ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:udaniligeno">ᎤᏓᏂᎵᎨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udesvnv">ᎤᏕᏒᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvquo">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsino">ᏧᏪᏥᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanehvna">ᎾᏁᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwegodanelv">ᎤᏪᎪᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvtli">ᎤᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talinei">ᏔᎵᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoinei">ᏦᎢᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galiquogine">ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigvdisgi">ᏫᎬᏗᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ulisqualvdino">ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvgi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danalehisanvha">ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galiquogi">ᎦᎵᏉᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itsilidasdiha">ᎢᏥᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsigatavna">ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelvi">ᎪᏪᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulinigvgv">ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsuniyohusvhiyeno">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danalehisanvha">ᏓᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidanadesvhvsgoi">ᏱᏓᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidigetsiyegoi">ᏱᏗᎨᏥᏰᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohisgini">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:31

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Esigi">ᎡᏏᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsegaqui">ᏤᎦᏈ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseli">ᎤᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dinvnodvquosgini">ᏗᏅᏃᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:33

verses.name: Matthew 22:34

verses.name: Matthew 22:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiyvwino">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haudasuyvgi">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏓᏑᏴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digosisisgi">ᏗᎪᏏᏏᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvdvnvgi">ᎤᏛᏛᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usadvvsgvi">ᎤᏌᏛᎥᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 22:36
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:37
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsanelanvhi">ᏣᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higeyusesdi">ᎯᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanawi">ᏣᎾᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hvdisgesdi">ᎲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadanvdo">ᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadanvtediyi">ᏣᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:38
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyi">ᎢᎬᏱᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodi">ᎦᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:39
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Talineno">ᏔᎵᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyaquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsadageyusv">ᏥᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigeyusesdi">ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdadala">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:41
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danilawiv">ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudvdvnvgi">ᏚᏛᏛᏅᎩ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 22:42
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseli">ᎢᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsadanvtesgv">ᎡᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vgvwoselvgi">ᎥᎬᏬᏎᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 22:43
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalisdodiha">ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uweyohvsgvi">ᎤᏪᏲᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigoseha">ᏥᎪᏎᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigaweha">ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 22:44
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseliga">ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsigatisi">ᏥᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsolesdi">ᏦᎴᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsasgagi">ᎨᏣᏍᎦᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalasidiyi">ᏗᏣᎳᏏᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gasgilo">ᎦᏍᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigatsiyvnelvha">ᏂᎦᏥᏴᏁᎸᎭ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 22:45
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yigoseha">ᏱᎪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdoda">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 22:46
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sganetsvhi">ᏍᎦᏁᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanetsedi">ᎬᏩᏁᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalenvdv">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagvwadvdvdi">ᎦᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.22"/>

verses.name: Matthew 23:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv23"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 23</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv23"/><w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwonetanvgi">ᏚᏬᏁᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 23:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dinowelisgi">ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Mosi">ᎼᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwesgilv">ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anina">ᎠᏂᎾ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 23:3

verses.name: Matthew 23:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Danadalitlvsgoyeno">ᏓᎾᏓᎵᏢᏍᎪᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digagedv">ᏗᎦᎨᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisvsdi">ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udeyadodi">ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisvsdiyi">ᏗᎵᏒᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninohatlahvsgoi">ᏓᏂᏃᎭᏝᎲᏍᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyesadv">ᎠᏂᏰᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvnvda">ᏴᎬᏅᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogvnitelvhvga">ᏱᏙᎬᏂᏖᎸᎲᎦ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilvquodo">ᎤᏂᎸᏉᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanitlvdiyi">ᏧᎾᏂᏢᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danalisdayvhvsgvi">ᏓᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degasgilv">ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalawiisdiyi">ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 23:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyolisdiyi">ᎨᏥᏲᎵᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diganododiyi">ᏗᎦᏃᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwanosediyi">ᎬᏩᏃᏎᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yetsosehesdi">ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwiyeno">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ditseyohvsgi">ᏗᏤᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigadvno">ᏂᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalinvtliquo">ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟᏉ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsoselvgi">ᎡᏦᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwiquoyeno">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsidoda">ᎢᏥᏙᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvtseha">ᏨᏤᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Squatinidohi">ᏍᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yetsosehesdi">ᏰᏦᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwiquoyeno">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ditsatinidohi">ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodiyu">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinvsidasdi">ᎡᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iadasaladisgesdi">ᎢᎠᏓᏌᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:eladi">ᎡᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagvnedi">ᎢᏯᎬᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:eladi">ᎡᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadadvnehesdi">ᎾᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsisaladodi">ᎠᏥᏌᎳᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsowelisgi">ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsiqualisi">ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:detsisdunehoyeno">ᏕᏥᏍᏚᏁᎰᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsiyvhihoi">ᏱᏥᏴᎯᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waniyvha">ᏩᏂᏴᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditseliseho">ᏱᏗᏤᎵᏎᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waniyvhihi">ᏩᏂᏴᎯᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsowelisgi">ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsiqualisi">ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:detsisvnehoyeno">ᏕᏥᏒᏁᎰᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunosulotsvhi">ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninelvi">ᏓᏂᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdv">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohidiyu">ᎪᎯᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolisdisgoi">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigiliyoisdi">ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsowelisgi">ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsiqualisi">ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:detsadeyohoyeno">ᏕᏣᏕᏲᎰᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amequohi">ᎠᎺᏉᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadohi">ᎦᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsiyoho">ᎡᏥᏲᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyusv">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgi">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyetsvnediyi">ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsvga">ᏁᏨᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwagudi">ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvsginoi">ᏨᏍᎩᏃᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsvneho">ᏁᏨᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ditsigewi">ᏗᏥᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadatinidohi">ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiwesgi">ᎢᏥᏪᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iaselidvsgesdi">ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvnv-digalawiisdiyi">ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dalonige">ᏓᎶᏂᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvna-digalawiisdiyi">ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahvi">ᎠᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdayiyu">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududala">ᎤᏚᏓᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsinegu">ᎢᏥᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsigewi">ᏗᏥᎨᏫ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adelvsgo">ᎠᏕᎸᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dalonigei">ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvna-digalawiisdiyige">ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvneha">ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dalonigei">ᏓᎶᏂᎨᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 23:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelasdiyi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haahvi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdayiyu">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududala">ᎤᏚᏓᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsinegu">ᎢᏥᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsigewi">ᏗᏥᎨᏫ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhisgo">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯᏍᎪ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:atsilvge-gelasdiyi">ᎠᏥᎸᎨ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvneha">ᏥᏂᎬᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 23:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iaselidvsgesdi">ᎢᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvgelasdiyi">ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdisgesdi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haahvi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvnv-digalawiisdiyi">ᎤᏛᏅ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdisgesdi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haganela">ᎾᎿᎭᎦᏁᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikaneisdisgesdi">ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdisgesdi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwediyi">ᎤᏪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hauwoli">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏬᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsowelisgi">ᏗᏦᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsiqualisi">ᎢᏥᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlonasdi">ᎢᏣᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:asgohineyeno">ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏁᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaguyisgo">ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svtli">ᏒᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esv">ᎡᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gamini">ᎦᎻᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:detsinohiyasgono">ᏕᏥᏃᎯᏯᏍᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgedvya">ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏛᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdiyi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudiyi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsadvnelei">ᏱᏂᏣᏛᏁᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soi">ᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsinohiyvnaquo">ᏂᏥᏃᎯᏴᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ditsigewi">ᏗᏥᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadatinidohi">ᏗᏣᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:dosv">ᏙᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsihna·hasolvsdisgi">ᎢᏥᎿᎭᏐᎸᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gemilino">ᎨᎻᎵᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigisgi">ᎢᏥᎩᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 23:25
