verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiyvwino">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunelei">ᏚᏁᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:soino">ᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:soino">ᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwanadvnedi">ᎢᎬᏩᎾᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigisei">ᎤᏂᎩᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvse">ᎤᏪᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunotanei">ᏭᏃᏔᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hisgino">ᎯᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unequotselei">ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unequotselei">ᎤᏁᏉᏤᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Saquosgini">ᏌᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvsei">ᎤᏪᏅᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:wusgoha">ᏭᏍᎪᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadohi">ᎦᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuwasgalane">ᏫᏚᏩᏍᎦᎳᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlai">ᎤᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ilvhiyuno">ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutse">ᎤᎷᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidasdi">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninatlai">ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osdvno">ᎣᏍᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunvnelei">ᏄᏅᏁᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hisgino">ᎯᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsei">ᎤᎷᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyole">ᏚᏲᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sginatlai">ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:desgiyohiselvgi">ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadeyvli">ᎢᏯᏕᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotselv">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unatlaino">ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:hosdv">ᎰᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higaliya">ᎯᎦᎵᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanvsidasdi">ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnelv">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsalvwisdanelvi">ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagvwiyusadegi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvyvneli">ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiyvha">ᎯᏴᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdadisdiyi">ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanatlai">ᏣᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquono">ᎾᏍᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sginatlai">ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:desgiyohiselvgi">ᏕᏍᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotselv">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᎸ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unatlai">ᎤᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:hosdv">ᎰᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higaliya">ᎯᎦᎵᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanvsidasdi">ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnelv">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsalvwisdanelvi">ᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagvwiyusadegi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvyvneli">ᏅᏓᎬᏴᏁᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiyvha">ᎯᏴᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdadisdiyi">ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanatlai">ᏣᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsinelvhi">ᏣᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sginatlai">ᏍᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvgatahvgi">ᎬᎦᏔᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hisdayiyu">ᎯᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgudesgvi">ᎯᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanitsawisvna">ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏣᏫᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hutesgvi">ᎱᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanitsaleladvnvna">ᎾᎿᎭᏂᏣᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisgaihvi">ᏥᏍᎦᎢᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquenvsvgi">ᎠᏇᏅᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:widagvsgalanvgi">ᏫᏓᎬᏍᎦᎳᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadohi">ᎦᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatseliga">ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatseliga">ᏗᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unatlaino">ᎤᎾᏝᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsanegutsidv">ᏣᏁᎫᏥᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadanulvdi">ᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanvsidasdi">ᎡᏣᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:higatahvgi">ᎯᎦᏔᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisgudesgv">ᏥᏍᎫᏕᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanagiwisvna">ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎩᏫᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gutesgv">ᎫᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanagileladvnvna">ᎾᎿᎭᎾᎩᎴᎳᏛᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>!

verses.name: Matthew 25:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisquanigodisgiyi">ᏗᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiwidotsane">ᏱᏫᏙᏣᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquatseliga">ᏗᏆᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsilugi">ᏥᏥᎷᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidagigohe">ᏱᏓᎩᎪᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquatseli">ᏗᏆᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninequotsvhi">ᎤᏂᏁᏉᏨᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidoetsigisiquo">ᏥᏙᎡᏥᎩᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asgohino">ᎠᏍᎪᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuhi">ᏧᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsivsi">ᏤᏥᎥᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhesdi">ᎤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinedi">ᎠᏥᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatino">ᎤᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodesdi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuhvna">ᏄᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsigiediquo">ᎠᏥᎩᎡᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uhvi">ᎤᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdodi">ᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvsidasdi">ᎦᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:doyiditlv">ᏙᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulisigv">ᏧᎵᏏᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wetsadauga">ᏪᏣᏓᎤᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hadaniyvgesdi">ᎾᎿᎭᏓᏂᏴᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danilvdagisgesdi">ᏓᏂᎸᏓᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daninudogvi">ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galutsvha">ᎦᎷᏨᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unuwosdesdi">ᎤᏄᏬᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsilvquodi">ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datinehesdi">ᏓᏘᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagani">ᏓᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwesgilvi">ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igvyiditlvno">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagetsilawidi">ᏙᏓᎨᏥᎳᏫᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadalesv">ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvgalenvtani">ᏙᏛᎦᎴᏅᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi-digatiya">ᎠᏫ-ᏗᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidagalenvdisgo">ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninodena">ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinihanulvhi">ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Awino">ᎠᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninodena">ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisi">ᎠᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagagotani">ᏙᏓᎦᎪᏔᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:awino">ᎠᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinihanulvhi">ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agasgani">ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodagaweseli">ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisi">ᎠᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonai">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Etsena">ᎡᏤᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsilvquotanvhi">ᎢᏥᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsatseli">ᎢᏣᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winigalisda">ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsalisgolvdanelvhi">ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudotlvnv">ᏧᏙᏢᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwadalenvdv">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agonuyeno">ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyosisgvgi">ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vsgiyelastanvno">ᎥᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏅᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agitadegisgvgi">ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vsgiunvno">ᎥᏍᎩᎤᏅᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvgigatahvna">ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vsgiyvtanvgi">ᎥᏍᎩᏴᏔᏅᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:36
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agiyelvha">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dosginuwovgino">ᏙᏍᎩᏄᏬᎥᎩᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agitlvgvgi">ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vsgiyagatanilvgino">ᎥᏍᎩᏯᎦᏔᏂᎸᎩᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:didasdudiyi">ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgisduhvgi">ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vsgiwadvhilvgino">ᎥᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎸᎩᏃ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:37
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvti">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvninetsi">ᏛᏂᏁᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwaweseli">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ilagiyu">ᎢᎳᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgosv">ᎢᏨᎪᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayosisgei">ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvyelastaneno">ᎢᏨᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatadegisgei">ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvuneno">ᎢᏨᎤᏁᏃ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:38
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ilagiyu">ᎢᎳᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgoe">ᎢᏨᎪᎡ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsagatahvna">ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvyvtaneno">ᎢᏨᏴᏔᏁᏃ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayelvha">ᏣᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvnuwoeno">ᎢᏨᏄᏬᎡᏃ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:39
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilagiyu">ᎢᎳᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgoe">ᎢᏨᎪᎡ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatlvgei">ᏣᏢᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didasdudiyi">ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsasduhei">ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvyagatanileno">ᎢᏨᏯᎦᏔᏂᎴᏃ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 25:40
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhino">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dakanetsi">ᏓᎧᏁᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodagaweseli">ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinetsadvnelv">ᏥᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdikani">ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalinvtli">ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nisgiyadvnelvgi">ᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:41
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodagaweseli">ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agasgani">ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonai">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sgiyadanvsi">ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:etsisgatsvhi">ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:winasdvna">ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvyi">ᎠᏥᎸᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsilohi">ᏫᏥᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgina">ᎠᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegotlvnanelvhi">ᎨᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:42
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agonuyeno">ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyosisgvgi">ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yisgiyelastanei">ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agitadegisgvgi">ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yisgiunei">ᏱᏍᎩᎤᏁᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 25:43
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvgigatahvna">ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yisgiyvtanei">ᏱᏍᎩᏴᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvha">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidisginuwoei">ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏄᏬᎡᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agitlvgvgi">ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didasdudiyi">ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgisduhvgi">ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yisgiwadvhilei">ᏱᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:44
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquono">ᎾᏍᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvninetsi">ᏛᏂᏁᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwaweseli">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ilagiyu">ᎢᎳᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgoe">ᎢᏨᎪᎡ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayosisgei">ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatadegisgei">ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsagatahvna">ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayelvha">ᏣᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatlvgei">ᏣᏢᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didasdudiyi">ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsasduhei">ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nitsvsdelvhvnano">ᏂᏨᏍᏕᎸᎲᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 25:45
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dakanetsi">ᏓᎧᏁᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodagaweseli">ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsadvnelvna">ᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdikani">ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinisgiyadvnelei">ᏱᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 25:46
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winasdvna">ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliyoisdiyi">ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdvnilosi">ᏮᏛᏂᎶᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:unadanvtisgini">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winasdvna">ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesvi">ᏗᎨᏒᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.25"/>

verses.name: Matthew 26:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv26"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 26</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv26"/><w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquadv">ᎤᏍᏆᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgvi">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 26:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsigataha">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusvhi">ᎢᏳᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohiyegi">ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisdayvdiyi">ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagatlutanisv">ᏣᎦᏡᏔᏂᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadvdiyi">ᎠᎦᏛᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilawitse">ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinowelisgi">ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehv">ᎠᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ganelv">ᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Kayaqua">ᎧᏯᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudoidv">ᏧᏙᎢᏛ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 26:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uninoheleno">ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galonuhedv">ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvdodiyi">ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniniyvdiyi">ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisdayvdiyi">ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyuyeno">ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanalitelvhvga">ᏯᎾᎵᏖᎸᎲᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quediniyi">ᏇᏗᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edohvi">ᎡᏙᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sawani">ᏌᏩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adayesgi">ᎠᏓᏰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvgi">ᎤᏢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelvi">ᎦᏁᎸᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 26:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ulutselvgi">ᎤᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayehvgi">ᎠᏰᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gugu">ᎫᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvya">ᏅᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unegv">ᎤᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvtanvhi">ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlisdvgi">ᎠᏟᏍᏛᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlonedi">ᎠᏠᏁᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulonetanvgi">ᎤᎶᏁᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgoli">ᎠᏍᎪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvgv">ᎦᏅᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgvi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwasdawadidohino">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagohv">ᎬᏩᎪᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitalawosvgi">ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesvgi">ᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsewogi">ᏣᏤᏬᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlonedi">ᎠᏠᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunadinvse">ᏳᎾᏗᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidugvwalanei">ᏱᏚᎬᏩᎳᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvhna·hadegi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinedi">ᏗᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ietsadeyadodi">ᎢᎡᏣᏕᏯᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Osiyuyeno">ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdasi">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinaquvga">ᏥᎾᏋᎦ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoyeno">ᎤᏲᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvhna·hadegi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getseladidoha">ᎨᏤᎳᏗᏙᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsvyeladidoha">ᏱᏨᏰᎳᏗᏙᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlonedi">ᎠᏠᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyelvi">ᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagiloneda">ᏣᎩᎶᏁᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vginisodiyi">ᎥᎩᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadvnvisdiha">ᎠᏆᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Analitsidonidolvha">ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᏂᏙᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhitlv">ᎢᎸᎯᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elanigvi">ᎡᎳᏂᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinadvga">ᏥᎾᏛᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninohedi">ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aganvdadisdodi">ᎠᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsudasi">ᏧᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isgaladi">ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudoidv">ᏧᏙᎢᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widulutselei">ᏫᏚᎷᏤᎴᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 26:15

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Igvyiyiquono">ᎢᎬᏱᏱᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagotanvna">ᎾᎪᏔᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisdiyi">ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutselv">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaduliha">ᏣᏚᎵᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogadvnvisdodiyi">ᎣᎦᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalisdayvdiyi">ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohiyegi">ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itsena">ᎢᏤᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digaduhvi">ᏗᎦᏚᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hatsehv">ᎾᎿᎭᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsiweselvha">ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎸᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Dideyohvsgi">ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigaweha">ᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisqualvelidi">ᎠᎩᏍᏆᎸᎡᎵᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvgisdawadidohi">ᎬᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hinelv">ᎯᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayotsisquanigotani">ᏓᏲᏥᏍᏆᏂᎪᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohiyegi">ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisdayvdiyi">ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:19

verses.name: Matthew 26:20

verses.name: Matthew 26:21

verses.name: Matthew 26:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utsatino">ᎤᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvnvgi">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalenvhvgi">ᎤᎾᎴᏅᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwaweselvgi">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>?

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ai">ᎠᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goweli">ᎪᏪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinohesgvi">ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atludisgi">ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigese">ᏱᎨᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudenvnaquo">ᏄᏕᏅᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsudasino">ᏧᏓᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adatludisgi">ᎠᏓᏡᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tadeyohvsgi">ᏔᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niwi">ᏂᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ulisquidino">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugisv">ᎤᎩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulihelitsv">ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunenelvgi">ᏚᏁᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvgi">ᏄᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nitsiv">ᏂᏥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadita">ᎢᏣᏗᏔ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 26:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhiyu">ᎢᎸᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gogi">ᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalenvdv">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgagadita">ᏴᎦᎦᏗᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:telvladi">ᏖᎸᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanugowisvhi">ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idaditahvha">ᎢᏓᏗᏔᎲᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:30

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ginalii">ᎩᎾᎵᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vhilugi">ᎥᎯᎷᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsvgi">ᎤᏂᎷᏨᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwasitadvgi">ᏕᎬᏩᏏᏔᏛᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwaniyvhvgi">ᎬᏩᏂᏴᎲᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:51
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usaladanvgi">ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanogeni">ᎧᏃᎨᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulvhvgi">ᎤᎸᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdi-ganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluyv">ᎤᎷᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidasdi">ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisdestanvgi">ᎤᎵᏍᏕᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:52
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselvgi">ᏄᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Galadisdiyi">ᎦᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsihilada">ᏥᎯᎳᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatseli">ᏣᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdiganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadvyeno">ᏂᎦᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdi-ganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyisgi">ᎠᏂᏱᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdi-ganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohuhisdodi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:53
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadanvteha">ᏯᏓᏅᏖᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsiyadadolisdanedi">ᎦᏥᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladuquo">ᏔᎳᏚᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadatlugi">ᎢᏳᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogvgikasi">ᏱᏙᎬᎩᎧᏏ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:54
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdoda">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadohiyuhvga">ᏯᏙᎯᏳᎲᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelvi">ᎪᏪᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:55
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyuno">ᎾᎯᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganosgisgi">ᎦᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsiyoho">ᏥᏥᏲᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsilugi">ᎢᏥᎷᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sginiyvhiga">ᏍᎩᏂᏴᎯᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdidiganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ada">ᎠᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinehi">ᏗᏥᏁᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Nidugitsvnisv">ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idinvgi">ᎢᏗᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degadeyohvsgvgi">ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvna-digalawiisdiyi">ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yisginiyisgei">ᏱᏍᎩᏂᏱᏍᎨᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:56
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyudiyi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unowelanvhi">ᎤᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadetsvgi">ᎬᏩᏕᏨᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisvgi">ᎤᎾᎵᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:57
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniniyvdv">ᎤᏂᏂᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kayaquoi">ᎧᏯᏉᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wunatinvstanvgi">ᏭᎾᏘᏅᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvgelohi">ᎠᏥᎸᎨᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hadinowelisgi">ᎾᎿᎭᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danilawivi">ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎥᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:58
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Quidano">ᏈᏓᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdawadvse">ᎤᏍᏓᏩᏛᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ge">Ꭸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaise">ᏣᎢᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diganelv">ᏗᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgi">ᎬᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyvlei">ᎤᏴᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidasdi">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninei">ᎠᏂᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ugowadvdiyi">ᎤᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvse">ᎤᏰᎸᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:walisquadihihvi">ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:59
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nunigvwiyusvno">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadvsonvhi">ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyole">ᎤᏂᏲᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninohelvhi">ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utludisgi">ᎤᏡᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadulisgei">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 26:60
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlotsequo">ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:unitsatesgininonv">ᎤᏂᏣᏖᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninohesgi">ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninanugotsei">ᎤᏂᎾᏄᎪᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlotsequo">ᎤᎾᏠᏤᏉ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Oniyisgininonv">ᎣᏂᏱᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninohesgi">ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsei">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Matthew 26:61
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwesvgi">ᏂᏚᏪᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsiyosda">ᏱᏥᏲᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvna-digalawiisdiyi">ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsoiquono">ᏦᎢᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudodaquadv">ᏧᏙᏓᏆᏛ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:yvganesgvli">ᏴᎦᏁᏍᎬᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:62
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nugvwiyusvno">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulenei">ᏚᎴᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinega">ᏱᏁᎦ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaninoheha">ᏣᏂᏃᎮᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigetsatludiha">ᏥᎨᏣᏡᏗᎭ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:63
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elaweyiquo">ᎡᎳᏪᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nugvwiyusvno">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iunetsv">ᎢᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gvlayosi">ᎬᎳᏲᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hineisdodiyi">ᎯᏁᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:sginohvsi">ᏍᎩᏃᎲᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:64
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niwi">ᏂᏫ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ilvhiyu">ᎢᎸᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayetsigoi">ᏓᏰᏥᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisi">ᎠᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigvgv">ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwolesdi">ᎤᏬᎴᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaisesdi">ᏣᎢᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulogilv">ᎤᎶᎩᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvloi">ᎦᎸᎶᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:65
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusv">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-gelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunuwav">ᏚᏄᏩᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwetsagalvhei">ᏚᏪᏣᎦᎸᎮᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Asotlvisda">ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaninoheha">ᏯᏂᏃᎮᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvniyuquo">ᎬᏂᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvgvga">ᎢᏣᏛᎬᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asotlvisdisgvi">ᎠᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:66
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseliha">ᎢᏤᎵᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Uninetsvno">ᎤᏂᏁᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayohuhisdi">ᎬᏩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:67
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ukadv">ᎤᎧᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunalitsisquei">ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏍᏇᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asquinv">ᎠᏍᏈᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwanasdisgei">ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisoi">ᎠᏂᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunoyeni">ᏧᏃᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwanasdisgei">ᏕᎬᏩᎾᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 26:68
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniwesgei">ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sgiyadoleohisi">ᏍᎩᏯᏙᎴᎣᎯᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsvniga">ᏥᏨᏂᎦ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 26:69
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Quidano">ᏈᏓᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwole">ᎤᏬᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udladanvdvi">ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulutseleno">ᎤᎷᏤᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adv">ᎠᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sdedohvgi">ᏍᏕᏙᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gelili">ᎨᎵᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:70
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udayilei">ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niwesgvi">ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:71
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Doyitlvno">ᏙᏱᏢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulosv">ᏭᎶᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugohei">ᎤᎪᎮᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduwesele">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haanedohi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Naselidi">ᎾᏎᎵᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danedohvgi">ᏓᏁᏙᎲᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:72
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Talineno">ᏔᎵᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udayilei">ᎤᏓᏱᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneistanei">ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:73
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohiyino">ᎪᎯᏱᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalutsele">ᎬᏩᎷᏤᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anidonai">ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwawesele">ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsedolvhi">ᎢᏤᏙᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiwonisgvyeno">ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvneha">ᏂᏨᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:74
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulenvhe">ᎤᎴᏅᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usginvdei">ᎤᏍᎩᏅᏕᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneistanei">ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tla">Ꮭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udvnei">ᎤᏛᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilaquono">ᎩᎳᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsataga">ᏣᏔᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvlasei">ᎤᏴᎳᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 26:75
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Quidano">ᏈᏓᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvdade">ᎤᏅᏓᏕ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsvhi">ᎤᏁᏨᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuweselei">ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsataga">ᏣᏔᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniyvgvna">ᎾᏂᏴᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoi">ᏦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdasquadayili">ᏅᏓᏍᏆᏓᏱᎵ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Unugotsvno">ᎤᏄᎪᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widutloyilei">ᏫᏚᏠᏱᎴᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Matt.26"/>

verses.name: Matthew 27:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv27"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 27</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv27"/><w xlit="Seq:Sunaleno">ᏑᎾᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanv">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehv">ᎠᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awi">ᎠᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninohele">ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvnediyi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalvlv">ᎤᎾᎸᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelisanawidvhei">ᎤᏁᎵᏌᎾᏫᏛᎮᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Quanidv">ᏆᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Qualedi">ᏆᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuniyohiselei">ᏫᏚᏂᏲᎯᏎᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsudasi">ᏧᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulonuhelvhi">ᎤᎶᏄᎮᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagugodanelvi">ᏓᎫᎪᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetliyvse">ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdvi">ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadvsonvhi">ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:douyohele">ᏙᎤᏲᎮᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoasgohi">ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli-adelv">ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunagvwalodi">ᏧᎾᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 27:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsisganvgi">ᏥᏍᎦᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusganvtsvna">ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigv">ᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigatluda">ᏥᎦᏡᏓ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogvdodi">ᎣᎬᏙᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalvwisdasi">ᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudinv">ᏚᏗᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hadigalawiisdiyi">ᎾᎿᎭᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unugotsei">ᎤᏄᎪᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wulosv">ᏭᎶᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wudadvnei">ᏭᏓᏛᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nunigvwiyusvno">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunigisv">ᏚᏂᎩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv">ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigagi">ᏱᎦᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelv-didiyi">ᎠᏕᎸ-ᏗᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yididihvsga">ᏱᏗᏗᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gigvyeno">ᎩᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalanvhi">ᏧᎬᏩᎳᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uninohelvno">ᎤᏂᏃᎮᎸᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uniwahistane">ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vti">ᎥᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digotlvsgi">ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulogesvi">ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haanedohi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsinisodiyi">ᏗᎨᏥᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlogesi">ᏠᎨᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigv">ᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulogesv">ᎤᎶᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anoseha">ᎠᏃᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyune">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetse">ᏧᏁᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tselimaya">ᏤᎵᎹᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwesei">ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunigisvgi">ᏚᏂᎩᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoasgohi">ᏦᎠᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli-adelv">ᎠᏰᎵ-ᎠᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwatanvhi">ᏧᎬᏩᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsatsigvwalotanvhi">ᏣᏥᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Isili">ᎢᏏᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunigvwalotanvhi">ᏧᏂᎬᏩᎶᏔᏅᎯ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 27:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwahistanvgi">ᎤᏂᏩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vti">ᎥᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digotlvsgi">ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulogesvi">ᎤᎶᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqueyonvi">ᎠᏇᏲᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiditlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwolvi">ᎤᏬᎸᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhino">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvdvnei">ᎤᏛᏛᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihisgo">ᏂᎯᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Yeliniwi">ᏰᎵᏂᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nunigvwiyusvno">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayilidolv">ᎬᏩᏱᎵᏙᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunetsei">ᏳᏁᏤᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Qualedi">ᏆᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuweselei">ᏄᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadvgiha">ᏯᏛᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanvnehv">ᎾᏅᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsatludisgvi">ᎨᏣᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 27:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquounv">ᏌᏉᎤᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinunetsei">ᏱᏄᏁᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigosei">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dilisdayvdiyino">ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyui">ᎢᏳᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuyohisedi">ᏧᏲᎯᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayvgi">ᎠᏴᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiaquo">ᎯᎠᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anela">ᎠᏁᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyuno">ᎾᎯᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diganotsali">ᏗᎦᏃᏣᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayvgi">ᎠᏴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unikahe">ᎤᏂᎧᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Qualaqua">ᏆᎳᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudoidv">ᏧᏙᎢᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilawitsv">ᏚᏂᎳᏫᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Qualedi">ᏆᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaduli">ᎢᏣᏚᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvyohisediyi">ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Qualaquasgo">ᏆᎳᏆᏍᎪ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsisage">ᏥᏌᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanosehoi">ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Matthew 27:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agataheyeno">ᎠᎦᏔᎮᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anvyugvquo">ᎠᏅᏳᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgv">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniyosvi">ᏚᏂᏲᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uwolvno">ᎤᏬᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digugododiyi">ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gasgilvi">ᎦᏍᎩᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudanvsei">ᏧᏓᏅᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvtsuweselei">ᏅᏧᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasganvna">ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsalvwisdanelesdi">ᏱᏗᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatiyeno">ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigiliyogi">ᏥᎩᎵᏲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gasgidasgvi">ᎦᏍᎩᏓᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgvi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinilawigi">ᏗᏂᎳᏫᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunisdiyetane">ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Qualaqua">ᏆᎳᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitayosediyi">ᎤᏂᏔᏲᏎᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhino">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsv">ᎤᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaduli">ᎢᏣᏚᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvyohisediyi">ᏗᏨᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Qualaqua">ᏆᎳᏆ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unadvnei">ᎤᎾᏛᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Qualedi">ᏆᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsiyvneli">ᏓᏥᏴᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanosehoi">ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Wagadvvga">ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwosele">ᎬᏬᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhino">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvnelv">ᎤᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usganvtsv">ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utliquo">ᎤᏟᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigae">ᏂᎦᎡ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelunei">ᎤᏁᎷᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:wagadvvga">ᏩᎦᏛᎥᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anadisgvi">ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Qualedi">ᏆᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehosv">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwasegogisdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadasuyedv">ᎤᎾᏓᏑᏰᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalitalvnvgi">ᎤᎾᎵᏔᎸᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ama">ᎠᎹ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wonegisei">ᏬᏁᎩᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusulehe">ᏚᏑᎴᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahvi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisganvtsvhi">ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusganvtsvna">ᏄᏍᎦᏅᏨᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugigv">ᎤᎩᎬ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsagasayasda">ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadvno">ᏂᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninetsei">ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuniwesei">ᏄᏂᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ugigv">ᎤᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogetsi">ᏦᎨᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginvgalesdi">ᎣᎩᏅᎦᎴᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:26

verses.name: Matthew 27:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyawisgi">ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseliga">ᏧᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelv">ᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvtane">ᎤᏂᏴᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hadegvwaduwistane">ᎾᎿᎭᏕᎬᏩᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sunadatlugi">ᏑᎾᏓᏡᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyawisgi">ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:28

verses.name: Matthew 27:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisdeyonv">ᎤᏂᏍᏕᏲᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdulo">ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutsayosdi">ᏧᏣᏲᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvtanvhi">ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unisdulanei">ᎤᏂᏍᏚᎳᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganasda">ᎦᎾᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisi">ᎠᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unasvgaladistanei">ᎤᎾᏒᎦᎳᏗᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danaliniquanvnehe">ᏓᎾᎵᏂᏆᏅᏁᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadehodisgei">ᎠᎾᏕᎰᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniwesgei">ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Itsvyoliga">ᎢᏨᏲᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsagvwiyuhi">ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dunalitsiqueno">ᏚᎾᎵᏥᏇᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvele">ᎤᏂᏴᎡᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganasda">ᎦᎾᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisqualvnistanei">ᎤᏂᏍᏆᎸᏂᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uninugotsvno">ᎤᏂᏄᎪᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwadvhe">ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Salini">ᏌᎵᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sawani">ᏌᏩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudoidv">ᏧᏙᎢᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvsgaisdagi">ᎬᏍᎦᎢᏍᏓᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunvnele">ᏄᏅᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvsdiyi">ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudahna·hawadv">ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Wunilutsvno">ᏭᏂᎷᏨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Goligada">ᎪᎵᎦᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudovi">ᏚᏙᎥᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usqualugoi">ᎤᏍᏆᎷᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigadvga">ᏥᎦᏛᎦ</w>,

verses.name: Matthew 27:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsunitsoyasdi">ᏧᏂᏦᏯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uditasdi">ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adaga">ᎠᏓᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asuyi">ᎠᏑᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninenelei">ᎤᏂᏁᏁᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unelvtanvno">ᎤᏁᎸᏔᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudulvhe">ᏳᏚᎸᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uditasdiyi">ᎤᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unadvneno">ᎤᎾᏛᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniyadole">ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunuwo">ᏧᏄᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anasasdisgei">ᎠᎾᏌᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyune">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehosgi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetsei">ᏧᏁᏤᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwesei">ᏥᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Diquanuwo">ᏗᏆᏄᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniyadolvgi">ᏚᏂᏯᏙᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquanuwo">ᎠᏆᏄᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unasastanvgi">ᎤᎾᏌᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:37
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uniyalvneno">ᎤᏂᏯᎸᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladitlv">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisdadvi">ᎤᎵᏍᏓᏛᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uliyilidehvi">ᎤᎵᏱᎵᏕᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvne">ᏂᎬᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelei">ᎪᏪᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hiayo">ᎯᎠᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:38
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquono">ᎾᏍᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegadvne">ᏕᎨᎦᏛᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninosgisgi">ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisi">ᎠᎦᏘᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:soino">ᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agasgani">ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditlv">ᎢᏗᏢ</w>.

verses.name: Matthew 27:39

verses.name: Matthew 27:57

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsisano">ᏥᏌᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunetselv">ᏚᏁᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigoliyeoi">ᏱᏥᎪᎵᏰᎣᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnelvi">ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:agonu">ᎠᎪᏄ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuyosisge">ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanehei">ᏣᏁᎮᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Luke 6:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuyvle">ᏧᏴᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanelvi">ᎠᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugise">ᏧᎩᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuge">ᏧᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadodi">ᎠᎦᏙᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidunele">ᏥᏚᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanehei">ᏣᏁᎮᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugisdiyi">ᎤᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv-anelohi">ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎠᏁᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgv">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistane">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nv-wadale">Ꮕ-ᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgvi">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuyvle">ᏭᏴᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalawiisdiyi">ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudeyonei">ᏚᏕᏲᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hano">ᎾᎿᎭᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edohe">ᎡᏙᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatisiditlv">ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwaiselvhi">ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ</w>

verses.name: Luke 6:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dinowelisgino">ᏗᏃᏪᎵᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniqualisi">ᎠᏂᏆᎵᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayawisgei">ᎬᏩᏯᏫᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadanvwodiquo">ᎬᏩᏓᏅᏬᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgv">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anelisgei">ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanuhisdodi">ᎬᏩᏄᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyohei">ᎤᏂᏲᎮᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahe">ᎠᎦᏔᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danadanvtesgvi">ᏓᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesele">ᏄᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwaiselvhi">ᎤᏩᎢᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Talehvga">ᏔᎴᎲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:haleniga">ᎭᎴᏂᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Dulenvno">ᏚᎴᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulenilei">ᎤᎴᏂᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduweselei">ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:sudalegi">ᏑᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsvyadvdvni">ᏓᏨᏯᏛᏛᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodi">ᏚᏳᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadodaquasgvi">ᎤᎾᏙᏓᏆᏍᎬᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Osdvsgo">ᎣᏍᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanediyi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyoge">ᎤᏲᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanediyi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvnv">ᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdelvdiyi">ᎠᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adahisdiyige">ᎠᏓᎯᏍᏗᏱᎨ</w>?

verses.name: Luke 6:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dukahna·hanidolvno">ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwaduwidv">ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadvnvi">ᏄᎾᏛᏅᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesele">ᏄᏪᏎᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hadoyanvhidv">ᎭᏙᏯᏅᎯᏛ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnelei">ᏄᏛᏁᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uwoyenino">ᎤᏬᏰᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udiwase">ᎤᏗᏩᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soi">ᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanei">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unikalitseno">ᎤᏂᎧᎵᏤᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitalawosgvi">ᎤᏂᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dunalinoheleno">ᏚᎾᎵᏃᎮᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunvnediyi">ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistane">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyui">ᎾᎯᏳᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:odalv">ᎣᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuloha">ᏭᎶᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolistanvsei">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏔᏅᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsvdaque">ᎤᏨᏓᏇ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdanehvi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanv">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widuyanvhei">ᏫᏚᏯᏅᎮᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taladu">ᏔᎳᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanidv">ᎢᏯᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusuyesei">ᏚᏑᏰᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidv">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwoei">ᏚᏬᎡᎢ</w>—

verses.name: Luke 6:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Sawani">ᏌᏩᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quida">ᏈᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwoei">ᏚᏬᎡᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Enidino">ᎡᏂᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvtli">ᎤᏅᏟ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsimi">ᏥᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsani">ᏣᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Quiligi">ᏈᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quadolami">ᏆᏙᎳᎻ</w>,

verses.name: Luke 6:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Madu">ᎹᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dami">ᏓᎻ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsimi">ᏥᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Eliqui">ᎡᎵᏈ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwitsi">ᎤᏫᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sawanino">ᏌᏩᏂᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Silodi">ᏏᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanosehoi">ᏣᏃᏎᎰᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Luke 6:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsudasino">ᏧᏓᏏᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsimi">ᏥᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadanvtli">ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsudasi">ᏧᏓᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isgaladi">ᎢᏍᎦᎳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adalonuhesgi">ᎠᏓᎶᏄᎮᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinulistanei">ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunigasoasv">ᏧᏂᎦᏐᎠᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwodalv">ᎤᏬᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulenei">ᎤᎴᏁᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsuquisdi">ᎤᏂᏧᏈᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnadv">ᏂᎬᎾᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsudiyi">ᏧᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsilusilimi">ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayunilosvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Taya">ᏔᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sadoni">ᏌᏙᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amequohi">ᎠᎺᏉᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulodi">ᎤᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayunilosvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏂᎶᏒᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilutse">ᏧᏂᎷᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadvganediyi">ᎬᏩᏛᎦᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsinvwodiyi">ᏗᎨᏥᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunitlvgvi">ᏚᏂᏢᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigadaha">ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didanvdo">ᏗᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanadeyadodidegi">ᎬᏩᎾᏕᏯᏙᏗᏕᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:unilutsei">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎢ</w>]; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degetsinvwanei">ᏕᎨᏥᏅᏩᏁᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadvno">ᏂᎦᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anatlinigvnehe">ᎠᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasvnisdiyi">ᎬᏩᏒᏂᏍᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didalehvsge">ᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvwodi">ᎤᏓᏅᏬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadiwisdisge">ᏚᎾᏗᏫᏍᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivi">ᎾᏂᎥᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dusaladaneno">ᏚᏌᎳᏓᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digadoli">ᏗᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dukanane">ᏚᎧᎾᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwasdawadidohi">ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvhna·hadegi">ᎢᏣᏛᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsatseliyeno">ᎢᏣᏤᎵᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyosisgi">ᏗᏥᏲᏏᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dodatsolvsiyeno">ᏙᏓᏦᎸᏏᏰᏃ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatloyihi">ᏗᏣᏠᏱᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dvtsiyetsiyeno">ᏛᏥᏰᏥᏰᏃ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiniquatihesdi">ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsadadaledisgesdi">ᎨᏣᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagetsisotlvdesdi">ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏕᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgagiyu">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadov">ᏕᏣᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgesdi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsaliheligesdi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsalitadegesdi">ᏕᏣᎵᏔᏕᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaliheligvi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gvniyuquoyeno">ᎬᏂᏳᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvedi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvladi">ᎦᎸᎳᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyayeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunidoda">ᏧᏂᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidunvnele">ᏂᏚᏅᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsenai">ᏗᏤᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:gayulayeno">ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiha">ᎢᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigalisdadisgi">ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsolvsvhi">ᏗᏦᎸᏒᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:dodvtsiyosisaniyeno">ᏙᏛᏥᏲᏏᏌᏂᏰᏃ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyetsasgi">ᎢᏥᏰᏣᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:uyoyeno">ᎤᏲᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvtawadegesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsatloyihesdi">ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyoiyu">ᎤᏲᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinohesgesdi">ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyayeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunigayvlige">ᏧᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidunilvquode">ᏂᏚᏂᎸᏉᏕ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlonasdi">ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvweseha">ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisgiyadvganeha">ᏥᏍᎩᏯᏛᎦᏁᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Detsigeyusesdi">ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisgagi">ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidetsadvnehesdi">ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiniquatihi">ᎨᏥᏂᏆᏘᎯ</w>,

verses.name: Luke 6:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetsehesdi">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisginvdisgi">ᎨᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolisdisgesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsidolisdiyi">ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagetsisotlvdisgi">ᎦᎨᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higoqualii">ᎯᎪᏆᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvnihesdi">ᎢᏨᏂᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:soiyi">ᏐᎢᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiyalisgolvdanehesdi">ᎯᏯᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvnohi">ᎤᏛᏃᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanaehesdi">ᏣᎾᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawini">ᎭᏫᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanuwo">ᏣᏄᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higeyutanvgi">ᎯᎨᏳᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsatayosehi">ᎨᏣᏔᏲᏎᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dehinehesdi">ᏕᎯᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gohusdino">ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanav">ᏣᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagiehi">ᏣᎩᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hitayoselvgi">ᎯᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyano">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadulisgv">ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igetsadvnediyi">ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidetsadvnehesdi">ᏂᏕᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsigeyuhiquo">ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎯᏉ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:yiditsigeyuha">ᏱᏗᏥᎨᏳᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiha">ᎢᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayetsalielitsedi">ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Anisganayeno">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunigeyuso">ᏚᏂᎨᏳᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanigeyuhi">ᎬᏩᏂᎨᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiniditsadvneha">ᏱᏂᏗᏣᏛᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igetsadvnehi">ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiha">ᎢᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayetsalielitsedi">ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Anisganayeno">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanadvnehoi">ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvgogineli">ᏛᎪᎩᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditselisehi">ᏗᏤᎵᏎᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsadolasdiha">ᏱᏗᏣᏙᎳᏍᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiha">ᎢᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayetsalielitsedi">ᎦᏰᏣᎵᎡᎵᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Anisganayeno">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgana">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danadolasdisgoi">ᏓᎾᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgetsinediyi">ᎥᎨᏥᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsigeyusesdi">ᏕᏥᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisgagi">ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsilvwisdaehesdi">ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolasdisgesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎳᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvsvna">ᏂᏨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vetsinidiyi">ᎥᎡᏥᏂᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:utsatino">ᎤᏣᏘᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvedi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:wasdvno">ᏩᏍᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galvladiyu">ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidadvneho">ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunalihelitsadvna">ᏄᎾᎵᎮᎵᏣᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyoi">ᎤᏂᏲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:36
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolitsatiyu">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsidoda">ᎢᏥᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolitsadiyu">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Luke 6:37
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadalawiselvgi">ᎢᏣᏓᎳᏫᏎᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgayetsilawisi">ᏴᎦᏰᏥᎳᏫᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadadugodanelvgi">ᏗᏣᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogayetsugodasi">ᏱᏙᎦᏰᏧᎪᏓᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:detsidoligesdi">ᏕᏥᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisganvtsehi">ᎨᏥᏍᎦᏅᏤᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsidolisdi">ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>;

verses.name: Luke 6:38
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsadanehesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinedi">ᎡᏥᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlilodv">ᎠᏟᎶᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asdayotanvhi">ᎠᏍᏓᏲᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atelvnvhi">ᎠᏖᎸᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtsewogi">ᎬᏤᏬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsinedi">ᎨᏥᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadatlohvi">ᏕᏣᏓᏠᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nusdvyeno">ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadatliloelv">ᎢᏣᏓᏟᎶᎡᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsatliloedi">ᎡᏣᏟᎶᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>;

verses.name: Luke 6:39
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwese">ᏄᏪᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dutlilosdanelei">ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Tsigodigewi">ᏥᎪᏗᎨᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatinuga">ᏯᏘᏄᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digewi">ᏗᎨᏫ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsula">ᎢᏧᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atalesv">ᎠᏔᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogvnilvgi">ᏱᏙᎬᏂᎸᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Luke 6:40
