verses.name: Romans 3:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Alesgo">ᎠᎴᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yugvwiyuha">ᏳᎬᏫᏳᎭ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayogisotlvdv">ᎦᏲᎩᏐᏢᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigoginoheha">ᏥᎪᎩᏃᎮᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniwe">ᎾᏂᏪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigogoseha">ᏥᎪᎪᏎᎭ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:Uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degilvwisdanehesdi">ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uliyeilvsdiyi">ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎸᏍᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsv">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadugodanediyi">ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodi">ᏚᏳᎪᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoge">ᎦᏙᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuha">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:utlisgo">ᎤᏟᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidohi">ᏂᏙᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdigidv">ᎤᏍᏗᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unv">ᎤᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gayulayeno">ᎦᏳᎳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degugotanv">ᏕᎫᎪᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsula">ᎢᏧᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvisdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanuyvdvi">ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unv">ᎤᏅ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goligi">ᎪᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohi">ᎤᏲᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nanivquo">ᎾᏂᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlesv">ᎤᎾᏞᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvnvi">ᎦᏅᏅᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyunasdihaquo">ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvdodi">ᏗᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunalistanv">ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unv">ᎤᏅ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unigisdiyi">ᎤᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didanisodiyi">ᏗᏓᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisduidv">ᎤᎵᏍᏚᎢᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dininogoi">ᏗᏂᏃᎪᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadalonuhedisgoi">ᎠᎾᏓᎶᏄᎮᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:inadv">ᎢᎾᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duninehv">ᏚᏂᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adahihi">ᎠᏓᎯᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunihanegalv">ᏚᏂᎭᏁᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawiniditlv">ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunineha">ᏚᏂᏁᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniholi">ᏗᏂᎰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikaliwohi">ᏗᎧᎵᏬᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adasginvdisdi">ᎠᏓᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvsdi">ᎤᏴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsunalasideni">ᏧᎾᎳᏏᏕᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diyanuliyu">ᏗᏯᏄᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigv">ᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatsewediyi">ᎤᎾᏓᏤᏪᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Advdisgi">ᎠᏛᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdadisdi">ᎠᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvdidego">ᎤᏛᏗᏕᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anedohvi">ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadohiyadvno">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvnv">ᎦᏅᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigadovsvhi">ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganayehisdi">ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiditlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdi">ᏱᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikanvi">ᏗᏂᎧᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idigataha">ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgv">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninetseha">ᎤᏂᏁᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinenuhi">ᎨᏥᏁᏄᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniholi">ᏗᏂᎰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsisdunediyi">ᏗᎨᏥᏍᏚᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elanigv">ᎡᎳᏂᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsvhi">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudugotanvhi">ᏧᏚᎪᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgv">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnehv">ᏄᏛᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvdudalesda">ᏴᎬᏚᏓᎴᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyeno">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvisdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadovhisdodi">ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadudalesdodi">ᎤᏓᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdodi">ᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnelvhi">ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudotanvhi">ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgv">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunowelvi">ᏚᏃᏪᎸᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 3:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udagadalesdi">ᎤᏓᎦᏓᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdidalehvsga">ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutsedi">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseli">ᎤᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalehna·hai">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 3:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadiyuyeno">ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsvhi">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohasv">ᎤᏃᎭᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalvquododi">ᎤᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 3:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gegudaledv">ᎨᎫᏓᎴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidigetsigvwalodanelvna">ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎬᏩᎶᏓᏁᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtanvhi">ᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvdoi">ᎠᎫᏴᏙᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwehvi">ᎤᏪᎲᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 3:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwanelv">ᏥᏄᏩᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohisdodi">ᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudiyi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugigv">ᎤᎩᎬ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsunanugowisediyi">ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayula">ᎦᏳᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvtsvhi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagvwadanedi">ᎦᎬᏩᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidiyu">ᎬᏂᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisanvhi">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏅᎯ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 3:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsunanugowisediyi">ᏧᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gudalesgi">ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgi">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hatlvgeno">ᎭᏢᎨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atlvquasdi">ᎠᏢᏆᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnelvhi">ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtanvhi">ᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanediyisgo">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanetsehi">ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdisgini">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtanvhi">ᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanetsehi">ᎠᏓᏁᏤᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dedugodiha">ᏕᏚᎪᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adudalesdisgv">ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnelvna">ᏄᏛᏁᎸᎾ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgo">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusiquo">ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Saquohiyuyeno">ᏌᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidegudalesdiha">ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiusdeselvhi">ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidigetsiusdeselvna">ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidegudalesdiha">ᏥᏕᎫᏓᎴᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 3:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgono">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidvneha">ᏂᏛᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idvdiha">ᎢᏛᏗᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:idisdayidisgini">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.3"/>

verses.name: Romans 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv121"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 4</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv121"/><w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdi">ᏥᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadadvni">ᏓᏓᏛᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igidoda">ᎢᎩᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwadvhv">ᎤᏩᏛᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvdv">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>?

verses.name: Romans 4:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehv">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududalestanvhi">ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uha">ᎤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvquisdodi">ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:yuha">ᏳᎭ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoyeno">ᎦᏙᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adiha">ᎠᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodi">ᎦᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goweli">ᎪᏪᎵ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyune">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanelei">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanehi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agaguyvedi">ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvdigalisdodisgo">ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatsiyelvnanehoi">ᏯᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udadugvsgini">ᎤᏓᏚᎬᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgo">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanehoi">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na-sgini">Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidulvwisdanehvna">ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgiquosgini">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gudalesgi">ᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganai">ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyusv">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanehoi">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsikaneisdiha">ᏥᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvnaneha">ᎤᏰᎸᎾᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidulvwisdanelvna">ᏂᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 4:7
verses.text: [<w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigaweha">ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunalisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsv">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagetsinelvhi">ᎦᎨᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadvnelv">ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegutlvnanelvhi">ᎨᎫᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 4:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osi">ᎣᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usganvtsv">ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwugosdisgvna">ᏄᏭᎪᏍᏗᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalisdanedi">ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiusdeselvhiquosgo">ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏉᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutseha">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigoge">ᏥᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiusdeselvhi">ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gohiyudiyeno">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanele">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idadiha">ᎢᏓᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ilagiyuno">ᎢᎳᎩᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusde">ᏄᏍᏕ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanelei">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎴᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigoge">ᏥᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhisgini">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinele">ᎠᏥᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahusdesdi">ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdvi">ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asdayidisgi">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyelvnanehvi">ᎠᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyusv">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsiusdeselvna">ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unidoda">ᎤᏂᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nidigetsiusdeselvna">ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyelvnanediyi">ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎾᏁᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 4:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiusdeselvhi">ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unidoda">ᎤᏂᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiusdeselvhi">ᏗᎨᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquosgini">ᎾᏍᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisdawadegi">ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulasinvsv">ᏚᎳᏏᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igidoda">ᎢᎩᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwohiyuse">ᏧᏬᎯᏳᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsatsiduisdaneleyeno">ᏣᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Equahami">ᎡᏆᎭᎻ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetlvtanvdv">ᎤᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudisgini">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adudalesdodi">ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 4:15

verses.name: Romans 4:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudladasidvehe">ᏳᏜᏓᏏᏛᎡᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uduistanvi">ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwohiyusvna">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyusgini">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gese">ᎨᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyusvi">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvquodisge">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 4:21

verses.name: Romans 4:22

verses.name: Romans 4:24

verses.name: Romans 4:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidatsiyose">ᏥᏓᏥᏲᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igisganvtsv">ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinvdigalisdodisgei">ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidagaletane">ᏥᏓᎦᎴᏔᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadudalesdiyi">ᎢᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.4"/>

verses.name: Romans 5:1

verses.name: Romans 5:7

verses.name: Romans 5:11

verses.name: Romans 5:15

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idigataha">ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadahna·hawasdv">ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadvnv">ᎠᎦᏛᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:agadvnvi">ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvisdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehv">ᎡᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohuhisdiyi">ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalenvdv">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diginatlvdiyi">ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududalaelvhi">ᎤᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digiyohusvhi">ᏗᎩᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idohiyuhvsga">ᎢᏙᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didvnodv">ᏗᏛᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 6:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Idigatahayeno">ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusv">ᎤᏲᎱᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagaletanvhi">ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohuhisdi">ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalinehidehi">ᎤᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuyohusvgi">ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asgini">ᎠᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnodv">ᎬᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnodv">ᎬᏃᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyohusvhi">ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadadanvtesgesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvnodv">ᏗᏨᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yugvwiyusadegesdi">ᏳᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diyogi">ᏗᏲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelvi">ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyudiyi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haditsiyelv">ᎾᎿᎭ[ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:udulvnvvsgvi">ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsiyohiselvgi">ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududadewisvi">ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvdodiyi">ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsilvwisdanediyi">ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsadayohisi">ᏤᏣᏓᏲᎯᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvnedi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadvnidvhi">ᎤᎾᏛᏂᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududadewisv">ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsiyohiselvgi">ᏕᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvdodiyi">ᏗᏨᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsilvwisdanediyi">ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 6:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asganiyeno">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigetsadalinehidehesdi">ᏱᎨᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadanuyvdi">ᏱᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiyasgini">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanuyvdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏄᏴᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:idisganvgesdisgo">ᎢᏗᏍᎦᏅᎨᏍᏗᏍᎪ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgesdi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadanuyvdvna">ᏂᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiyasgini">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadanuyvdvi">ᎢᎦᏓᏄᏴᏛᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidetsadayohiselv">ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏲᎯᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinvsidohv">ᎢᏥᏅᏏᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsoiyudiyi">ᎡᏦᎢᏳᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinatlai">ᎢᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsoiyuhvsgi">ᎡᏦᎢᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgi">ᎬᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adudalesdi">ᎠᏚᏓᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgi">ᎬᏗᏍᎩ</w>?

verses.name: Romans 6:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alihelitsedi">ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinatlai">ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesvgi">ᏥᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinawi">ᏗᏥᎾᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyunv">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dideyodi">ᏗᏕᏲᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsiyohiselvhi">ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niditsinatlavna">ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinulistanv">ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinatlai">ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanvgi">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuniwesdi">ᎢᏳᏂᏪᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiquedalv">ᎢᏥᏇᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wanagalahiyu">ᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelvyeno">ᏗᏥᏰᎸᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadudadewisv">ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidetsiyosvgi">ᏥᏕᏥᏲᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaha">ᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninatlai">ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsilvwisdanediyi">ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadudadewisv">ᎢᏣᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyohi">ᏗᏥᏲᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninatlai">ᎤᏂᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisgana">ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyuyeno">ᎾᎯᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinatlai">ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesvgi">ᏥᎨᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niditsinatlavna">ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyuno">ᎾᎯᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesvgi">ᏥᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinequotsehe">ᎢᏥᏁᏉᏤᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsadehosga">ᏥᏣᏕᎰᏍᎦ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdiyeno">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wuliyeilohisdi">ᏭᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohisgini">ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niditsinatlavna">ᏂᏗᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinatlai">ᏗᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinulistanv">ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsinequovhi">ᎢᏥᏁᏉᎥᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiha">ᎢᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsisganvna">ᏂᏥᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvnehi">ᎢᏨᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:walisquadihihvno">ᏩᎵᏍᏆᏗᎯᎲᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wusditsihisdi">ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 6:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asganiyeno">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udaguyvedi">ᎤᏓᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanedi">ᎤᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wusditsihisdi">ᏭᏍᏗᏥᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseliga">ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.6"/>

verses.name: Romans 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv124"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 7</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv124"/><w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adalinvtli">ᎠᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyeno">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsiwonediha">ᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᎭ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlav">ᎤᎾᏝᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehvi">ᎡᎲᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Romans 7:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ageyvyeno">ᎠᎨᏴᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidatsehoi">ᏥᏓᏤᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududalvdo">ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unaneladisdiyi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igohidv">ᎢᎪᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alenidohv">ᎠᎴᏂᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyehisgini">ᎤᏰᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ududaledv">ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududalvdv">ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unaneladisdiyi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehv">ᎡᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidunatsenv">ᏱᏚᎾᏤᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adayonehi">ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agosehesdi">ᎠᎪᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ududaledv">ᎤᏚᏓᎴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududalvdvi">ᎤᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adayonehi">ᎠᏓᏲᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidanatseha">ᏱᏓᎾᏤᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyohusvhi">ᏗᏥᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsalistanv">ᏂᏣᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatsvsdiyi">ᏗᏣᏨᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvsvgi">ᎠᏰᎸᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohusv">ᎠᏲᎱᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagaletanvhi">ᏣᎦᎴᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugatatanvhi">ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edinanugowisediyi">ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uquedalvquoyeno">ᎤᏇᏓᎸᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidehvi">ᏥᏕᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asganvisdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulvnvvsgvi">ᎤᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehvgi">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didiyelv">ᏗᏗᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududadewisvi">ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugatatanvhi">ᎤᎦᏔᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edinanugowisediyi">ᎡᏗᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohisgini">ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edadudalaelv">ᎡᏓᏚᏓᎳᎡᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diginatlvnvhi">ᏗᎩᎾᏢᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvdodiyi">ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edadvnediyi">ᎡᏓᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelvquo">ᎪᏪᎸᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvdodiyi">ᎢᎬᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadvnelv">ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwagutanvsvi">ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadogeno">ᎦᏙᎨᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadadvni">ᏓᏓᏛᏂ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganiquo">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏉ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtlasgini">ᎥᏝᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvgigadovse">ᏱᎬᎩᎦᏙᎥᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigatsigatahe">ᏱᎦᏥᎦᏔᎮ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adulvnvdi">ᎠᏚᎸᏅᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesvna">ᏄᏪᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesei">ᏱᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadadulvelvgi">ᏣᏓᏚᎸᎡᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asganisgini">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgvi">ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalesv">ᏄᏓᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadulvnvdiyi">ᎠᏆᏚᎸᏅᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquvnelvgi">ᎾᏋᏁᎸᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ilvhiyuyeno">ᎢᎸᎯᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesv">ᏥᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidaquanelodvna">ᏂᏓᏆᏁᎶᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyui">ᎢᏳᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnodv">ᎬᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsvsgini">ᎤᎵᏁᏨᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulutsv">ᎤᎷᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvnidvgi">ᎤᏛᏂᏛᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyohusvgi">ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏒᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanehi">ᎠᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adahihiquo">ᎠᏓᎯᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualisdanelvgi">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asganiyeno">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgv">ᎬᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilonuhelvgi">ᎠᎩᎶᏄᎮᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agihistanvgi">ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasganvna">ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasganvna">ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodvi">ᏚᏳᎪᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigono">ᏥᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agihihiquo">ᎠᎩᎯᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulistanei">ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Asganisgini">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehvgi">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agihisdiyi">ᎠᎩᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgvgi">ᎬᏗᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsv">ᎤᎵᏁᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgana·hiyu">ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Idigatahayeno">ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyi">ᎤᏠᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatinidohi">ᎠᏆᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vginadinvdv">ᎥᎩᎾᏗᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginatlvdiyi">ᎠᎩᎾᏢᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nusdvyeno">ᏄᏍᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagilvwisdanehvi">ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagiyelvha">ᏯᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nusdvsgini">ᏄᏍᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadulisgvi">ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvnehoi">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiniquatihvi">ᏥᏂᏆᏘᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadvnehoi">ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadulisgvna">ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvneha">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goiyuhvsga">ᎪᎢᏳᎲᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdi">ᏥᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvneha">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asganisgini">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagiyaa">ᏣᎩᏯᎠ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigatahayeno">ᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiquedalv">ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadvnv">ᏯᏛᏅ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulitloyasdvna">ᏄᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:adulvdiyiyeno">ᎠᏚᎸᏗᏱᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiha">ᎠᎩᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsiwatiha">ᏱᏥᏩᏘᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osdvyeno">ᎣᏍᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadulisgvi">ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvnehoi">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyosgini">ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadulisgvna">ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadvnehoi">ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadulisgvna">ᎾᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvneha">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigagadvneha">ᏱᏂᎦᎦᏛᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asganisgini">ᎠᏍᎦᏂᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagiyaa">ᏣᎩᏯᎠ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquo">ᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiwatiha">ᏥᏩᏘᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquadvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadulv">ᎠᏆᏚᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagikahna·hawadidohoi">ᏓᎩᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osiyuyeno">ᎣᏏᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvha">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdiha">ᎬᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawini">ᎭᏫᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquehv">ᎠᏇᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigowatiha">ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏘᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyelv">ᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadudadewisvi">ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digatilegi">ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdogihi">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahvi">ᎠᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyvgi">ᏥᏴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquvnehi">ᎢᏯᏋᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquudalvvsgi">ᎠᏊᏓᎸᎥᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyelv">ᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadudadewisv">ᎠᏆᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahvi">ᎠᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyosdvquo">ᎤᏲᏍᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquasdi">ᎾᏆᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvquudalesi">ᏛᏊᏓᎴᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyelv">ᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adahihi">ᎠᏓᎯᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadudalvdvi">ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 7:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyalielitseha">ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseliga">ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtediyi">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdiha">ᎬᏗᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvquo">ᎠᏴᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsiganawadega">ᏕᏥᎦᎾᏩᏕᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:agiquedalvsgini">ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsigahna·hawadega">ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏕᎦ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.7"/>

verses.name: Romans 8:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv125"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 8</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv125"/><w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waha">ᏩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanadugodanedi">ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwayai">ᎬᏩᏯᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanisdawadegvna">ᎾᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adanvdosgini">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanisdawadega">ᏣᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdoyeno">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanehi">ᎠᏓᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdidalehvsga">ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquudalesv">ᎠᏊᏓᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseli">ᎤᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadudalvi">ᎠᏆᏚᏓᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dikahna·hawadvsdiyeno">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwadvnedi">ᎢᎬᏩᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgv">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awanagalahiyu">ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>,—<w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvse">ᏧᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditlilostanvhi">ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgana">ᎠᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalei">ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duwugodanele">ᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usegogise">ᎤᏎᎪᎩᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvisdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedalv">ᎤᏇᏓᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayavi">ᎠᏯᎥᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 8:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayulisdododiyi">ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgv">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadvnehohvsdiyi">ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎰᎲᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdawadegi">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdosgini">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdawadegi">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatinidohi">ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedaliquo">ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unagasayasdoi">ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatinidohi">ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdoquo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unagasayasdoi">ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uquedaliyeno">ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agasayasdodiyi">ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waliyeilohiha">ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:adanvdosgini">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adesayasdodiyi">ᎠᏕᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:waliyeilohiha">ᏩᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uquedaliyeno">ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agasayasdodiyi">ᎠᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digatilegi">ᏗᎦᏘᎴᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadegi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udogiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎩᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgvdvga">ᏱᏅᎬᏛᎦ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 8:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatinidohi">ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgvnadvga">ᏱᏅᎬᎾᏛᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatinidohi">ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdosgini">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsatinidohi">ᏗᏣᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:howa">ᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsiyaa">ᏱᏥᏯᎠ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwehvna">ᏄᏪᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigagi">ᏱᎦᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyaesdi">ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdosgini">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnodv">ᎬᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusv">ᎤᏲᎱᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuletanvhi">ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyaesdi">ᎢᏥᏯᎡᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusv">ᎤᏲᎱᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuletanvhi">ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagvnohistani">ᏙᏓᎬᏃᎯᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diyohusgi">ᏗᏲᎱᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelvi">ᏗᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvtani">ᏓᎬᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsiyaa">ᏥᏥᏯᎠ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:egiduga">ᎡᎩᏚᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigiduga">ᏱᎩᏚᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igisdawadidasdiyi">ᎢᎩᏍᏓᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idehvi">ᎢᏕᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehv">ᎢᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisdawadidohesdi">ᎢᏥᏍᏓᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dodatsiyohusi">ᏙᏓᏥᏲᎱᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehv">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsihihesdi">ᎢᏥᎯᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:detsvnesdi">ᏕᏨᏁᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nanivyeno">ᎾᏂᎥᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:giloi">ᎩᎶᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatinidohi">ᏧᎾᏘᏂᏙᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinatlai">ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinelvhi">ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinayehisdiyi">ᎢᏥᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsisgini">ᏧᏪᏥᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igegvnelvhi">ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvdo">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinelv">ᎡᏥᏁᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idvdisgv">ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Aqua">ᎠᏆ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:Edoda">ᎡᏙᏓ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:tsidadisgoi">ᏥᏓᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdoyeno">ᎠᏓᏅᏙᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daligoneha">ᏓᎵᎪᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digadanvdo">ᏗᎦᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanvnehv">ᎾᏅᏁᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatiyehi">ᎢᎦᏘᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:igatiyedi">ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanedi">ᎤᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatiyedi">ᎢᎦᏘᏰᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:howa">ᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigatloyasdiha">ᏱᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliyogvi">ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatloyasdodi">ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquodisgvi">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadanvtesgvyeno">ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliyoisdi">ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvtlilosdodi">ᏗᎬᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:eginanugowisedi">ᎡᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ulinigidvyeno">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aganelanvhi">ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatiya">ᎠᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinanugowisv">ᎨᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwetsi">ᏧᏪᏥ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 8:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aganelanvhiyeno">ᎠᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayogi">ᎠᏲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagvnelei">ᎾᎬᏁᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvsv">ᎤᏰᎸᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osiyusgini">ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvnv">ᎤᏰᎸᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanelvhi">ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwvdiyi">ᎤᏮᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvnv">ᎤᏰᎸᏅ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 8:21

verses.name: Romans 9:19

verses.name: Romans 9:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isaya">ᎢᏌᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayula">ᎦᏳᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwesoi">ᏥᏄᏪᏐᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudatinai">ᏧᏓᏘᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niginohiyelvna">ᏂᎩᏃᎯᏰᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigese">ᏱᎨᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinohiyvhi">ᎤᎵᏃᎯᏴᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sodamiquo">ᏐᏓᎻᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yididatselei">ᏱᏗᏓᏤᎴᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gomali">ᎪᎹᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigasdei">ᏱᏂᎦᏍᏕᎢ</w>.
