verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:wigvdvdi">ᏫᎬᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdiha">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w>?] <w xlit="Seq:Isili">ᎢᏏᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuwadvhv">ᏳᏩᏛᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuyohvgi">ᏧᏲᎲᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gegasuyedvsgini">ᎨᎦᏑᏰᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwadvhv">ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anisoino">ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunigusiyotsvgi">ᏚᏂᎫᏏᏲᏨᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunelv">ᏚᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adalitadisgi">ᎠᏓᎵᏔᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigadoli">ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanigowadvdodi">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎪᏩᏛᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinileni">ᏗᏂᎴᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanadvgododi">ᏗᎬᏩᎾᏛᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyasdi">ᎢᏯᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dewi">ᏕᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigaweha">ᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Alisdayvdiyi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisgilv">ᎤᏂᏍᎩᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unesgi">ᎤᏁᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisadvvsgi">ᎤᏂᏌᏛᎥᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunodehihi">ᏧᏃᏕᎯᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisdvdisdodi">ᎤᏂᏍᏛᏗᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winunalisdasi">ᏫᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏏ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 11:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dinigadoli">ᏗᏂᎦᏙᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widigegalisihvsdasi">ᏫᏗᎨᎦᎵᏏᎲᏍᏓᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigowadvdiyi">ᎤᏂᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadisadadegesdi">ᏚᎾᏗᏌᏓᏕᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunodelv">ᏚᏃᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninvisdiyi">ᏧᏂᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvsei">ᎠᏰᎸᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duninvtsv">ᏚᏂᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwanisanv">ᏄᏩᏂᏌᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdelvdodi">ᎠᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutselv">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadvyugediyi">ᎤᎾᏛᏳᎨᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunvnisodiyi">ᎢᏳᏅᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duninvtsv">ᏚᏂᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unenvisdisgi">ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunalisdanehv">ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unenvisdisgi">ᎤᏁᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvsdesdi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anikalitsvha">ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏨᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihiyeno">ᏂᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvwonediha">ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadalenvdv">ᏗᏣᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginvsidv">ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsiyalitsidonediyi">ᎦᏥᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsilvquodiha">ᏥᎸᏉᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquasvgalodvi">ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏛᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 11:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvquadvnedi">ᎢᎬᏆᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquvnisodiyi">ᎢᏯᏋᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlinigvnediyi">ᎤᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogitloyi">ᎣᎩᏠᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsisdelvdiyi">ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisonvistanvi">ᎨᏥᏐᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohisdanehi">ᎤᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigalisdi">ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisdodi">ᎤᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degegadanilvtsvha">ᏕᎨᎦᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duniyohusvsgini">ᏚᏂᏲᎱᏒᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunalehisanv">ᏚᎾᎴᎯᏌᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyi">ᎢᎬᏱᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvdvnatsvhi">ᎤᎬᏛᎾᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w>;] <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duhna·hasdetlv">ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwanigalvi">ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwanigalv">ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidigvnigalesv">ᏱᏗᎬᏂᎦᎴᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inage-hehi">ᎢᎾᎨ-ᎮᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oliwa">ᎣᎵᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hayiwiyetsayitlvtanv">ᎾᎿᎭᏱᏫᏰᏣᏱᏢᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisdelodv">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎶᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitseladisdi">ᏱᏤᎳᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsalisdelvdi">ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duhna·hasdetlv">ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galitsonv">ᎦᎵᏦᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oliwa">ᎣᎵᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugvi">ᏡᎬᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 11:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitatlvquisehesdi">ᏱᏔᏢᏈᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwanigalvi">ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatlvquisga">ᏯᏢᏈᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duhna·hasdetlv">ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitinanugowisga">ᏱᏘᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duhna·hasdetlvsgini">ᏚᎿᎭᏍᏕᏢᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsananugowisga">ᎨᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geli">ᎨᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdvhiwesi">ᏅᏛᎯᏪᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:duwanigalv">ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunvnigalvhvgi">ᏚᏅᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquvyitlvdiyi">ᎥᏋᏱᏢᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hani">ᎾᎿᎭᏂ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nunohiyusvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayulisdotanvgi">ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degetsinigalvhvgi">ᏕᎨᏥᏂᎦᎸᎲᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidoga">ᏥᏙᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsohiyusv">ᏦᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnisiha">ᏂᎬᏂᏏᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdiquo">ᏞᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsatselvsesdi">ᏱᏣᏤᎸᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hinayesgesdisgini">ᎯᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 11:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidugeyunvna">ᏂᏚᎨᏳᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvnehiya">ᏅᏁᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwanigalvi">ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsageyunvnaquo">ᏂᏣᎨᏳᏅᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hagasayasda">ᎭᎦᏌᏯᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvteyu">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdayiyu">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asdayiyu">ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidegvnehv">ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninvtsvhi">ᏧᏂᏅᏨᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtiyu">ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsananugowisehvi">ᏣᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎲᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvwasdidi">ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsaniyvsv">ᏕᏣᏂᏴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtiyu">ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsvnagalesdi">ᎡᏨᎾᎦᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwasdihaquo">ᎢᎬᏩᏍᏗᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunohiyusvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsiyitlvdi">ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwayitlvdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏱᏢᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inage">ᎢᎾᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehiya">ᎡᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oliwa">ᎣᎵᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvyitlvnvhi">ᏨᏱᏢᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hahehiya">ᎾᎿᎭᎮᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oliwa">ᎣᎵᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugv">ᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yetsvyitlvnv">ᏰᏨᏱᏢᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyusgini">ᎤᏟᎯᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahitiyu">ᎠᎯᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haanehiya">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏁᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsiyitlvdi">ᎨᏥᏱᏢᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haunvsv">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseligaya">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oliwa">ᎣᎵᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlugvi">ᏡᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquaduli">ᏯᏆᏚᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nitsigatahvnaquo">ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:itsigatanaiquoyeno">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvtsalisda">ᏱᏅᏣᎵᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvtesgvi">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agusiyoisdi">ᎠᎫᏏᏲᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unilutselv">ᎤᏂᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isili">ᎢᏏᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvlvhi">ᎤᏂᏴᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 11:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagalistani">ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Isili">ᎢᏏᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisdelvdi">ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sayani">ᏌᏯᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagalutsi">ᏓᎦᎷᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digudalesgi">ᏗᎫᏓᎴᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvneli">ᏅᏓᎬᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunilvquodvna">ᏄᏂᎸᏉᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igaqui">ᎢᎦᏈ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwehvi">ᎤᏪᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degatsiyatloisdanelvi">ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏠᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsivedi">ᎦᏥᎥᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalistanvha">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsvi">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osdvno">ᎣᏍᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsisgagi">ᎨᏥᏍᎦᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunalistanv">ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dasuyesgvsgini">ᏓᏑᏰᏍᎬᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsigeyuha">ᎨᏥᎨᏳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigayvlige">ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanedi">ᎤᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udayanvdi">ᎤᏓᏯᏅᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlaquo">ᏝᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihiyeno">ᏂᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwagutanvsv">ᏧᏩᎫᏔᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsoiyusvna">ᏁᏦᎢᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesvgi">ᏥᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsidolitsvhi">ᎡᏥᏙᎵᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunohiyusvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 11:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunohiyunv">ᏳᏃᎯᏳᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatseli">ᎢᏣᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisodiyi">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsidolisdi">ᎨᏥᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwugotanv">ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunohiyusvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwedolisdi">ᏧᏪᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 11:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasewiniyv">ᎾᏎᏫᏂᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatanvhi">ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadosaniyu">ᎠᎦᏙᏌᏂᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatanaiyu">ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>! <w xlit="Seq:nigavquo">ᏂᎦᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvgoliyedi">ᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degugodisgvi">ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwedasdiyi">ᎤᏪᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagoluwadvdi">ᎦᎪᎷᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>!

verses.name: Romans 11:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagoyeno">ᎦᎪᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugadovso">ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdv">ᎤᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatequalono">ᎤᎾᏖᏆᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvteloi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᎶᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Romans 11:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudalenvtanv">ᏚᏓᎴᏅᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelv">ᎤᏁᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dvagaguyveli">ᏛᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᎵ</w>?

verses.name: Romans 11:36
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwala">ᎤᎬᏩᎳ</w>; [<w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquododi">ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilvi">ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Emenv">ᎡᎺᏅ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.11"/>

verses.name: Romans 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv129"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 12</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv129"/><w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsvsdiyediha">ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolitsatiyu">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏣᏘᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalisgolvdodiyi">ᏗᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnodv">ᎬᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv">ᎠᏥᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gelasdi">ᎨᎳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdvna">ᏄᏍᏛᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:digvwadanilvisdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvdv">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsadvnehvi">ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunasdv">ᏄᎾᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsvsdesdi">ᏱᏂᏨᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanetliyvdvsgini">ᏗᏣᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditse">ᏗᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idigvnelvhi">ᎢᏗᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvdvi">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsigoliyedi">ᎨᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulisgv">ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwadanilvisdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:akalii">ᎠᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwagatiyayeno">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgv">ᎬᏗᏍᎬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginelvhi">ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigatsiweseha">ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivquo">ᎾᏂᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigetsadasuya">ᏥᎨᏣᏓᏑᏯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tlesdiquo">ᏞᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanilosvsdisgesdi">ᏯᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgv">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiduyugodi">ᏥᏚᏳᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvtediyi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏖᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unalisina·hisdisgini">ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgvi">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dutliloelv">ᏚᏟᎶᎡᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwihai">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utsatiyeno">ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidegahitlewisv">ᏥᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagadv">ᎾᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degahitlewisv">ᏕᎦᎯᏞᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyi">ᎤᏠᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtanidasdi">ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 12:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:igitsati">ᎢᎩᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidalisdiha">ᏂᏓᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dedanelodvi">ᏕᏓᏁᎶᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidiv">ᏂᏗᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisiyvwiha">ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadudadewisv">ᎢᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalehna·hai">ᏧᏓᎴᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:eginelvnvhi">ᎡᎩᏁᎸᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginelvi">ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehohisdi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:egatliloelv">ᎡᎦᏟᎶᎡᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idvdisgesdi">ᎢᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:idadolehosgesdi">ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>;]

verses.name: Romans 12:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idiyadohihesdi">ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idiyadohihvquo">ᎢᏗᏯᏙᎯᎲᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degilvwisdanehesdi">ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadeyohvsgesdi">ᏓᏕᏲᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dideyodiquo">ᏗᏕᏲᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehesdi">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 12:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonedisgi">ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:digawonedodiquo">ᏗᎦᏬᏁᏙᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanehesdi">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayadohehesdi">ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nugeyuhvsgvna">ᏄᎨᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvnehesdi">ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaganelodi">ᏣᎦᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugasayasdi">ᎤᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadoligesdi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ukalisdi">ᎤᎧᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdv">ᎤᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvnehesdi">ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adageyudi">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nutlonasdvna">ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Itsiniquatihesdi">ᎢᏥᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:detsiniyvsesdi">ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Analinvtli">ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadageyudi">ᏧᎾᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadageyusesdi">ᏕᏣᏓᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:didalvquododi">ᏗᏓᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvdisgv">ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadagvwiyudisgesdi">ᏕᏣᏓᎬᏫᏳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Detsilvwisdanehv">ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanulvdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏄᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvtesdi">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsadvnehesdi">ᎡᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaliheligesdi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ditsvnidiyu">ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigiliyogvi">ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsadadolisdisgesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilvi">ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Romans 12:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unadanvti">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninigvsehv">ᎤᏂᏂᎬᏎᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsiyadohehesdi">ᏕᏥᏯᏙᎮᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsigaliyiyu">ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏱᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadasquanigododiyi">ᏗᏣᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetsehesdi">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igetsvhna·hadegi">ᎢᎨᏨᎿᎭᏕᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:osdvquo">ᎣᏍᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetsehesdi">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsisginvdisgesdi">ᏱᏗᏥᏍᎩᏅᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analiheligi">ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaliheligesdi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinatloyihi">ᏗᎾᏠᏱᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsatloyihesdi">ᏕᏣᏠᏱᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utloyihaquo">ᎤᏠᏱᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadadanvtesgvi">ᏕᏣᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsagasayasdesdi">ᏱᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodi">ᎦᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:detseladidohesdisgini">ᏕᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadadolisdi">ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigatanai">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadayelvsesdi">ᏱᏣᏓᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Usonv">ᎤᏐᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvnehesdi">ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsatlegesdi">ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usonv">ᎤᏐᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinetsvnehesdi">ᏱᏁᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadanvtesgesdi">ᏂᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnelidasdi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᎵᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahvi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igetsadvnedi">ᎢᎨᏣᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatlinigvnehesdi">ᎢᏣᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dohiyi">ᏙᎯᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadediyi">ᎢᏣᏕᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsvgeyui">ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsatlegesdi">ᏱᏣᏞᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsilanvdadehesdisgini">ᎢᏥᎳᏅᏓᏕᎮᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utalawohisdi">ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowela">ᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Atleisdi">ᎠᏞᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseliga">ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagaguyvhi">ᏓᎦᎫᏴᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adiha">ᎠᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsasgagi">ᏣᏍᎦᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agonu">ᎠᎪᏄ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyosisgesdi">ᎤᏲᏏᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiyelohesdi">ᎯᏰᎶᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utadegisgesdi">ᎤᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiuvsgesdi">ᎯᎤᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·hadvnehv">ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinosga">ᏥᏃᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutsistli">ᏧᏥᏍᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dehitlusgesdi">ᏕᎯᏡᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgoli">ᎠᏍᎪᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 12:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usonv">ᎤᏐᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsvnelv">ᏁᏨᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadalinehidelesdi">ᏱᏣᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎴᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:usonvsgini">ᎤᏐᏅᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsvnelv">ᏁᏨᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiyadalinehidehesdi">ᎯᏯᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·hadvnehvi">ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.12"/>

verses.name: Romans 13:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv130"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 13</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv130"/><w xlit="Seq:Nanivquo">ᎾᏂᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunohiyusesdi">ᏚᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degotlvwadisvi">ᏕᎪᏢᏩᏗᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudotlvha">ᏳᏙᏢᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidegotlvha">ᏥᏕᎪᏢᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtelvhi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digotlvnvhi">ᏗᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatilegesdi">ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvsvi">ᎪᏢᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dagatilegesdi">ᏓᎦᏘᎴᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtelvhi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvnvhi">ᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigatilegi">ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadugodanediyi">ᏧᎾᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwadvdisgesdi">ᎠᏂᏩᏛᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nunigvwiyusadegiyeno">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diganayehisdi">ᏗᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidolvwisdaneha">ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyosgini">ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidolvwisdaneha">ᏱᏙᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsadulisgono">ᏣᏚᎵᏍᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanayehisdiyi">ᏣᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvsvi">ᎪᏢᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·hadvnehesdi">ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalvquododi">ᏣᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusadegi">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidasdi">ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanehi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoquo">ᎤᏲᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsalvwisdanehesdi">ᏙᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hisgaihesdi">ᎯᏍᎦᎢᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiganeha">ᏱᎦᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelasdi-ganvhidv">ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ-ᎦᏅᎯᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidasdi">ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utlegi">ᎤᏞᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asdvdisdisgi">ᎠᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanehi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyudi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udasdvdisdiquo">ᎤᏓᏍᏛᏗᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsodanvdvsgini">ᏦᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osehehv">ᎣᏎᎮᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgesdi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aguyvdi">ᎠᎫᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaguyisgesdi">ᎢᏣᎫᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dunilvwisdaneha">ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diguyvedi">ᏗᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsaguyvehesdi">ᏕᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvedi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvehesdi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsinotanvdiyi">ᎢᏥᏃᏔᏅᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisgolvdanelv">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvedi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsaguyvehesdi">ᎡᏣᎫᏴᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinayeisdi">ᎡᏥᎾᏰᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinayesgesdi">ᎡᏥᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsilvquododi">ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsilvquodesdi">ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:8

verses.name: Romans 13:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadayonelvgi">ᏣᏓᏲᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadalvgi">ᏣᏓᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanosgisvgi">ᏣᏃᏍᎩᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanohelvgi">ᏣᏃᎮᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsagvvsgesdi">ᏱᏣᎬᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiaquo">ᎯᎠᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igawedv">ᎢᎦᏪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haadotsalvsga">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏙᏣᎸᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquala">ᎤᏍᏆᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kaneisdi">ᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsvsv">ᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadageyusv">ᏂᏣᏓᎨᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigeyusesdi">ᏂᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdadala">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏓᎳ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adageyudi">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinuwaneho">ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadala">ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎳ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adageyudi">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:akaliiha">ᎠᎧᎵᎢᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgvi">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsidigataha">ᏥᏗᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aliyilisvi">ᎠᎵᏱᎵᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeisdiyi">ᎠᏰᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idilihv">ᎢᏗᎵᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uliyeilolv">ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎸ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gohiyeno">ᎪᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:egisdelvdiyi">ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:navniyu">ᎾᎥᏂᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyi">ᎢᎬᏱᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digohiyunvi">ᏗᎪᎯᏳᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Svnoyi">ᏒᏃᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asqualoga">ᎠᏍᏆᎶᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugitsvnidi">ᎤᎩᏨᏂᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidvga">ᏂᏛᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigv">ᎤᎵᏏᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idanuwosda">ᎢᏓᏄᏬᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgasdodo">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga-gadv">ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 13:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idehvi">ᎢᏕᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigeso">ᏂᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlasdino">ᎥᏝᏍᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganawasdi">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᎾᏩᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udayvsdesdi">ᎤᏓᏴᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisidi">ᏗᏂᏏᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nolisina·hisdvna">ᏃᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alenidasdi">ᎠᎴᏂᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlesdino">ᎥᏞᏍᏗᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adisvsdi">ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didadvyutsedi">ᏗᏓᏛᏳᏤᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhisgini">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanuwosda">ᎡᏣᏄᏬᏍᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadvnvisdanelesdi">ᏱᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvvsgv">ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnediyi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.13"/>

verses.name: Romans 14:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigavquo">ᏂᎦᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwalisdayvdodi">ᎬᏩᎵᏍᏓᏴᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyusoi">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏐᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awanagala">ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advsvvsgiquo">ᎠᏛᏒᎥᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdisgoi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvlisaliquo">ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyelvnesdi">ᏳᏰᎸᏁᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nalisdayvhvsgvna">ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nalisdayvhvsgvna">ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiduwugodanelesdi">ᏱᏚᏭᎪᏓᏁᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudanilvtsv">ᏚᏓᏂᎸᏨ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidehiyugodane">ᏥᏕᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidasdi">ᎤᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidohi">ᎤᏅᏏᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgasdodi">ᎤᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadogv">ᎦᏙᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganvgvi">ᎦᏅᎬᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:atsiyosdodanedi">ᎠᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvisdiyi">ᎤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulediyi">ᎤᎴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwanedi">ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulvquodo">ᏄᎸᏉᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigavquo">ᏂᎦᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvquodoi">ᏚᎸᏉᏙᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:akalii">ᎠᎧᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohiyusesdi">ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsunadanvdvi">ᏙᏧᎾᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvquodo">ᏧᎸᏉᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodanehoi">ᎦᎸᏉᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilono">ᎩᎶᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulvquodvna">ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodisgo">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulvquodvna">ᏄᎸᏉᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsalisdayvhvsgoi">ᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvnanehoi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎾᏁᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alihelitsehoi">ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nalisdayvhvsgvna">ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesoi">ᏥᎨᏐᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquododisgo">ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nalisdayvhvsgvna">ᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alihelitsehoi">ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏤᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:7

verses.name: Romans 14:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidalenidoha">ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edalenideha">ᎡᏓᎴᏂᏕᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yididiyohusga">ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ediyohuhiseha">ᎡᏗᏲᎱᎯᏎᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidalenidoha">ᏱᏓᎴᏂᏙᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yididiyohusga">ᏱᏗᏗᏲᎱᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edatseliga">ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwale">ᎤᎬᏩᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuyohusei">ᏧᏲᎱᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidulehisanei">ᏥᏚᎴᎯᏌᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwanosei">ᏧᏩᏃᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohusvhi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinvnodv">ᏗᏅᏃᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dohiyugodaneha">ᏙᎯᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isdalinvtli">ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvlisaliquo">ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ihiyelvsga">ᎢᎯᏰᎸᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:isdalinvtli">ᎢᏍᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyuyeno">ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiditlv">ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigaledi">ᏫᎦᎴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwugododiyi">ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwesgilvi">ᎤᏪᏍᎩᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:12

verses.name: Romans 14:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalenvdv">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yididadadugodanehesdi">ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiasgini">ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyusesdi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsugodisgesdi">ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadodesdisgi">ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ustlvnisdisgi">ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsidiyi">ᎢᏥᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalinvtli">ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulohisdiyi">ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigataha">ᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquohiyudi">ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquvnelv">ᎾᏋᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaha">ᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaha">ᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvsgi">ᎠᏰᎸᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaha">ᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulisdanehoi">ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadanvtli">ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvdigalisdodiha">ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiyadanvdadistanv">ᏱᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adageyudi">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvdiha">ᏴᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·hadvnehvi">ᎿᎭᏛᏁᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:halisdayvhvsgv">ᎭᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hidvdotanvgi">ᎯᏛᏙᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohuhiselvhi">ᎤᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnehv">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usonv">ᎤᏐᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuninohelesdi">ᏳᏂᏃᎮᎴᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdiquo">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aditasdiquo">ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:duyugodvsgini">ᏚᏳᎪᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alihelisdi">ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwvdidegv">ᎤᏮᏗᏕᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advnehesdi">ᎠᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwadanilvisdi">ᏗᎬᏩᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagvwayelvdi">ᎦᎬᏩᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisdawadisesdi">ᎢᏗᏍᏓᏩᏗᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dohi">ᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnehi">ᎢᎬᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digegadalinigohisdodi">ᏗᎨᎦᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsayostanesdi">ᏱᏣᏲᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdiquo">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvtsulisdotanesdi">ᏱᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nudalesvyeno">ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaha">ᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyosgini">ᎤᏲᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvneho">ᎾᏛᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgv">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidigodesdiha">ᏱᏗᎪᏕᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usiyu">ᎤᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hawiya">ᎭᏫᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisdiyi">ᎠᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gigage-aditasdi">ᎩᎦᎨ-ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aditasdiyi">ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advnediyi">ᎠᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadanvtli">ᏗᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwodesdisgi">ᏧᏬᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ustlvnisdisgi">ᎤᏍᏢᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awanagala">ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanehi">ᎢᏳᏩᏁᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohiyudisgo">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tseha">ᏤᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsatselidv">ᏣᏤᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsohiyusesdi">ᏦᎯᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadohisdv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtesdi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvsv">ᎤᏰᎸᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgv">ᎬᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidadadugodanehvna">ᏂᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 14:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutlvwisehi">ᏧᏢᏫᏎᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degugodisgo">ᏕᎫᎪᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usganvtsv">ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yulisdayvnv">ᏳᎵᏍᏓᏴᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgo">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwohiyusvna">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvhvsgvi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigavyeno">ᏂᎦᎥᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdidalehvsgvna">ᏅᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.14"/>

verses.name: Romans 15:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv132"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 15</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv132"/><w xlit="Seq:Ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalinigidv">ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidideliseha">ᏱᏗᏕᎵᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daniwanagalv">ᏓᏂᏩᎾᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniwanagalai">ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvsvquo">ᎢᎬᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igiyelvdi">ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigedadvnelidoha">ᏱᏂᎨᏓᏛᏁᎵᏙᎭ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 15:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nidiv">ᏂᏗᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idisiyvwiha">ᎢᏗᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nav">ᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadala">ᎢᎦᏓᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidadvnehesdi">ᏂᏓᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigohisdiyi">ᎤᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 15:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvyeno">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinadvnehei">ᏱᎾᏛᏁᎮᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hiasgini">ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:nulisdanelei">ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎴᎢ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:gagvwanadasotlvdv">ᎦᎬᏩᎾᏓᏐᏢᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagetsasotlvtanvi">ᎦᎨᏣᏐᏢᏔᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilutselvgi">ᎠᎩᎷᏤᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 15:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nudalesvyeno">ᏄᏓᎴᏒᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:eti">ᎡᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelanvhi">ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadeloquasdi">ᎢᎦᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvse">ᎠᏰᎸᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelanei">ᎪᏪᎳᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didvnidiyu">ᏗᏛᏂᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnehv">ᏂᎬᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugalisdi">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadanvdadisdisgv">ᎢᎦᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:goweli">ᎪᏪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvhi">ᎢᎬᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 15:5

verses.name: Romans 16:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gaya">ᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisquanigodisgi">ᎠᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivquo">ᎾᏂᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugv">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disquanigodisgi">ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:witsiyoliga">ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ilasda">ᎢᎳᏍᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaduhv">ᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ahv">ᎠᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatiya">ᎠᎦᏘᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:witsiyoliga">ᏫᏥᏲᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quoda">ᏉᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 16:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadosdi">ᎤᏓᏙᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseladidohesdi">ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsivi">ᏂᏥᎥᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Emenv">ᎡᎺᏅ</w>.

verses.name: Romans 16:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalinigohisdodi">ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigawesgv">ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseliga">ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agalitsidonvi">ᎠᎦᎵᏥᏙᏅᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnelvhi">ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvhv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagvwadalenvdv">ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adelistanvhi">ᎠᏕᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>,

verses.name: Romans 16:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohisgini">ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnelvhi">ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunowelanvhi">ᏧᏃᏪᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvtanvhi">ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgv">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisquadisgi">ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igegvlvhi">ᎢᎨᎬᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohiyudiyi">ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>—

verses.name: Romans 16:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvhiyu">ᎤᏩᏒᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatanai">ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:galvquododi">ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilvi">ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Emenv">ᎡᎺᏅ</w>.  <chapter eID="Rom.16"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen12" osisID="Rom" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv134"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 1</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv134"/><w xlit="Seq:Quola">ᏉᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquasuyedv">ᎠᏆᏑᏰᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginvsidv">ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtelvi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sosdini">ᏐᏍᏗᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginvtli">ᎢᎩᏅᏟ</w>,

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Witsvyowelasi">ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsanelodi">ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadatlugv">ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Golinidiyi">ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsadatluga">ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisgana">ᎢᏥᏍᎦᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyetsvnelvhi">ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:etsiyanvdv">ᎡᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvti">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degesadisv">ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudov">ᏚᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anineisdisgi">ᎠᏂᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaquo">ᎢᏧᎳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseliga">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseliga">ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsatseli">ᎢᏣᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisgolvtanelvhi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Igidoda">ᎢᎩᏙᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyalielitseho">ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseliga">ᎠᏆᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgo">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinelvhi">ᎡᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsenvistanvhi">ᎢᏤᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalesvi">ᏄᏓᎴᏒᎢ</w>—<w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dideyodi">ᏗᏕᏲᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adedovhisdi">ᎠᏕᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinohelv">ᎠᏥᏃᎮᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagohiyudi">ᎦᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsvnelvi">ᏁᏨᏁᎸᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsohasgvna">ᏂᏦᎭᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sudalegi">ᏑᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unv">ᎤᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalisgolvdanedi">ᎤᏓᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsigatenohv">ᎢᏥᎦᏖᏃᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdatsalinigohistani">ᏨᏓᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisquadisdi">ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgi">ᎬᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayetsuisdodi">ᎦᏰᏧᎢᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalidasdvna">ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyanvdv">ᎢᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaligodiyi">ᎢᏣᎵᎪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvtayoseha">ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudov">ᏚᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdiha">ᎬᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseliga">ᎢᎦᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyiha">ᎤᏠᏱᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsineisdiyi">ᎢᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsagalenvdisgi">ᏗᏣᎦᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsehvna">ᏂᏤᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ukalitsvhiquosgini">ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadudododiyi">ᏗᏣᏚᏙᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyiquo">ᎤᏠᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvtelidohvi">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᎵᏙᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyiquo">ᎤᏠᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsugodisgvi">ᏕᏧᎪᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vginonelvhiyeno">ᎥᎩᏃᏁᎸᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinohesgvi">ᎡᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tloi">ᏠᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinav">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinohesgvi">ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyosdi">ᏗᏥᏲᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisiyvwiha">ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiwesgvi">ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quola">ᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyaligonehi">ᏥᏯᎵᎪᏁᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aquola">ᎠᏉᎳ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Siquasi">ᏏᏆᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ilvsgisgo">ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyatsidvhi">ᎢᏯᏥᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Quolasgo">ᏉᎳᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadahna·hawasdv">ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadvne">ᎠᎦᏛᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisdelvdiyi">ᎢᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:alesgo">ᎠᎴᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quola">ᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudov">ᏚᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsawostanei">ᏕᏣᏬᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyalielitseha">ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdodiha">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehv">ᎢᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiyawovna">ᏂᏥᏯᏬᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tlisqua">ᏟᏍᏆ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gaya">ᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasvquo">ᎤᏩᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudov">ᏚᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadawosdiha">ᏓᏓᏬᏍᏗᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yigvquoseha">ᏱᎬᏉᏎᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sdiquena">ᏍᏗᏇᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinav">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degatsiyawovgi">ᏕᎦᏥᏯᏬᎥᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiquanvta">ᏱᏆᏅᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyawovi">ᏥᏯᏬᎥᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvyeno">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiginvse">ᏱᎩᏅᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquadawosdiyi">ᏗᏆᏓᏬᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aqualitsidodiyisgini">ᎠᏆᎵᏥᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisina·hisdi">ᎠᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gawonihisdiyi">ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvdodiyi">ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvyeno">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudahna·hawadv">ᏧᏓᎿᎭᏩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgalisda">ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dadahna·hawasdvyeno">ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedi">ᎧᏃᎮᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganedv">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvha">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyohuhisdi">ᏧᏂᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:egisdelvdi">ᎡᎩᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigvgv">ᎤᎵᏂᎬᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igiyelvhi">ᎢᎩᏰᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igawela">ᎢᎦᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:datsidvtani">ᏓᏥᏛᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisinasv">ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisinasani">ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequo">ᎠᏎᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagatsiyvneli">ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aneyatahi">ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aneyatahvi">ᎠᏁᏯᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasani">ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digowelisgi">ᏗᎪᏪᎵᏍᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gawonisgv">ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adisvhihi">ᎠᏗᏒᎯᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganedvquo">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinuwanelv">ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasanv">ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasaniyu">ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinuwanisane">ᏥᏄᏩᏂᏌᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisinasanv">ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anvdisgv">ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvwagatahvna">ᏂᎬᏩᎦᏔᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osi">ᎣᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvne">ᎤᏰᎸᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganedv">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alitsidodi">ᎠᎵᏥᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwvdodiyi">ᎤᏮᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsusdelvdiyi">ᏧᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusiyeno">ᎠᏂᏧᏏᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdv">ᎤᏰᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anitayohiha">ᎠᏂᏔᏲᎯᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Anigoino">ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasaniyu">ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyoha">ᎤᏂᏲᎭ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dadahna·hawasdv">ᏓᏓᎿᎭᏩᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadvnvhi">ᎠᎦᏛᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalitsidohvsga">ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunodesdisgi">ᏧᏃᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Anigoino">ᎠᏂᎪᎢᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganedv">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvhi">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na-sgini">Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyanvdv">ᎨᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsulaquo">ᎢᏧᎳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anigoi">ᎠᏂᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyu">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasaniyu">ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyelvhi">ᎤᏂᏰᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Alisganedvyeno">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasina·hi">ᎾᏏᎾᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awanagala">ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nulinigvga">ᏄᎵᏂᎬᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsigowadihayeno">ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏗᎭᏰᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsiyanvhvi">ᎡᏥᏯᏅᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunitsata">ᏳᏂᏣᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisinasani">ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunitsata">ᏳᏂᏣᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunalinigidv">ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunitsata">ᏳᏂᏣᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsilvquodi">ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusuyesv">ᏚᏑᏰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisganisdv">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎦᏂᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyelvhi">ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ane">ᎠᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudehohisdodiyi">ᏧᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatanai">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎾᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusuyesv">ᏚᏑᏰᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwanagala">ᎠᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyelvhi">ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudehohisdodiyi">ᏧᏕᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunalinigidv">ᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohadv">ᎤᏃᎭᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvlisali">ᏅᎵᏌᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyelvhi">ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dusuyesv">ᏚᏑᏰᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanehvna">ᎾᏁᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunalisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaneha">ᏣᏁᎭ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvquisdiyi">ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 1:30

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagoge">ᎦᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugadovso">ᎤᎦᏙᎥᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdvi">ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvweyodi">ᎬᏪᏲᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwalisdodi">ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdv">ᎤᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igeha">ᎢᎨᎭ</w>.  <chapter eID="1Cor.2"/>

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awisgi">ᎠᏫᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ama">ᎠᎹ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdutlisgi">ᎠᏍᏚᏟᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanalisdiha">ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegaguyvedi">ᎨᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseligaya">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegaguyvdanedi">ᎨᎦᎫᏴᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deunilvwisdanelvi">ᏕᎤᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdanelv">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinegvwasdiquo">ᏱᏁᎬᏩᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haunesgehvi">ᎾᎿᎭᎤᏁᏍᎨᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agaguyvedi">ᎠᎦᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelv">ᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyavi">ᎢᏥᏯᎥᎢ</w>?
