verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyostanv">ᏳᏲᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelvi">ᎦᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayuyostani">ᏓᏳᏲᏍᏔᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelv">ᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgina">ᎾᏍᎩᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiadalidastani">ᏥᎠᏓᎵᏓᏍᏔᏂ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahna·hai">ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvwasdi">ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unegu">ᎤᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winigalisda">ᏫᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahna·hai">ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Agadovhisdiyeno">ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ani">ᎠᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisganedvquo">ᎠᎵᏍᎦᏁᏛᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgvi">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igowela">ᎢᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Deganiyiha">ᏕᎦᏂᏱᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahna·hai">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdiha">ᎬᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsv">ᎤᏅᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisinasanvi">ᎠᏂᏏᎾᏌᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Alewo">ᎠᎴᏬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agataha">ᎠᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadanvtesgv">ᎠᎾᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahna·hai">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequoquo">ᎠᏎᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwiquo">ᏴᏫᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidatlvquasdodisgesdi">ᏱᏓᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyuyeno">ᏂᎦᏗᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatseliga">ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:quola">ᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aquola">ᎠᏉᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Siquasi">ᏏᏆᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohuhisdi">ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesesdi">ᏥᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatseliga">ᎢᏣᏤᎵᎦ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 3:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseliga">ᏧᏤᎵᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvno">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>.  <chapter eID="1Cor.3"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv137"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 4</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv137"/><w xlit="Seq:Naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gogadanvtesgv">ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginvsidasdi">ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gogadanvtesgesdi">ᎪᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogagasayasdidegi">ᎣᎦᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unagasayasdidegi">ᎤᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegvso">ᎨᎬᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunadvnediyi">ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadanvtesgv">ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvlisaliquo">ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disgiyugodanediyi">ᏗᏍᎩᏳᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awiquo">ᎠᏫᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwugododi">ᏧᏭᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidigadadugodaneha">ᏱᏗᎦᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎭ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadalawisedi">ᎠᏆᏓᎳᏫᏎᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquudaleha">ᏯᏊᏓᎴᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhisgini">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquugodanehi">ᏗᏊᎪᏓᏁᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsugotanvgi">ᏗᏧᎪᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusqualvhvna">ᏄᏍᏆᎸᎲᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galutsvha">ᎦᎷᏨᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadv">ᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidodagananugowisi">ᏥᏙᏓᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigv">ᎤᎵᏏᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvsgali">ᏗᎬᏍᎦᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodagvneli">ᏂᏙᏓᎬᏁᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninawiyi">ᏧᏂᎾᏫᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadanvtelvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsilvquododi">ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ali">ᎠᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:degatlilosdisgv">ᏕᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaneisda">ᎦᏓᏁᎢᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aquola">ᎠᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsineisda">ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgiyadeloquaediyi">ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᎡᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvtesgv">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsilosvsdodiyi">ᎢᏥᎶᏒᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowelvi">ᎪᏪᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlvquisdiyi">ᎤᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodisgv">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atludisgvi">ᎠᏡᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagoge">ᎦᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvnelv">ᏂᏨᏁᎸ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaha">ᏣᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsanelvna">ᏁᏣᏁᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanelvhi">ᎡᏣᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ihatlvquisga">ᎢᎭᏢᏈᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsanelvnaquo">ᏁᏣᏁᎸᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsikalitsvhi">ᎢᏥᎧᎵᏨᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehna·haiyu">ᎢᏤᎿᎭᎢᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsigvwiyuhi">ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvyaligonelvna">ᏂᏨᏯᎵᎪᏁᎸᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yohi">ᏲᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigvwiyuhi">ᎢᏥᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igigvwiyuhi">ᎢᎩᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadanvtesgvyeno">ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogvnelv">ᏃᎬᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginvsidv">ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oniyi">ᎣᏂᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsogiyohuhisdiyi">ᏦᎩᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:digogakanodiyeno">ᏗᎪᎦᎧᏃᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogalistanv">ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Oginegu">ᎣᎩᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigatahna·hai">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsotsiwanagala">ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalinigidiyu">ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:etsilvquodiyu">ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginiquatihi">ᎣᎩᏂᏆᏘᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:11

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdaya">ᎠᏍᏓᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dogilvwisdanehoi">ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ogvsv">ᎣᎬᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogoyeni">ᏦᎪᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsvdisgo">ᏙᏨᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsadvnehoi">ᎣᏣᏛᏁᎰᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gayogisotlvdisgv">ᎦᏲᎩᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsinetsehoi">ᏙᏥᏁᏤᎰᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogvnehv">ᏃᎬᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otselisgoi">ᎣᏤᎵᏍᎪᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsdeohisdodiyi">ᎢᏨᏍᏕᎣᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigiyelv">ᏱᎩᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsvyowelaneha">ᏥᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:diquetsisgini">ᏗᏇᏥᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgeyui">ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyanvdadisdiha">ᎢᏨᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:15

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:16

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinvsvgi">ᏥᏅᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dimadi">ᏗᎹᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiwadvhvsdiyi">ᎢᏥᏩᏛᎲᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeyui">ᏥᎨᏳᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquetsi">ᎠᏇᏥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyadvnehi">ᎢᏯᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dakahna·hawadegvi">ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsanvdadistani">ᏓᏣᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gedohv">ᎨᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsigahna·hawadegvi">ᏕᏥᎦᎿᎭᏩᏕᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degadeyohvsgv">ᏕᎦᏕᏲᎲᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degesadisv">ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadatluwadisv">ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdatsvlutseli">ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilvna">ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyelvnv">ᏳᏰᎸᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdagadoleosi">ᏮᏓᎦᏙᎴᎣᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwonisgvquo">ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadequvhisdi">ᏧᎾᏕᏋᎯᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dunalinigvgvsgini">ᏚᎾᎵᏂᎬᎬᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdvi">ᏄᏍᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 4:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaduliha">ᎢᏣᏚᎵᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganasda">ᎦᎾᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinei">ᏥᏁᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdatsvlutseli">ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigoge">ᏥᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adageyudiyu">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvti">ᎤᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdatsvlutseli">ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ</w>?  <chapter eID="1Cor.4"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:3

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsadatlisahesdi">ᎢᏣᏓᏟᏌᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdono">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatawadegesdi">ᎠᎦᏔᏩᏕᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyu">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tali">ᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvdesdi">ᎤᏛᏕᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudov">ᏚᏙᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvdodiyi">ᎢᏨᏙᏗᏱ</w>,

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sedani">ᏎᏓᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsiyohisediyi">ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏎᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyoisdiyi">ᎤᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedalvi">ᎤᏇᏓᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udanvdono">ᎤᏓᏅᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdelvdiyi">ᎠᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:6

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinugowa">ᎢᏥᏄᎪᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uweti">ᎤᏪᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agododi">ᎠᎪᏙᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galv">ᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdodiyi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsagolanvna">ᏁᏣᎪᎳᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasquoyeno">ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohiyegi">ᎧᏃᎯᏰᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igiyohuhiselv">ᎢᎩᏲᎱᎯᏎᎸ</w>;

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igisquanigodesdi">ᎢᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dilisdayvdiyi">ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlesdi">ᎥᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uweti">ᎤᏪᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agododi">ᎠᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtlesdi">ᎥᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agododi">ᎠᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nidagotanvnasgini">ᏂᏓᎪᏔᏅᎾᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nutlonasdvna">ᏄᏠᎾᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gayegogi">ᎦᏰᎪᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsvyowelanelvgi">ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsedasdiyi">ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinanisihvsgi">ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:itsedasdiyi">ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadegi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinanisihvsgi">ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigvvsgi">ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvsdi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadagiehi">ᎠᎾᏓᎩᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditlilostanvhi">ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadadolisdanehi">ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdi">ᏱᏄᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinugoisdi">ᎢᏥᏄᎪᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gohisgini">ᎪᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyowelasi">ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsedasdiyi">ᎢᏤᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analinvtli">ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agosehi">ᎠᎪᏎᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisihvsgi">ᏗᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvvsgi">ᎤᎬᎥᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditlilostanvhi">ᏗᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdanehi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adasohehi">ᎠᏓᏐᎮᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyvsdesgi">ᎤᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvsdi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adagiehi">ᎠᏓᎩᎡᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtlasdi">ᎥᏝᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsalisdayvnesdi">ᏱᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᏁᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidigatsiyugodaneha">ᏱᏗᎦᏥᏳᎪᏓᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:doyiditlv">ᏙᏱᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsugodaneho">ᏱᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyai">ᎠᏂᏯᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 5:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Doyiditlvsgini">ᏙᏱᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehi">ᎠᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degugodanehoi">ᏕᎫᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsinugowa">ᎡᏥᏄᎪᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehv">ᎢᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganai">ᎠᏍᎦᎾᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="1Cor.5"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv139"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 6</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv139"/><w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehv">ᎢᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuha">ᏳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyeilidasdodi">ᎤᏰᎢᎵᏓᏍᏙᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yeliquosgo">ᏰᎵᏉᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanadvnehi">ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunolv">ᏚᏃᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidetsadayeilida">ᏱᏕᏣᏓᏰᎢᎵᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvti">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunolvi">ᏚᏃᎸᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvti">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunugodanedi">ᏧᏄᎪᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsugodanedi">ᏗᏧᎪᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kani">ᎧᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsugododi">ᏗᎨᏧᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digedugodanedi">ᏗᎨᏚᎪᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:vtlasgono">ᎥᏝᏍᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogedugoda">ᏱᏙᎨᏚᎪᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiquo">ᎪᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsiha">ᏱᏥᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digugododi">ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiquo">ᎪᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsikahvsgesdi">ᏕᏥᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunugododiyi">ᏧᏄᎪᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsiyelvi">ᎨᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haitsadatlugvi">ᎾᎿᎭᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsadehohisdisgi">ᎢᏣᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsiwea">ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎠ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Howasgo">ᎰᏩᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeha">ᏰᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnv">ᏂᏣᏛᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquounv">ᏌᏉᎤᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahna·hai">ᎠᎦᏔᎿᎭᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwugodanedi">ᏗᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anelinvtli">ᎠᏁᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:danadayeilidohvi">ᏓᎾᏓᏰᎢᎵᏙᎲᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:6

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdi">ᏥᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesviyu">ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatini">ᎤᏣᏘᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnehvi">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsvquo">ᎢᏨᏒᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadayeilidohvi">ᏕᏣᏓᏰᎢᎵᏙᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiyelvsgvna">ᏂᏥᏰᎸᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyetsvnediyi">ᎢᏰᏨᏁᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiyelvsgvna">ᏂᏥᏰᎸᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsigiediyi">ᎡᏥᎩᎡᏗᏱ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utsatinisgini">ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvneha">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsigieha">ᏕᏥᎩᎡᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalinvtli">ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanadvnehi">ᎢᏯᎾᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseli">ᎤᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsilidastanvgi">ᎢᏥᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinanisihvsgi">ᏗᎾᏂᏏᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diyelvhi">ᏗᏰᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadadolisdanehi">ᏗᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadayonehi">ᏗᎾᏓᏲᏁᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsiyegi">ᏗᎨᏥᏰᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgayaquo">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisotlvdisgi">ᏗᏂᏐᏢᏗᏍᎩ</w>,

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninosgisgi">ᎠᏂᏃᏍᎩᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigvvsgi">ᎤᏂᎬᎥᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniyvsdesgi">ᏧᏂᏴᏍᏕᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadasohehi">ᎠᎾᏓᏐᎮᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvsdi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadagiehi">ᎠᎾᏓᎩᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseli">ᎤᎾᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseligohi">ᎤᏤᎵᎪᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsasdvgi">ᏂᏣᏍᏛᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsosulevhi">ᎡᏦᏑᎴᎥᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvti">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyetsvnelvhi">ᎢᏰᏨᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsudaledv">ᎡᏧᏓᎴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudosdvi">ᏚᏙᏍᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvtanvhi">ᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Iganelanvhi">ᎢᎦᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vqueliselv">ᎥᏇᎵᏎᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadasdelvdi">ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vqueliselv">ᎥᏇᎵᏎᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginatlai">ᎠᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquoliyi">ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvnvhi">ᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquoliyi">ᎤᏍᏉᎵᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvnvhi">ᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodvdvtani">ᏙᏛᏛᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsula">ᎢᏧᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquoligi">ᎤᏍᏉᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdayvdi">ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ayelvno">ᎠᏰᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisidi">ᏗᏂᏏᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvnvhi">ᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhisgini">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gotlvnvhi">ᎪᏢᏅᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deuletanv">ᏕᎤᎴᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodagaletani">ᏙᏓᎦᎴᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvtani">ᏓᎬᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyu">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududadewisdvi">ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏛᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigono">ᏥᎪᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ududadewisv">ᎤᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodatsiyanvhi">ᏙᏓᏥᏯᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unegutsidvno">ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadudadewisdodi">ᏧᎾᏚᏓᏕᏫᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagatsiyvneli">ᏅᏓᎦᏥᏴᏁᎵ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Gvwatlisdi">ᎬᏩᏟᏍᏗ</w>!

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlaquosgo">ᏝᏉᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unegutsidv">ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidunadudado">ᏥᏚᎾᏚᏓᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniyelv">ᎠᏂᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigaweha">ᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdisgesdi">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniquedalvi">ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidunadudadoi">ᏥᏚᎾᏚᏓᏙᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanalisdisgoi">ᎾᎾᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Etsalidisi">ᎡᏣᎵᏗᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinisidi">ᏗᏂᏏᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvgv">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnehvna">ᏂᎬᏁᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gilosgini">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidanisihvsgo">ᏥᏓᏂᏏᎲᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asganvtsehoi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏤᎰᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlaquosgo">ᏝᏉᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyelv">ᏗᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganelv">ᎦᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsiyaa">ᏥᏥᏯᎠ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsinelvhi">ᎢᏥᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadatseli">ᎢᏣᏓᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 6:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsugvwalodiyeno">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsiwahistanvhi">ᎡᏥᏩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsilvquodisgesdi">ᎡᏥᎸᏉᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyelv">ᎢᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvdisgesdi">ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanvdo">ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsvdisgesdi">ᏕᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseli">ᏧᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>.  <chapter eID="1Cor.6"/>

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv140"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 7</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv140"/><w xlit="Seq:Nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdasgiyowelanelv">ᏨᏓᏍᎩᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunotlistanvna">ᏄᏃᏟᏍᏔᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelvdv">ᎤᏕᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanisidiyi">ᏧᎾᏂᏏᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisgaya">ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalii">ᏧᎾᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunikahesdi">ᏚᏂᎧᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigeyv">ᎠᏂᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwaniyehi">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunikahesdi">ᏚᏂᎧᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugeyusesdi">ᎤᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugeyudi">ᎤᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugeyusesdi">ᎤᎨᏳᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgvquo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwanedi">ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyehisgini">ᎤᏰᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgvquo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwanedi">ᎢᎬᏩᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:udaliisgini">ᎤᏓᎵᎢᏍᎩᏂ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadageyutanvgi">ᏗᏣᏓᎨᏳᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iditsatsadadvnedi">ᎢᏗᏣᏣᏓᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadayelvnanelvhi">ᏗᏣᏓᏰᎸᎾᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlega">ᏞᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnediyi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadladanvdadediyi">ᎢᏣᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvdiyi">ᎢᏨᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdodi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsilvwisdanediyi">ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talinequo">ᏔᎵᏁᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsadawadisgesdi">ᏙᏣᏓᏩᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sedani">ᏎᏓᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigoliyediyi">ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsalisquanigododi">ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinitsiweha">ᏥᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhiquo">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnediyi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnediyi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinetsvhi">ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utliyeno">ᎤᏟᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvgiyelvdi">ᎬᎩᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivquo">ᎾᏂᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquasdv">ᎾᏆᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinunasdi">ᏱᏄᎾᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatseligaya">ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninelv">ᎤᏂᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unihoi">ᎤᏂᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwi">ᎠᏏᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niusdoi">ᏂᎤᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdoi">ᏄᏍᏙᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigatsiweseha">ᏂᎦᏥᏪᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidanatsehvna">ᏂᏓᎾᏤᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunosulotsvhi">ᏧᏃᏑᎶᏨᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadvnv">ᎾᏆᏛᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvwanadvnv">ᏱᏅᏩᎾᏛᏅ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidanvnivna">ᏂᏓᏅᏂᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:danatsegesdiquo">ᏓᎾᏤᎨᏍᏗᏉ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:utliyeno">ᎤᏟᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvsdiyi">ᏗᏨᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galeyvhisdiyi">ᎦᎴᏴᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dinatsehino">ᏗᎾᏤᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetseha">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayvquo">ᎠᏴᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhisgini">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dekanetseha">ᏕᎧᏁᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudanvelesdi">ᏳᏓᏅᎡᎴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudanvsv">ᏳᏓᏅᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvwadvnesdi">ᏅᏩᏛᏁᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidatsehvna">ᏂᏓᏤᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dohiquo">ᏙᎯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanvnehesdi">ᎾᏅᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigakahvsgesdi">ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anisoisgini">ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayvquo">ᎠᏴᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetseha">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuwekaha">ᏳᏪᎧᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgi">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osiyuno">ᎣᏏᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yayelvsga">ᏯᏰᎸᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unaneladisdiyi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigakahvsgesdi">ᏱᎦᎧᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeha">ᏰᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwohiyusvna">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyuquo">ᎣᏏᏳᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyelvha">ᏳᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unaneladisdiyi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadanvehesdi">ᏯᏓᏅᎡᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nuwohiyusvnayeno">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvgalvdv">ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwohiyusvna">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvgalvdv">ᎤᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsetsi">ᏗᏤᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigadaha">ᎠᏂᎦᏓᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvgalvdv">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᎦᎸᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgininonv">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwohiyusvna">ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudanvsv">ᏳᏓᏅᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvsgesdi">ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginvtli">ᎢᎩᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igido">ᎢᎩᏙ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yududalo">ᏳᏚᏓᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdoi">ᏥᏄᏍᏙᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadediyi">ᎢᎦᏕᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igiyanvhv">ᎢᎩᏯᏅᎲ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadoyeno">ᎦᏙᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalisdodiha">ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ihigataha">ᎢᎯᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:higeyv">ᎯᎨᏴ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gahisdelvdi">ᎦᎯᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayehi">ᏣᏰᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalisdodiha">ᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ihigataha">ᎢᎯᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgaya">ᎯᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gahisdelvdi">ᎦᎯᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadalii">ᏣᏓᎵᎢ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyasgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigayadohelv">ᏥᎦᏯᏙᎮᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiduyanvhv">ᏥᏚᏯᏅᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdesdi">ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anehesdi">ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinetseha">ᏕᏥᏁᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadatluwadisvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyanisgesdi">ᎠᏥᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsiusdeselvna">ᎾᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinulistanesdi">ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiusdeselvhi">ᎠᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyanisgesdi">ᎠᏥᏯᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yatsiusdeselesdi">ᏯᏥᎤᏍᏕᏎᎴᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ahusdesdi">ᎠᎱᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdodi">ᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·husdesvna">ᎾᎱᏍᏕᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdodi">ᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:disquanigododiyisgini">ᏗᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗᏱᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsutseliga">ᏧᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nanivgilo">ᎾᏂᎥᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnvquo">ᏄᏛᏅᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyanvhv">ᎠᏥᏯᏅᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haquo">ᎾᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadvnesdi">ᏅᏩᏛᏁᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Etsayanvhvsgo">ᎡᏣᏯᏅᎲᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsanatlai">ᎡᏣᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyusgininonv">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:netsanatlavna">ᏁᏣᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwalisdodi">ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:higvwiyutanvha">ᎯᎬᏫᏳᏔᏅᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhiyeno">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyanvdv">ᎤᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinatlai">ᎠᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsinatlavna">ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyano">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyanvdv">ᎠᏥᏯᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsinatlavna">ᎾᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatlai">ᎤᎾᏝᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:etsiwahistanvhi">ᎡᏥᏩᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwiquo">ᏴᏫᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digetsinatlai">ᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnvquo">ᏄᏛᏅᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyanvhv">ᎠᏥᏯᏅᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hanvwadvnesdi">ᎾᎿᎭᏅᏩᏛᏁᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dakahna·hawadisvi">ᏓᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidanatsehvna">ᏂᏓᎾᏤᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetsvhi">ᎤᏁᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagiha">ᏯᎩᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvyelvdi">ᎬᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvneha">ᏂᎬᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agidolitsvhi">ᎠᎩᏙᎵᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadvnehi">ᎢᎦᏛᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaqualisdodiyi">ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadanvtesgv">ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliya">ᎠᎩᎵᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tseha">ᏤᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdi">ᏱᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehvi">ᎡᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ageyvsgo">ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:desdadudata">ᏕᏍᏓᏚᏓᏔ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disdadudadesdiyi">ᏗᏍᏓᏚᏓᏕᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayolvgi">ᏣᏲᎸᎩ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ageyvsgo">ᎠᎨᏴᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidisdadudadvna">ᏂᏗᏍᏓᏚᏓᏛᎾ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsayolv">ᏣᏲᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadalii">ᏣᏓᎵᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsadesvna">ᏱᏣᏕᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigahisganvga">ᏱᎦᎯᏍᎦᏅᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adv">ᎠᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidutsenv">ᏱᏚᏤᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvsganvga">ᏱᎬᏍᎦᏅᎦ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunasdi">ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigiliyoisdi">ᎤᏂᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagiquo">ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyeliseha">ᎢᏨᏰᎵᏎᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiasgini">ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usqualahiyu">ᎤᏍᏆᎳᎯᏳ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiaquono">ᎯᎠᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alinohiyaha">ᎠᎵᏃᎯᏯᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadali">ᏧᎾᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsunadaliquo">ᏧᎾᏓᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>,

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinatloyihi">ᏗᎾᏠᏱᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nidanatloyihvnaquo">ᏂᏓᎾᏠᏱᎲᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haanaliheligi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nanaliheligvnaquo">ᎾᎾᎵᎮᎵᎬᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwasgi">ᎤᏂᏩᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nunihvnaquo">ᏄᏂᎲᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anvdisgi">ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatiniquo">ᎤᏣᏘᏂᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinanvnedisgesdi">ᏱᎾᏅᏁᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galosohvsgaquo">ᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎦᏉ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquaduliha">ᎠᏆᏚᎵᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitselihisgvnaquo">ᏂᏤᎵᎯᏍᎬᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdodiyi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalvna">ᏄᏓᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyudvnediyi">ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanediyi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na-sgini">Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udali">ᎤᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyudvnediyi">ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalii">ᎤᏓᎵᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanediyi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:34
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dunadalehna·haa">ᏚᎾᏓᎴᎿᎭᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyehi">ᎠᏥᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:natsiyehvna">ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Natsiyehvna">ᎾᏥᏰᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ageyv">ᎠᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasganvna">ᎾᏍᎦᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvdogihi">ᎤᏓᏅᏙᎩᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:na-sgini">Ꮎ-ᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsiyehi">ᎠᏥᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvtesgo">ᎠᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyudvnediyi">ᎢᏳᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyehi">ᎤᏰᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdi">ᎤᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanediyi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:35
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsv">ᎢᏨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdanedi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquasulisgvi">ᎠᏆᏑᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvsadvvsgvquo">ᎢᏨᏌᏛᎥᏍᎬᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:osiyusgini">ᎣᏏᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvdi">ᎠᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:itsadvnediyi">ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>,] <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsikahna·hawadidasdiyi">ᏤᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiyosdodanehvna">ᏂᏥᏲᏍᏙᏓᏁᎲᎾ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 7:36

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanehi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analisdayvdisgv">ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvquodi">ᏗᎦᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv">ᎠᏥᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gelasdiyi">ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatiyadegi">ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏯᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneladisdisgv">ᎤᏁᎳᏗᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilv">ᎠᏥᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gelasdiyi">ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyaquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwugotanv">ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analitsidohvsgi">ᎠᎾᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisdelvdodiyi">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvtanvhi">ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigowelvga">ᏱᎪᏪᎸᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvquadvnediyi">ᎢᏴᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:utliyeno">ᎤᏟᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaqualisdanedi">ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagiyohusvquo">ᏯᎩᏲᎱᏒᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asequo">ᎠᏎᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinuwanelv">ᏱᏄᏩᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquasdodi">ᎠᏆᏢᏆᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasquoyeno">ᎾᏍᏉᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalitsidohvsga">ᏱᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagiha">ᏯᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdodi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Aseyeno">ᎠᏎᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquadvnedi">ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvquvnelv">ᏅᏋᏁᎸ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaqualisdanedi">ᎢᏯᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalitsidohvsgvna">ᏂᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvnvhi">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigadvneha">ᏱᏂᎦᏛᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquaguyveha">ᎥᏆᎫᏴᎡᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvnvhi">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquasvgalotanv">ᎥᏆᏒᎦᎶᏔᏅ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vquaguyvedi">ᎥᏆᎫᏴᎡᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galitsidohvsgesdi">ᎦᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏋᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyaquadvnediyi">ᎢᏯᏆᏛᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquasvgalv">ᎠᏆᏒᎦᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gilosgininonv">ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginatlai">ᎠᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginatlai">ᎬᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadadvnelv">ᎾᏆᏓᏛᏁᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyanii">ᎢᏯᏂᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotsediyi">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsitsusi">ᏥᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualistanvgi">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotsediyi">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nano">ᎾᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanuyvdi">ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaquadanuyvdo">ᏣᏆᏓᏄᏴᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotsediyi">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanuyvdi">ᎤᎾᏓᏄᏴᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadanuyvdvna">ᏄᎾᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadanuyvdvna">ᎾᏆᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotsediyi">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadanuyvdvna">ᏄᎾᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadanuyvdvna">ᎾᏆᏓᏄᏴᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquadanuyvdisgini">ᎠᏆᏓᏄᏴᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahvi">ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Diniwanagala">ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahv">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanagala">ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualistanvgi">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniwanagala">ᏗᏂᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvginequotsediyi">ᎬᎩᏁᏉᏤᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nigavquo">ᏂᎦᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalesv">ᏄᏓᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualistanv">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadalesv">ᏄᎾᏓᎴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigatahvi">ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayulisdodiyi">ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igadv">ᎢᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsisdelvdiyi">ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadvneho">ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgoi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haaqueladisgi">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏇᎳᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigata">ᏱᏥᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadogiyasgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎩᏯᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadogiyasgvi">ᎠᎾᏙᎩᏯᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwiquo">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdisgv">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asasdvi">ᎠᏌᏍᏛᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdesdi">ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadogiyasgesdi">ᎢᏣᏙᎩᏯᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatseli">ᎢᏣᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadasegogisdiyi">ᎤᎾᏓᏎᎪᎩᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanatlinigvneho">ᏣᎾᏟᏂᎬᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisquanigodiyu">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayogiquo">ᎠᏲᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisdulo">ᎠᎵᏍᏚᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvnediyi">ᎨᏥᏅᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadulisgoi">ᎤᎾᏚᎵᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvsgini">ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayogi">ᎠᏲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 9:26

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alihelisdi">ᎠᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdayvhvsga">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nayo">ᎾᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginoheha">ᎥᎩᏃᎮᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigalieliga">ᏥᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:16

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:18

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudvnele">ᏄᏛᏁᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unalisdayvnonv">ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏃᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulisquidi">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugisei">ᎤᎩᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwesei">ᏄᏪᏎᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itse">ᎢᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanohedv">ᎧᏃᎮᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datlohisdvi">ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agigigv">ᎠᎩᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdvsdayidi">ᏨᏛᏍᏓᏱᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsadvnehesdi">ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyusdiha">ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaditasgesdi">ᎢᏣᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgiyanvdadisgvi">ᏍᎩᏯᏅᏓᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvnehesdi">ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisgesdi">ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadu">ᎦᏚ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aditasgesdi">ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisquidi">ᎤᎵᏍᏈᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asganvtsehesdi">ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏤᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugigv">ᎤᎩᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Giloyeno">ᎩᎶᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadvnehesdi">ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisgesdi">ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aditasgesdi">ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agisgesdi">ᎠᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aditasgesdi">ᎠᏗᏔᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwugodanehi">ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usganvtsvi">ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nagowatisgvna">ᎾᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvnoheheha">ᎢᏨᏃᎮᎮᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Udanvdo">ᎤᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvdi">ᏱᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigawoniha">ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsisginvdvhi">ᎠᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvdv">ᏴᎬᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvdv">ᏴᎬᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvni">ᎬᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvdiha">ᏱᎬᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsudalenvdvsgininonv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisgolvtanvhi">ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanilvwisdanedi">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igegvnedi">ᎢᎨᎬᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvwanilvwisdanedi">ᏗᎬᏩᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igegvnehi">ᎢᎨᎬᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanivi">ᎾᏂᎥᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvnigesvsgini">ᎬᏂᎨᏒᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnehv">ᏂᎬᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsineha">ᎨᏥᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvdodiyi">ᎤᏅᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Asiyvwiyeno">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgolvdanelvhi">ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asinasdv">ᎠᏏᎾᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwonihisdiyi">ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatanai">ᎠᎦᏔᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igagadv">ᎢᎦᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwonihisdiyi">ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgolvdanelvhi">ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgolvdanelvhi">ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsineho">ᎠᏥᏁᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudanvwodiyi">ᏧᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgolvdanelvhi">ᎤᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvwisdanediyi">ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udolehohisdiyi">ᎤᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didanvdo">ᏗᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunasdv">ᏄᎾᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugoliyediyi">ᏧᎪᎵᏰᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvsgi">ᎢᎸᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalegi">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwonihisdiyi">ᏧᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadaleno">ᏅᏩᏓᎴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetlvdodiyi">ᏧᏁᏢᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonihisdi">ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deulvwisdanehoi">ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dayadoheho">ᏓᏯᏙᎮᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelagiha">ᏧᎾᏁᎳᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunatseli">ᏧᎾᏤᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hiaquo">ᎯᎠᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdesdi">ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elisgvi">ᎡᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayelvyeno">ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiduwitlewisv">ᏥᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlewisv">ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigalisdiha">ᏥᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdi">ᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Saquohiyeno">ᏌᏉᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidiv">ᏂᏗᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsegawovhi">ᏤᎦᏬᎥᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyegvnelvhi">ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Iditsusi">ᎢᏗᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digadalenvdv">ᏗᎦᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tseginatlai">ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tseginatlai">ᏤᎩᎾᏝᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidiv">ᏂᏗᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igaditasdiyi">ᎢᎦᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyegvnelvhi">ᎢᏰᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayelvyeno">ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwitlewisv">ᎤᏫᏞᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsatisgini">ᎤᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlewisvi">ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:olasideni">ᎣᎳᏏᏕᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinuwesv">ᏱᏄᏪᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquatitla">ᏯᏆᏘᏝ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgo">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yutitla">ᏳᏘᏝ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agaleni">ᎠᎦᎴᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinuwesv">ᏱᏄᏪᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agata">ᎠᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquatitla">ᏯᏆᏘᏝ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgo">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎪ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yutitla">ᏳᏘᏝ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigv">ᏂᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agata">ᎠᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advgododi">ᎠᏛᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigv">ᏂᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:advgododi">ᎠᏛᎪᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:owewasvisdodiyi">ᎣᏪᏩᏒᎢᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlewisv">ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoha">ᏌᏉᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haayelv">ᎾᎿᎭᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvnvi">ᎤᏰᎸᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwitlv">ᎤᏫᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hatlv">ᎭᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utsatisgini">ᎤᏣᏘᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deuwitlewisv">ᏕᎤᏫᏞᏫᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquoquo">ᏌᏉᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agata">ᎠᎦᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvwawesedi">ᎢᎬᏩᏪᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwoyeni">ᎤᏬᏰᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvyaduliha">ᏱᎬᏯᏚᎵᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:alewo">ᎠᎴᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgoli">ᎠᏍᎪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idigvwawesedi">ᎢᏗᎬᏩᏪᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulasideni">ᏧᎳᏏᏕᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidisdvyasuliha">ᏱᏗᏍᏛᏯᏑᎵᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsehi">ᏤᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idiwanagala">ᎢᏗᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinvwasdoi">ᏥᏅᏩᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisgedv">ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:23

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwitlv">ᎤᏫᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yagiliyoga">ᏯᎩᎵᏲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlv">ᏚᏫᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatloyasdiha">ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anigiliyoga">ᎠᏂᎩᎵᏲᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwitlv">ᎤᏫᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquotanvhi">ᎦᎸᏉᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlv">ᏚᏫᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unatloyasdiha">ᎤᎾᏠᏯᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analiheliga">ᎠᎾᎵᎮᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvi">ᎠᏰᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwitlewisvi">ᏚᏫᏞᏫᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsisiyvwiha">ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deuwekanv">ᏕᎤᏪᎧᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anisiyvwiha">ᎠᏂᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hatsunanelodi">ᎾᎿᎭᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugvi">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidv">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:talineno">ᏔᎵᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsoineno">ᏦᎢᏁᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dinadeyohvsgi">ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:onino">ᎣᏂᏃ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanehi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquono">ᎿᎭᏉᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegalisgolvdanelvhi">ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadanvwodiyi">ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:analisdelisgi">ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusadegi">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ilvsgi">ᎢᎸᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalegi">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniwonisgi">ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidv">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anadolehosgi">ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinadeyohvsgi">ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanehi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 12:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunadanvwodiyi">ᏧᎾᏓᏅᏬᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gegalisgolvdanelvhi">ᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvsgi">ᎢᎸᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudalegi">ᎢᏳᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daniwoniha">ᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigadvsgo">ᏂᎦᏛᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ananetlvdiha">ᎠᎾᏁᏢᏗᎭ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:5

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:6

verses.name: I Corinthians 13:8
