verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsaduli">ᏥᏣᏚᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanedi">ᎤᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsiyohesdi">ᎢᏥᏲᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadadalinehidediyi">ᏗᏣᏓᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugv">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsalinigohisdodiyi">ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwonihisdi">ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gawonisgesdi">ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdisgesdi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atayohihesdi">ᎠᏔᏲᎯᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsisdelvdiyi">ᎠᏥᏍᏕᎸᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unetlvdodiyi">ᎤᏁᏢᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigadadolisdi">ᏱᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvdiha">ᏱᎬᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwonihisdi">ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adadolisdisgoi">ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdvsgini">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigananugowisgo">ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:howa">ᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgesdi">ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadadolisdisgesdi">ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagolisdi">ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadadolisdisgesdi">ᎦᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdisgesdi">ᎬᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinogisgesdi">ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagolisdi">ᎦᎪᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsinogisgesdi">ᏕᏥᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:halihelitsv">ᎭᎵᎮᎵᏨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsadanvdo">ᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hvtanvha">ᎲᏔᏅᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigalisdoda">ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagatanavna">ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwediyi">ᎤᏪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuwola">ᏳᏬᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Emenv">ᎡᎺᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadv">ᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:haliheligi">ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:nigoligvnayeno">ᏂᎪᎵᎬᎾᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niwesgvi">ᏂᏪᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nihiyeno">ᏂᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niweha">ᏂᏪᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:haliheligvi">ᎭᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:soisgini">ᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yulinigohisdiha">ᏳᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsiyalielitseha">ᏥᏯᎵᎡᎵᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aquanelanvhi">ᎠᏆᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvgiwonihisdi">ᏗᎬᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonihisdi">ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esgaquo">ᎡᏍᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsivi">ᏂᏥᎥᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugv">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvgiyelvdi">ᎬᎩᏰᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hahisgiquo">ᎾᎿᎭᎯᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikanetsvhi">ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agineisdiyi">ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdv">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvdodiyi">ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsiyeyodiyi">ᎦᏥᏰᏲᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgohi">ᎠᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyagayvli">ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ikanetsvhi">ᎢᎧᏁᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agineisdiyi">ᎠᎩᏁᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniwonihisdi">ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvdodiyi">ᎠᏋᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyoli">ᏗᏥᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigesesdi">ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvdvi">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:adasgaisdisgininonv">ᎠᏓᏍᎦᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsiyoli">ᏗᏥᏲᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:detsadanvdvsgini">ᏕᏣᏓᏅᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadvnaya">ᏗᏣᏛᎾᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dikahna·hawadvsdiyi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnv">ᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gowela">ᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniwonisgi">ᏗᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunihanegali">ᏧᏂᎭᏁᎦᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatsiyvtani">ᏓᎦᏥᏴᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadatsiwonetani">ᎦᏓᏥᏬᏁᏔᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvquadvganehesdi">ᏱᎬᏆᏛᎦᏁᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adiha">ᎠᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yihowa">ᏱᎰᏩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonihisdi">ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudisgi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelvha">ᎠᏰᎸᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unohiyudanehi">ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asgini">ᎠᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:adolehohisdisgini">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgi">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:unohiyudanehi">ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏓᏁᎯ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgisgini">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdi">ᏥᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugv">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhitlv">ᎢᎸᎯᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidunilawitsonv">ᏱᏚᏂᎳᏫᏦᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonihisdi">ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidaniwoniha">ᏱᏓᏂᏬᏂᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yuniyvlilvno">ᏳᏂᏴᎵᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hani">ᎾᎿᎭᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanigatanavna">ᎾᏂᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anohiyuhvsgini">ᎠᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilvnotiha">ᏚᏂᎸᏃᏘᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgvnadv">ᏴᎬᎾᏛ</w>?

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgini">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanadolehosga">ᏯᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yuyvlilvno">ᏳᏴᎵᎸᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgi">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagatanavna">ᎾᎦᏔᎾᎥᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwohiyudanehoi">ᎬᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvwugodanehoi">ᏕᎬᏭᎪᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udelidv">ᎤᏕᎵᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodv">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unawiyi">ᎤᎾᏫᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigalisda">ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaliyesduhvga">ᏯᎵᏰᏍᏚᎲᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yadadolisdasi">ᏯᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yideganotsalvga">ᏱᏕᎦᏃᏣᎸᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadasuyvi">ᎢᏣᏓᏑᏴᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:howa">ᎰᏩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsilawigi">ᏕᏥᎳᏫᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsisiyvwiha">ᎢᏥᏏᏴᏫᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikanogidv">ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnvisdoi">ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dideyodi">ᏗᏕᏲᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnvisdoi">ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digawonihisdi">ᏗᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnvisdoi">ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnedi">ᎢᎬᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnvisdoi">ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anetlvdodi">ᎠᏁᏢᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvnvisdoi">ᎢᏣᏛᏅᎢᏍᏙᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsilvwisdanehv">ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadalinigohisdodiyi">ᏗᏣᏓᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwalesdi">ᎤᎬᏩᎴᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwanadale">ᏅᏩᎾᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuniwonihisdi">ᏧᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigawoniha">ᏱᎦᏬᏂᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anitali">ᎠᏂᏔᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoi">ᏦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyvdv">ᎢᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wasdesdi">ᏩᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daniwonisegesdi">ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏎᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwesvdv">ᎤᏪᏒᏛ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:asiyvwino">ᎠᏏᏴᏫᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anetlvdisgesdi">ᎠᏁᏢᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 14:28

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodesdi">ᏚᏳᎪᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquenvsdiyi">ᎠᏇᏅᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dayotsenvstani">ᏓᏲᏤᏅᏍᏔᏂ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wvdatsvlutseli">ᏮᏓᏨᎷᏤᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Masidoni">ᎹᏏᏙᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilosvhi">ᎠᎩᎶᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:masidoniyeno">ᎹᏏᏙᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayeli">ᎠᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilohisdiyi">ᎠᎩᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdiha">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigvquadedi">ᏫᎬᏆᏕᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigagi">ᏱᏂᎦᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquagoladiyv">ᏯᏆᎪᎳᏗᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgiyatinvsdiyi">ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaisv">ᎦᎢᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvhitlv">ᎢᎸᎯᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsigadvi">ᏫᏥᎦᏛᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquaduli">ᏯᏆᏚᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaisv">ᎦᎢᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgowadvdiyi">ᎢᏨᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvha">ᎠᏋᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ilvsgi">ᎢᎸᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igohidv">ᎢᎪᎯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyadenediyi">ᎢᏨᏯᏕᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyelvnv">ᏳᏰᎸᏅ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Equisasgini">ᎡᏈᏌᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gedohesdi">ᎨᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgasgohine">ᎯᏍᎦᏍᎪᎯᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyasdi">ᎢᏯᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Equohiyuyeno">ᎡᏉᎯᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgilanvdadelv">ᎥᎩᎳᏅᏓᏕᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagvdodi">ᎦᎬᏙᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsata">ᎤᏂᏣᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dinigatilegi">ᏗᏂᎦᏘᎴᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dimadi">ᏗᎹᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigalutsvha">ᏫᎦᎷᏨᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsagasayasdesdi">ᎢᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niganayesgvnaquo">ᏂᎦᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseladidasdiyi">ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dulvwisdaneyeno">ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanedi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utloyiquo">ᎤᏠᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuniquatihesdi">ᏳᏂᏆᏘᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadvquosgini">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsetsanigistanvha">ᏤᏣᏂᎩᏍᏔᏅᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agilutsediyi">ᎠᎩᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsigatenohayeno">ᏥᎦᏖᏃᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uluhisdiyi">ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analinvtli">ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anilutsvha">ᎠᏂᎷᏨᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aquola">ᎠᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginvtli">ᎢᎩᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsisdiyeda">ᏥᏍᏗᏰᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsilutsediyi">ᏫᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unenvsdodiyi">ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analinvtli">ᎠᎾᎵᏅᏟ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudulv">ᏳᏚᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwenvsdiyi">ᎤᏪᏅᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:wvdagalutsi">ᏮᏓᎦᎷᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udladanvdadelvha">ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏓᏕᎸᎭ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsiyawisgesdi">ᎢᏥᏯᏫᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsiniyvsesdi">ᏕᏥᏂᏴᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsisgaya">ᎢᏥᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ditsalinigidiyu">ᏗᏣᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsilvwisdanehv">ᏕᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adageyudi">ᎠᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvdisgesdi">ᎢᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Alewo">ᎠᎴᏬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:detsigataha">ᏕᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sdiquena">ᏍᏗᏇᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinavi">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyi">ᎢᎬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udatanvhi">ᎤᏓᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Agaya">ᎠᎦᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadayosv">ᏚᎾᏓᏲᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunisdelvhidasdiyi">ᏧᏂᏍᏕᎸᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvti">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ</w>;

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itsvtayoseha">ᎢᏨᏔᏲᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsohiyudiyi">ᏗᏦᎯᏳᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunasdi">ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naniv">ᎾᏂᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunilvwisdanehi">ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:analinigvnehi">ᎠᎾᎵᏂᎬᏁᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galieliga">ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvgilutselv">ᎬᎩᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Sdiquena">ᏍᏗᏇᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quoduneda">ᏉᏚᏁᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Agayiga">ᎠᎦᏱᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihiyeno">ᏂᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsilulotsehvgi">ᏥᏥᎷᎶᏤᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anikalisisa">ᎠᏂᎧᎵᏏᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anigalisdadayeno">ᎠᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏓᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanvdo">ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsilvquodesdiquo">ᏕᏥᎸᏉᏕᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunasdi">ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadatluwadisv">ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Esiyi">ᎡᏏᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigetsiyoliha">ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Equila">ᎡᏈᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quisila">ᏈᏏᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigetsiyoliha">ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadayolisdi">ᎤᎾᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvwanaligoneha">ᎬᏩᎾᎵᎪᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadatlugv">ᎤᎾᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aninelvi">ᎠᏂᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigetsiyoliha">ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎭ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Detsadayolisdisgesdi">ᏕᏣᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didadowedovsdi">ᏗᏓᏙᏪᏙᎥᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Quola">ᏉᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadayolisdi">ᎠᏆᏓᏲᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquoyeni">ᎠᏉᏰᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvtanvhi">ᎠᏋᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquowelanvhi">ᎠᏉᏪᎳᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugeyusvna">ᏄᎨᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igesesdi">ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsisginvdvhi">ᎠᏥᏍᎩᏅᏛᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagalutsi">ᏓᎦᎷᏥ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsikahna·hawadidohesdi">ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: I Corinthians 16:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadageyudi">ᎠᏆᏓᎨᏳᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsikahna·hawadidohesdi">ᏕᏥᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsivi">ᏂᏥᎥᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgesdi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Emenv">ᎡᎺᏅ</w>.  <chapter eID="1Cor.16"/> <div canonical="true" eID="gen13" osisID="1Cor" type="book"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv150"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 1</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv150"/><w xlit="Seq:Quola">ᏉᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginvsidv">ᎠᎩᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtelvi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dimadi">ᏗᎹᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginvtli">ᎢᎩᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:witsvyowelasi">ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsanelodi">ᏗᏣᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadatlugv">ᎢᏣᏓᏡᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Golinidiyi">ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsadatlugv">ᏥᏣᏓᏡᎬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvti">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvnadv">ᏂᎬᎾᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Agaya">ᎠᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udadolisdi">ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itseladidohesdi">ᎢᏤᎳᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayunalisgolvtanvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Igidoda">ᎢᎩᏙᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:3

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsigiliyoga">ᏲᏥᎩᎵᏲᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsigalisdadisdi">ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdelvdodi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwala">ᎤᎬᏩᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsiwadveha">ᏥᏥᏩᏛᎡᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsvnidiyu">ᏗᏨᏂᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigiliyoisdiyi">ᎢᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsigiliyogv">ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyi">ᎤᏠᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugalisdi">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yogadanvta">ᏲᎦᏓᏅᏔ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsigalisdadisdi">ᎢᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏗᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalisdelvdodi">ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwala">ᎤᎬᏩᎳ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyvsv">ᎢᏨᏴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyu">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsigataha">ᏦᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatloyasdisgv">ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliyoisdi">ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsatloyasdodi">ᎢᏣᏠᏯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugalisdi">ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yogaduliha">ᏲᎦᏚᎵᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nitsigatahvnaquo">ᏂᏥᎦᏔᎲᎾᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udeyadodi">ᎤᏕᏯᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogilutselv">ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Esiyi">ᎡᏏᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvstanvhi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagedv">ᎦᎨᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogilutselvi">ᎣᎩᎷᏤᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ulosvstanvhi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidogalinigvgvi">ᏂᏙᎦᎵᏂᎬᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdagalisdodisgvgi">ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogalvyolilvgi">ᎣᎦᎸᏲᎵᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogadvnidisdiyi">ᏦᎦᏛᏂᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:9

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:11

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:12

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadale">ᏅᏩᏓᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsvyowelaneha">ᏱᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitsigataha">ᏥᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidetsadanilvtsv">ᏥᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvha">ᎠᏋᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvlisquadisgi">ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanilvisdiyi">ᏗᏣᏓᏂᎸᎢᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquohiyusv">ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtelvgi">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasqualisgvna">ᎾᏍᏆᎵᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsvlutsediyi">ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisodiyi">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏐᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvdadisdiyi">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsvloisdanediyi">ᏫᏨᎶᎢᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Masidoni">ᎹᏏᏙᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wagiluhisdiyi">ᏩᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Masidoni">ᎹᏏᏙᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diganigisv">ᏗᎦᏂᎩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdatsvlutsediyi">ᏅᏓᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsudiyi">ᏧᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsigadv">ᏫᏥᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgiyatinvsdiyi">ᏍᎩᏯᏘᏅᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdv">ᏥᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsaquadanvtelvgi">ᏣᏆᏓᏅᏖᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvlisaliquosgo">ᏅᎵᏌᎵᏉᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvhi">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesei">ᎨᏎᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadanvdvli">ᎦᏓᏅᏛᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udanvtedi">ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadatesgoi">ᎦᏓᏖᏍᎪᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinegv">ᏥᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hiaquo">ᎯᎠᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinusdi">ᏱᏄᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w>?

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhisgini">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalidasdvna">ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:nudohiyuha">ᏄᏙᎯᏳᎭ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvnetsehv">ᎢᏨᏁᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Uwetsi">ᎤᏪᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehv">ᎢᏤᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyalitsidonelvhi">ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Siliwena">ᏏᎵᏪᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Dimadi">ᏗᎹᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyalitsidonelvhi">ᎢᏨᏯᎵᏥᏙᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvdiyi">ᎤᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yogadvnei">ᏲᎦᏛᏁᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vvsgini">ᎥᎥᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvdiyi">ᎤᏛᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogvnelvgi">ᏃᎬᏁᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nagadvyeno">ᎾᎦᏛᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uduistanvi">ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vv">ᎥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdvdi">ᎬᏛᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:geso">ᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsilvquododiyi">ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyogvnediyi">ᎢᏲᎬᏁᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalinigohisdisgi">ᏗᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:edatseliga">ᎡᏓᏤᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igilonevhi">ᎢᎩᎶᏁᎥᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igiyelvtanvhi">ᎢᎩᏰᎸᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iginelvhi">ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diginawiyi">ᏗᎩᎾᏫᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatidisdodi">ᎠᎦᏘᏗᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsitayoseha">ᏥᏔᏲᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatahi">ᎠᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvdo">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyudanediyi">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgeyuvsgv">ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎥᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgv">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Golinidiyi">ᎪᎵᏂᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:winitsilugvna">ᏫᏂᏥᎷᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 1:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyadanvtehehi">ᎢᏨᏯᏓᏅᏖᎮᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyusvi">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:otsisdelisgiquosgini">ᎣᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsaliheligvi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:itsohiyusvyeno">ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdodi">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asi">ᎠᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidetsidoga">ᏥᏕᏥᏙᎦ</w>.  <chapter eID="2Cor.1"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv151"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 2</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv151"/><w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdvgi">ᏄᏍᏛᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daquugotanvgi">ᏓᏊᎪᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsvlutsediyi">ᏫᏨᎷᏤᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvquadanvti">ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏘ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsvyadanvdadistanv">ᏱᏨᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osdv">ᎣᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquadanvdadisda">ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiquo">ᎾᏍᎩᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyadanvdadistanvhi">ᏥᏯᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w>?

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdv">ᏥᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiwitsvyowelanelvgi">ᏥᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdiquo">ᏞᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hawitsilutsvha">ᎾᎿᎭᏫᏥᎷᏨᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigvquadanvdadistanesdi">ᏱᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏁᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulihelisdi">ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvquadanvdadisdodi">ᎬᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquelisvgi">ᎠᏇᎵᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nitsivquo">ᏂᏥᎥᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvyoiyuha">ᎢᏨᏲᎢᏳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualihelisdisgv">ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiv">ᏂᏥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsalihelisdisgvi">ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utsatiyeno">ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiliya">ᎠᎩᎵᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtawadegv">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:witsvyowelanelvgi">ᏫᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digatsigasawoihi">ᏗᎦᏥᎦᏌᏬᎢᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadanvdadisdodi">ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquelisei">ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:itsigadovhisdiyiquosgini">ᎢᏥᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏗᏱᏉᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatanvhi">ᎤᏣᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgeyuiyu">ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyusgininonv">ᎢᏳᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudanvdadistanvhi">ᏧᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayvquo">ᎠᏴᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquadanvdadistanv">ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihisgini">ᏂᎯᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiv">ᏂᏥᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeli">ᏰᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadanvdadistanv">ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏔᏅ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsilosvsdanediyi">ᏥᎶᏒᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsilawisehvi">ᏥᎳᏫᏎᎲᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aliquo">ᎠᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:nvsdvdvi">ᏅᏍᏛᏛᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvwasdvdistanv">ᏥᎬᏩᏍᏛᏗᏍᏔᏅ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yetsidolitsvquo">ᏰᏥᏙᎵᏨᏉ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yetsigalisdadv">ᏰᏥᎦᎵᏍᏓᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:yinvsegagi">ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyelvsv">ᎤᏰᎸᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yunoyvtisda">ᏳᏃᏴᏘᏍᏓ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:8

verses.name: II Corinthians 2:9

verses.name: II Corinthians 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv152"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 3</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv152"/><w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsaleni">ᎣᏣᎴᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogvsv">ᎣᎬᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsadalvquodiha">ᎣᏣᏓᎸᏉᏗᎭ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tsigoge">ᏥᎪᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widitsvnohedi">ᏫᏗᏨᏃᎮᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogalisdaneha">ᏃᎦᎵᏍᏓᏁᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:goweli">ᎪᏪᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogilvquodisgi">ᎣᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinunalisdanehoi">ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disginvnelvhi">ᏗᏍᎩᏅᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgilvquodisgi">ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏗᏍᎩ</w>?

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogvsv">ᎣᎬᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yotsadanoheha">ᏲᏣᏓᏃᎮᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalitsidohvsgvi">ᎣᏣᎵᏥᏙᎲᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvsgini">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginvsidasdi">ᎣᎩᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgvi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetse">ᏧᏁᏤ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igagati">ᎢᎦᎦᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigv">ᎤᎵᏏᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsulvsadadisdiyi">ᏧᎸᏌᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:dulvsadadilv">ᏚᎸᏌᏓᏗᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoginawiyi">ᏦᎩᎾᏫᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oginediyi">ᎣᎩᏁᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga-gati">ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agadovhisdodi">ᎠᎦᏙᎥᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseliga">ᎤᏤᎵᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ukadv">ᎤᎧᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsvdidalehvsga">ᏨᏗᏓᎴᎲᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsugvwalodi">ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaquo">ᎦᏓᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digotlvtanvhi">ᏗᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degilodi">ᏕᎩᎶᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtlano">ᎥᏝᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:9

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsiyelv">ᏦᏥᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsiyidoho">ᎣᏥᏱᏙᎰ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyohusv">ᎤᏲᎱᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnv">ᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsiyelvi">ᏦᏥᏰᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ayvyeno">ᎠᏴᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotseha">ᏦᏤᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilvquo">ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogiyohusidena">ᏦᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogisdvdisgvi">ᎣᎩᏍᏛᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnv">ᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayohusgi">ᎠᏲᎱᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogiquedalvi">ᎣᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Utloyiquo">ᎤᏠᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogiha">ᏦᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudodi">ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigvnv">ᏥᏂᎬᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigowela">ᏥᎪᏪᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aquohiyunv">ᎠᏉᎯᏳᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginetsv">ᎠᎩᏁᏨ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsohiyuhvsga">ᎣᏦᎯᏳᎲᏍᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsinega">ᎣᏥᏁᎦ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Otsigatahayeno">ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuletanvhi">ᏧᎴᏔᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agvdisgv">ᎠᎬᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dodayogaletani">ᏙᏓᏲᎦᎴᏔᏂ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihino">ᏂᎯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:widigiyosihisdi">ᏫᏗᎩᏲᏏᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:15

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidogiyawega">ᏱᏙᎩᏯᏪᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhisgininonv">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gaduiditlv">ᎦᏚᎢᏗᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogiwanagalotseha">ᎣᎩᏩᎾᎦᎶᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hawiniditlvsgini">ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogalinigohiseha">ᎣᎦᎵᏂᎪᎯᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidadodaquisvi">ᏂᏓᏙᏓᏈᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udasakayeno">ᎤᏓᏌᎧᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsigiliyogv">ᎣᏥᎩᎵᏲᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tlegaquo">ᏞᎦᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogiwadveha">ᎣᎩᏩᏛᎡᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvstanvhi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyudagedv">ᎢᏳᏓᎨᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:alisquadisgi">ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 4:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nidotsakanisgvna">ᏂᏙᏣᎧᏂᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvgowadvdi">ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvgowadvdi">ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyeno">ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvgowadvdi">ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalosohvsgi">ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgisgini">ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvgowadvdi">ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalosohvsgi">ᏗᎦᎶᏐᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>.  <chapter eID="2Cor.4"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv154"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 5</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv154"/><w xlit="Seq:Otsigatahayeno">ᎣᏥᎦᏔᎭᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:elohi">ᎡᎶᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsinelv">ᎣᏥᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogilitsodv">ᎣᎩᎵᏦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyotsv">ᏳᏲᏨ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ogiha">ᎣᎩᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanelv">ᎠᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:adanelv">ᎠᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuwoyi">ᏧᏬᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digvtanvhi">ᏗᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:anesgehvhi">ᎠᏁᏍᎨᎲᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayogi">ᎠᏲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvloi">ᎦᎸᎶᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:didanelv">ᏗᏓᏁᎸ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aniyeno">ᎠᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsiyav">ᎣᏥᏯᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogiliyediha">ᎣᎩᎵᏰᏗᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogaduliha">ᎣᎦᏚᎵᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:oganuwosdodiyi">ᎣᎦᏄᏬᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsinelv">ᎣᏥᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvlo">ᎦᎸᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayudalenvhi">ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 5:3

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:4

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:5

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:6

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsogadanvtawadego">ᏦᎦᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yano">ᏯᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsaliheligoi">ᎣᏣᎵᎮᎵᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinogadvhna·hadego">ᏥᏃᎦᏛᎿᎭᏕᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unitsati">ᎤᏂᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotsenvisdisgoi">ᏙᏤᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nogihvna">ᏃᎩᎲᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadiyu">ᏂᎦᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ogatseliga">ᎣᎦᏤᎵᎦ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Detsvsdugielv">ᏕᏨᏍᏚᎩᎡᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsiholi">ᏦᏥᎰᎵ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Itsigolinidi">ᎢᏥᎪᎵᏂᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsoginawi">ᏦᎩᎾᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsvyadvnohisdanelv">ᏕᏨᏯᏛᏃᎯᏍᏓᏁᎸ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:12

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utloyiquo">ᎤᏠᏱᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgiyaguyvdanehv">ᏍᎩᏯᎫᏴᏓᏁᎲ</w>—<w xlit="Seq:diquetsi">ᏗᏇᏥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigatsiwonedisgo">ᏥᎦᏥᏬᏁᏗᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvwonediha">ᎢᏨᏬᏁᏗᎭ</w>—<w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadvnohi">ᏗᏣᏛᏃᎯ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niditsadoligvna">ᏂᏗᏣᏙᎵᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsulaha">ᎢᏧᎳᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidetsigilanaladisgesdi">ᏱᏕᏥᎩᎳᎾᎳᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nanohiyuhvsgvna">ᎾᏃᎯᏳᎲᏍᎬᎾ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gadoyeno">ᎦᏙᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadudadv">ᏚᎾᏚᏓᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gado">ᎦᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunvnv">ᏄᏅᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga-gati">ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisigi">ᎤᎵᏏᎩ</w>?

verses.name: II Corinthians 6:15

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yusquanigodi">ᏳᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Sedaniyeno">ᏎᏓᏂᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dikahna·hawadidohi">ᏗᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga-gadv">ᎢᎦ-ᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehi">ᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atselvsgoi">ᎠᏤᎸᏍᎪᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodiyu">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duyugodv">ᏚᏳᎪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidasdi">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanatselvsga">ᏯᎾᏤᎸᏍᎦ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulisqualvdi">ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyunalisdanedi">ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunilvwisdanelv">ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Taline">ᏔᎵᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiweha">ᏂᏥᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unegu">ᎤᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquelisehesdi">ᏯᏇᎵᏎᎮᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:iyu">ᎢᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdesdi">ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginegu">ᎠᎩᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disgiyadanilvgi">ᏗᏍᎩᏯᏓᏂᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdiyi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiwesgv">ᏂᏥᏪᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinegv">ᏥᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwesdi">ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsinega">ᏱᏥᏁᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aginegusgini">ᎠᎩᏁᎫᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinega">ᏥᏁᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsinayesgvna">ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvdiha">ᏥᎬᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigatlvquasga">ᏥᎦᏢᏆᏍᎦ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunitsata">ᏧᏂᏣᏔ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsanatlvquisga">ᏣᎾᏢᏈᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uquedali">ᎤᏇᏓᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdodi">ᎬᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatlvquasi">ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unineguyeno">ᎤᏂᏁᎫᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unanelagi">ᎤᎾᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dotseliseha">ᏙᏤᎵᏎᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsiyelvha">ᎢᏥᏰᎸᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsigatanai">ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎾᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:20
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Unelagiyeno">ᎤᏁᎳᎩᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itselisgo">ᎢᏤᎵᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsinatlvnv">ᏱᏗᏥᎾᏢᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asvha">ᎠᏒᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinitsvnelv">ᏱᏂᏨᏁᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsihv">ᎢᏥᎲ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:yitsigielv">ᏱᏥᎩᎡᎸ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yudalisaladanv">ᏳᏓᎵᏌᎳᏓᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsakadv">ᏕᏣᎧᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsvnilv">ᏱᏨᏂᎸ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:21
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udehohisdi">ᎤᏕᎰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinega">ᏥᏁᎦ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsotsiwanagala">ᏦᏥᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gogosehvi">ᎪᎪᏎᎲᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Na·hna·hasgininonv">ᎾᎿᎭᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwanayehisdi">ᎬᏩᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> (<w xlit="Seq:unegu">ᎤᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneisdi">ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinega">ᏥᏁᎦ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsinayesgvna">ᏂᏥᎾᏰᏍᎬᎾ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:22
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Inaquilu">ᎢᎾᏈᎷ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Aniisili">ᎠᏂᎢᏏᎵ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Equahamisgo">ᎡᏆᎭᎻᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunetlvtanvdv">ᏧᏁᏢᏔᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:23
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigo">ᏥᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunvsidasdi">ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>? (<w xlit="Seq:unegu">ᎤᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uneisdi">ᎤᏁᎢᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinega">ᏥᏁᎦ</w>,) <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlii">ᎤᏟᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dagilvwisdanehv">ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vgilivnilv">ᎥᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utlihiyu">ᎤᏟᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:digasdudiyi">ᏗᎦᏍᏚᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgiyvtanvi">ᎥᎩᏴᏔᏅᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igai">ᎢᎦᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agiyohusidena">ᎠᎩᏲᎱᏏᏕᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanoquo">ᏯᏃᏉ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:24
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Anitsusi">ᎠᏂᏧᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hisgi">ᎯᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigvgilivnilvgi">ᏂᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdiha">ᎢᏳᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galulogi">ᎦᎷᎶᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgasgohi">ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvquvnisdiyi">ᎢᎬᏋᏂᏍᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:25
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsoi">ᏦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwagudi">ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ganasda">ᎦᎾᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degvgilivnistanvgi">ᏕᎬᎩᎵᎥᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:saquo">ᏌᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvya">ᏅᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidegvquvnistanvgi">ᏂᏕᎬᏋᏂᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsoi">ᏦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwagudi">ᎢᏳᏩᎫᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyu">ᏥᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatsodv">ᎠᏆᏦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uyotsvgi">ᎤᏲᏨᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ulitsvdaquadv">ᎤᎵᏨᏓᏆᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udodaquadv">ᎤᏙᏓᏆᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asdvgv">ᎠᏍᏛᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquadvnvgi">ᎾᏆᏛᏅᎩ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:26
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gedohv">ᎨᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yanoquo">ᏯᏃᏉ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:equoni">ᎡᏉᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degeyv">ᏕᎨᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unayehisdiyu">ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:dinadanasahvsgi">ᏗᎾᏓᎾᏌᎲᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninayehisdiyu">ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:diquatseli">ᏗᏆᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninayehisdiyu">ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsunadalenvdv">ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninayehisdiyu">ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:gaduhv">ᎦᏚᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unayehisdiyu">ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:inage">ᎢᎾᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unayehisdiyu">ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:amequohi">ᎠᎺᏉᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unayehisdiyu">ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:unatlonasdi">ᎤᎾᏠᎾᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:otsalinvtli">ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uninayehisdiyu">ᎤᏂᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:27
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Dagiyawetsidolv">ᏓᎩᏯᏪᏥᏙᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualisdanelvi">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:yanogiyu">ᏯᏃᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsilvsgvna">ᏂᏥᎸᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:agonu">ᎠᎪᏄ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyosisgvi">ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agitadegisgvi">ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:yanogiyu">ᏯᏃᎩᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:amatli">ᎠᎹᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvsgvi">ᎬᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:uyvtlv">ᎤᏴᏢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvha">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:28
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nidatloyasdvna">ᏂᏓᏠᏯᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidugitsvnisv">ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsagilutseha">ᏣᎩᎷᏤᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diquagasayasdodiyi">ᏗᏆᎦᏌᏯᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadatluwadisvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:29
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:awanagaloi">ᎠᏩᎾᎦᎶᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsiwanigalvna">ᏂᏥᏩᏂᎦᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duwodehihoi">ᏚᏬᏕᎯᎰᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayvno">ᎠᏴᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsileyvsgvna">ᏂᏥᎴᏴᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>?

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:30
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ase">ᎠᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesesdi">ᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanagaliyu">ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagatlvquasi">ᏓᎦᏢᏆᏏ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:31
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igatseli">ᎢᎦᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Tsisa">ᏥᏌ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udoda">ᎤᏙᏓ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvquododi">ᎦᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:agataha">ᎠᎦᏔᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigatsigovsgvna">ᏂᎦᏥᎪᎥᏍᎬᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:32
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Demasga">ᏕᎹᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigedohv">ᏫᎨᏙᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nugvwiyusedegi">ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏎᏕᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Elida">ᎡᎵᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwekanvhi">ᎤᏪᎧᏅᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ayawisgvgi">ᎠᏯᏫᏍᎬᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Anidemasga">ᎠᏂᏕᎹᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniduhvi">ᎤᏂᏚᎲᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udulisgv">ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginiyvdiyi">ᎠᎩᏂᏴᏗᏱ</w>;

verses.name: II Corinthians 11:33
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Atsolanvno">ᎠᏦᎳᏅᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagvginugowisvgi">ᏓᎬᎩᏄᎪᏫᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:talutsagihi">ᏔᎷᏣᎩᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvquatsodi">ᎬᏆᏦᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvquatlovtanvgi">ᎬᏆᏠᎥᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asoyulodi">ᎠᏐᏳᎶᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiyadiwiselvgi">ᏥᏯᏗᏫᏎᎸᎩ</w>.  <chapter eID="2Cor.11"/>

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv161"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 12</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv161"/><w xlit="Seq:Vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvwadasdelvdi">ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdiyi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:datsineistani">ᏓᏥᏁᎢᏍᏔᏂ</w> [<w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w>] <w xlit="Seq:unelawiselv">ᎤᏁᎳᏫᏎᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nuwanelvi">ᏄᏩᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:2
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tsigatahvgi">ᏥᎦᏔᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgaya">ᎠᏍᎦᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyuhvsgi">ᎪᎯᏳᎲᏍᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadu">ᏂᎦᏚ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nadetiyv">ᎾᏕᏘᏴ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:ayav">ᎠᏯᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nayavna">ᎾᏯᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agataha">ᎠᎦᏔᎭ</w>;) <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatinawidvhvgi">ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoine">ᏦᎢᏁ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galvlo">ᎦᎸᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wagatinolvgi">ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:3
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigatahi">ᏥᎦᏔᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w>, (<w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayav">ᎠᏯᎥ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayelv">ᎠᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nayavna">ᎾᏯᎥᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsigataha">ᏱᏥᎦᏔᎭ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agataha">ᎠᎦᏔᎭ</w>;)

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:4
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agatinawidvhvgi">ᎠᎦᏘᎾᏫᏛᎲᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvwadohiyadv">ᏅᏩᏙᎯᏯᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digesv">ᏗᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wagatinolvgi">ᏩᎦᏘᏃᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udvganvgi">ᎤᏛᎦᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aniwonisgv">ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igawesdi">ᎢᎦᏪᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:niduyugodvna">ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwesdiyi">ᎢᏳᏪᏍᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:5
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsineisdisgv">ᏥᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigatlvqui">ᏱᎦᏢᏈ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aquvsvsgini">ᎠᏋᏒᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gadaneisdisgv">ᎦᏓᏁᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvgagatlvqui">ᏴᎦᎦᏢᏈ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanagaliyu">ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Iyuyeno">ᎢᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yaquaduli">ᏯᏆᏚᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdiyi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aginegu">ᎠᎩᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigagesesdi">ᏱᎦᎨᏎᏍᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhiyeno">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yitsinohvli">ᏱᏥᏃᎲᎵ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aseno">ᎠᏎᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unelagi">ᎤᏁᎳᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vgela">ᎥᎨᎳ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodiha">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtesgv">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiniagilvquodi">ᏱᏂᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ano">ᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naquasdv">ᎾᏆᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agigowatisgvi">ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nusdv">ᏄᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadvgisgvi">ᎠᏆᏛᎩᏍᎬᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgino">ᎾᏍᎩᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvstanvhi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualisaladodiyi">ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgv">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginanugowiselvgi">ᎥᎩᎾᏄᎪᏫᏎᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:agitsayohihi">ᎠᎩᏣᏲᎯᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginelvgi">ᎥᎩᏁᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiquedalvi">ᎠᎩᏇᏓᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Sedani">ᏎᏓᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unvsidv">ᎤᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvnihi">ᎠᏋᏂᎯ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulosvstanvhi">ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualisaladodiyi">ᎠᏆᎵᏌᎳᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugvwali">ᎤᎬᏩᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsoi">ᏦᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsitayoselvgi">ᏂᏥᏔᏲᏎᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Ugvwiyuhi">ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvediyi">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᎡᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiano">ᎯᎠᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagiweselvgi">ᎾᎩᏪᏎᎸᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gvwagatiya">ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadadolisdi">ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yeliquo">ᏰᎵᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsalisdelvdodi">ᎨᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:aqualinigvgvyeno">ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎬᎬᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ukalitsvhi">ᎤᎧᎵᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnelvhi">ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·hawanagala">ᎾᎿᎭᏩᎾᎦᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>. <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualihelitsvhi">ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utli">ᎤᏟ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvha">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatlvquisdiyi">ᎠᏆᏢᏈᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanagaliyu">ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidiyu">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquutlvdodiyi">ᎠᏊᏢᏙᏗᏱ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:galieliga">ᎦᎵᎡᎵᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanagaliyu">ᏥᏩᎾᎦᎵᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gayvgisotlvdvi">ᎦᏴᎩᏐᏢᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:aginigidv">ᎠᎩᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyo">ᎤᏲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvquvhna·hadegvi">ᏅᏋᎿᎭᏕᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ehisdi">ᎡᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadanvtawadegv">ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgvi">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tsiwanigaliyuyeno">ᏥᏩᏂᎦᎵᏳᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigeso">ᏥᎨᏐ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aqualinigidiyu">ᎠᏆᎵᏂᎩᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesoi">ᎨᏐᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Aginegu">ᎠᎩᏁᎫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:naqualistanv">ᎾᏆᎵᏍᏔᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatlvquasgvi">ᎦᏢᏆᏍᎬᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nisgiyvnisasi">ᏂᏍᎩᏴᏂᏌᏏ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nihiyeno">ᏂᎯᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgilvquododi">ᏍᎩᎸᏉᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:vtlayeno">ᎥᏝᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sudalegi">ᏑᏓᎴᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unv">ᎤᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigatsiyoasga">ᏱᎦᏥᏲᎠᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunigvwiyusv">ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsinvsidv">ᎨᏥᏅᏏᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohusdi">ᎪᎱᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Udohiyuhiya">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adolehohisdodi">ᎠᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏙᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vginvsidv">ᎥᎩᏅᏏᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:digalvwisdanelvhi">ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigalisdiha">ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsehvi">ᎢᏤᎲᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:gvtanvhi">ᎬᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidiyu">ᎬᏂᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:uyelvdvi">ᎤᏰᎸᏛᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:usquanigodi">ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degalvwisdanelvi">ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:degalvwisdanelvi">ᏕᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gadono">ᎦᏙᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:usdi">ᎤᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hna·haesga">ᎾᎿᎭᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsohasga">ᏕᏦᎭᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:disoi">ᏗᏐᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsunanelodi">ᏧᎾᏁᎶᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunadatluwadisvi">ᏚᎾᏓᏡᏩᏗᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagedv">ᎦᎨᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvyvnelvna">ᏂᏨᏴᏁᎸᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:gesgivsiquo">ᎨᏍᎩᎥᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adina">ᎠᏗᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsatini">ᎤᏣᏘᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nitsvyadvnelvi">ᏂᏨᏯᏛᏁᎸᎢ</w>.

verses.name: II Corinthians 12:14

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utsati">ᎤᏣᏘ</w> <w xlit="Seq:osiyu">ᎣᏏᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agiyelvsesdi">ᎠᎩᏰᎸᏎᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquaguyvhidasdiyi">ᎠᏆᎫᏴᎯᏓᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquvsv">ᎠᏋᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquadisvhvsdiyi">ᎠᏆᏗᏒᎲᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsadanvdo">ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:detsisdelisgvi">ᏕᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasquo">ᎾᏍᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanequogv">ᎧᏁᏉᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsvgeyusvi">ᎢᏨᎨᏳᏒᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ugayolohisdiyi">ᎤᎦᏲᎶᎯᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinigvneha">ᏱᏂᎬᏁᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:sgigeyusvi">ᏍᎩᎨᏳᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:mosi">ᎼᏏ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udohiyuhi">ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalidasdvna">ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigav">ᏂᎦᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinavi">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsinvsidasdi">ᎠᏥᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiyai">ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gohiyudisgi">ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudalenvdv">ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvnedi">ᎢᎬᏁᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:6
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Galonedvsgini">ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aganvgi">ᎠᎦᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nudalidasdvna">ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvgi">ᎨᏒᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwasv">ᎤᏩᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinavi">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dudatinav">ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itela">ᎢᏖᎳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yidiginiyvha">ᏱᏗᎩᏂᏴᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvlisquadisgi">ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igalisgasdodv">ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idatlvquisdodisgv">ᎢᏓᏢᏈᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udugi">ᎤᏚᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvdi">ᎬᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:7
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Galvquodiyu">ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Adanvdo">ᎠᏓᏅᏙ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinigaweha">ᏥᏂᎦᏪᎭ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanegv">ᎧᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvgodiyi">ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadulisgesdi">ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w>,

verses.name: Hebrews 3:8
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsisdayodisgesdi">ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinawi">ᏗᏥᎾᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadvnelv">ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvginalvstanvgi">ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvgigoliyevgi">ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inagei">ᎢᎾᎨᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Hebrews 3:9
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsigayvlige">ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvgigoliyesgvgi">ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvquagatisgvgi">ᏥᎬᏆᎦᏘᏍᎬᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:anigowatisgvgisgininonv">ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dagilvwisdanehv">ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgasgohi">ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudetiyvdv">ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:10
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gatsiniquotilvgi">ᎦᏥᏂᏉᏘᎸᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yvwi">ᏴᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hia">ᎯᎠ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nagiwesvgi">ᎾᎩᏪᏒᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Nigohilv">ᏂᎪᎯᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dulena·hiha">ᏚᎴᎾᎯᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsuninawi">ᏧᏂᎾᏫ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:vtla">ᎥᏝ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unigadovsvhi">ᎤᏂᎦᏙᎥᏒᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigi">ᏱᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:daginvnvi">ᏓᎩᏅᏅᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:11
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdayulisdotanvgi">ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquaselitanvgi">ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:agitalawosgv">ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvsdiyu">ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aquatseli">ᎠᏆᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsawesolvsdodiyi">ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:12
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Itseyatahesdi">ᎢᏤᏯᏔᎮᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:idalinvtli">ᎢᏓᎵᏅᏟ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdiquo">ᏞᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uwohiyuhisdv">ᎤᏬᎯᏳᎯᏍᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unawi">ᎤᎾᏫ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yuyaesdi">ᏳᏯᎡᏍᏗ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:adanvehi">ᎠᏓᏅᎡᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnidv">ᎬᏂᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Unelanvhi">ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:13
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Detsadawonidisgesdisgini">ᏕᏣᏓᏬᏂᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidugitsvnisvi">ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:asiquo">ᎠᏏᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gagosedi">ᎦᎪᏎᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:getsisdayohisdi">ᎨᏥᏍᏓᏲᎯᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyulisdodiyi">ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:udalidasdi">ᎤᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:asgani">ᎠᏍᎦᏂ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuwanisadv">ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:14
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Degadudadewisvyeno">ᏕᎦᏚᏓᏕᏫᏒᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Galonedv">ᎦᎶᏁᏛ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvwasdiquo">ᏱᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:deginiyvsv">ᏕᎩᏂᏴᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ulinigidv">ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvlisquadisgi">ᎬᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igvyiyi">ᎢᎬᏱᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igalisgasdotanvi">ᎢᎦᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏔᏅᎢ</w>;

verses.name: Hebrews 3:15
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Hiayeno">ᎯᎠᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igawedv">ᎢᎦᏪᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:igi">ᎢᎩ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:Gohi">ᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iga">ᎢᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyuno">ᎢᏳᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadulisgesdi">ᎢᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:kanegv">ᎧᏁᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsadvgodiyi">ᎢᏣᏛᎪᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:tlesdi">ᏞᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yiditsisdayodisgesdi">ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ditsinawi">ᏗᏥᎾᏫ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgiya">ᎾᏍᎩᏯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunadvnelv">ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na·hiyu">ᎾᎯᏳ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigvginalvstanvgi">ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 3:16
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Gagoyeno">ᎦᎪᏰᏃ</w> <w xlit="Seq:hna·haquo">ᎿᎭᏉ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unadvganv">ᎤᎾᏛᎦᏅ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:unihna·halvstanei">ᎤᏂᎿᎭᎸᏍᏔᏁᎢ</w>; <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigadv">ᏂᎦᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Itsiquiyi">ᎢᏥᏈᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nidodayudinvstanvhi">ᏂᏙᏓᏳᏗᏅᏍᏔᏅᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:Yisi">ᏱᏏ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinunadvnelei">ᏱᏄᎾᏛᏁᎴᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:17
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvgasgohi">ᏅᎦᏍᎪᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsudetiyvdv">ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ</w> <w xlit="Seq:duniquatilei">ᏚᏂᏆᏘᎴᎢ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:unisganvtsvhi">ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:diniyelv">ᏗᏂᏰᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:inage">ᎢᎾᎨ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsidunvtsei">ᏥᏚᏅᏤᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:18
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Ale">ᎠᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gago">ᎦᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:dunetsele">ᏚᏁᏤᎴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:aselidvsgv">ᎠᏎᎵᏛᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:uniyvsdiyi">ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsaweyvlvsdodiyi">ᎠᏣᏪᏴᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>? <w xlit="Seq:tlasgo">ᏝᏍᎪ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yigese">ᏱᎨᏎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:na">Ꮎ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunohiyusvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigesei">ᏥᎨᏎᎢ</w>?

verses.name: Hebrews 3:19
verses.text: <w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsinusdi">ᏥᏄᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idigowatiha">ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigvwaniyvsdi">ᏫᎬᏩᏂᏴᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nigesvna">ᏂᎨᏒᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesv">ᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nvdigalisdodisgv">ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nunohiyunvna">ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏅᎾ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gesvi">ᎨᏒᎢ</w>.  <chapter eID="Heb.3"/>

verses.name: Hebrews 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv208"/><title type="x-chapterLabel">ᎠᏯᏙᎸᎢ 4</title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv208"/><w xlit="Seq:Nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:iyusdi">ᎢᏳᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:ayv">ᎠᏴ</w> <w xlit="Seq:idinayesgesdi">ᎢᏗᎾᏰᏍᎨᏍᏗ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:svgiduisdanelv">ᏒᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ</w> <w xlit="Seq:wigiyvsdiyi">ᏫᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ</w> <w xlit="Seq:tsigi">ᏥᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:utseli">ᎤᏤᎵ</w> <w xlit="Seq:atsawesolvsdodiyi">ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ</w>, <w xlit="Seq:nasgi">ᎾᏍᎩ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gvnigesv">ᎬᏂᎨᏒ</w> <w xlit="Seq:yinvgalisda">ᏱᏅᎦᎵᏍᏓ</w> <w xlit="Seq:nihi">ᏂᎯ</w> <w xlit="Seq:gilo">ᎩᎶ</w> <w xlit="Seq:esga">ᎡᏍᎦ</w> <w xlit="Seq:itsohasvi">ᎢᏦᎭᏒᎢ</w>.

verses.name: Hebrews 4:2
